issues.title: managed-agent: post-preparation Workspace refusals still use the ordinary pre-admission budget

labels.name: priority/P2
labels.description: Medium - Moderately impactful, noticeable problem

labels.name: type/bug
labels.description: Something isn't working as expected

labels.name: scope/session-management
labels.description: Session state and persistence

issues.body:
### What happened?

After #17457, every non-cancelling Turn prepares the Runtime before loading the Harness Session. Preparation waits for the Runtime Broker's `warm()` future, which completes after the binding is provisioned and attested — but that is not proof that the daemon's Workspace registry is already `active`.

If `POST /session/:id/load` still returns `503 {"code":"workspace_runtime_unavailable"}` after preparation, the coordinator classifies it as an ordinary pre-admission failure. The Turn gets the default five pre-admission retries (about 31 seconds of backoff) and can then terminate with the refusal code even though Runtime provisioning has already completed.

This is a follow-up to #17380 / #17457. It is not yet reproduced on a live stack: the code path is reachable, but we do not have evidence that the daemon activation window normally exceeds the retry budget.

### What did you expect to happen?

A Workspace that has completed Broker preparation should either become loadable within the existing retry window (in which case this can be closed as not-a-bug with evidence), or be waited on explicitly under a bounded ceiling that keeps checking cancellation and dispatch-lease ownership. The wait must not extend the general retry exemptions or hold the Turn indefinitely.

The terminal code should remain the refusal's own code: `workspace_runtime_unavailable` for the current 503 and `workspace_unavailable` for the legacy 409.

### Relevant code paths

- `HarnessCoordinator.prepareRuntime` runs before `createOrLoad` / `recoverManagedRuntime`: `packages/managed-agent-server/control-plane/src/main/java/com/alibaba/qwen/code/managedagent/session/HarnessCoordinator.java:514-530`, `:1143-1150`.
- `RuntimeWarmer.warm` delegates to `RuntimeBrokerService.warm`, whose completion covers binding provisioning and attestation: `packages/managed-agent-server/control-plane/src/main/java/com/alibaba/qwen/code/managedagent/workspace/runtime/ManagedRuntimeCoordinator.java:247-255`, `packages/managed-agent-server/runtime-broker/src/main/java/com/alibaba/qwen/code/runtimebroker/service/RuntimeBrokerService.java:524-530`.
- The daemon load route can still answer 503 when the managed entry is not active or the live session owner is unavailable: `packages/cli/src/serve/routes/session.ts:1865`, `:1909`.
- The SDK maps that refusal to `HarnessSessionRefusedFailure`: `packages/managed-agent-server/adapters/src/main/java/com/alibaba/qwen/code/managedagent/harness/HarnessSdkValues.java:65`.
- The ordinary pre-admission budget defaults to five retries: `packages/managed-agent-server/server/src/main/java/com/alibaba/qwen/code/managedagent/config/ManagedAgentProperties.java:897`.

### Evidence needed

- Control-plane logs showing Runtime warm completion or successful attestation followed by repeated 503 load refusals, with timestamps.
- Whether the window appears after a daemon restart, a Workspace generation replacement, or a cold provisioning run.
- The Turn's final terminal code and retry count, plus whether cancellation or lease loss was involved.

### Anything else we need to know?

A prior attempt (#17516) tried to classify the refusal as a provisioning wait. It was closed because the current 503 arrives as `HarnessSessionRefusedFailure`, not `HarnessHttpFailure`, and its deferral path still charged the same budget, so it did not change production behavior. This follow-up should not revive that approach without a real budget-exemption design.

<details>
<summary>Client Information</summary>

Not applicable — server-side managed-agent control-plane issue; no local client reproduction.

</details>

issues.title: Agent Collaboration: delegate to agents in different registered workspaces of the same daemon

labels.name: priority/P2
labels.description: Medium - Moderately impactful, noticeable problem

labels.name: type/feature-request
labels.description: New feature or enhancement request

labels.name: category/core
labels.description: Core engine and logic

labels.name: roadmap/multi-agent
labels.description: Roadmap: Multi-agent collaboration

issues.body:
### What would you like to be added?

Support native Agent Collaboration between **different registered workspaces in the same Qwen Code daemon**. A main session in workspace A should be able to `@` an assistant bound to workspace B, let it execute in B, and receive its progress, questions and final result back in A.

For example, an embedding application has a main workspace and several specialist assistants. Each assistant already has its own registered workspace with its own `QWEN.md`, skills, tools, project settings and sessions. Asking `@SqlAssistant` from the main session should use that assistant's existing workspace context. It should not require switching the main session's workspace or copying the assistant's configuration into it.

The desired contract is:

1. **Bind and address the target.** Provide a supported API to register/bind a native agent to an existing workspace in this daemon, then expose it to an authorized caller's native `@` roster. Resolve the binding by stable workspace/agent IDs; display names alone must not select the execution target.
2. **Execute in the target context.** Create or resume a native session in B using B's effective directory, instructions, skills, tools and configuration. Keep A's context unchanged and enforce existing workspace trust and permission boundaries. Copying a definition into A is not sufficient.
3. **Return progress and results.** Preserve the native collaboration run/session identity and authorship when reporting queued/running/waiting/terminal states, useful progress and the final result to A. Expose a stable target-session/task reference that the embedding application can turn into an openable link. A message-delivery acknowledgement alone is not task completion.
4. **Handle long-running tasks and follow-ups.** Allow A to continue working while B runs, with supported wait/read or event delivery and a way to recover the binding after reconnect or restart. A follow-up or targeted cancellation should affect the intended task in B without starting a duplicate task or cancelling unrelated sessions.
5. **Relay structured user questions.** If B calls `ask_user_question`, make the pending question available to A, including the original request identity, answer keys, all questions/options and free-text or multiple-selection semantics. A host can answer from authorized context it already has, or ask the user, then submit the answer to that same pending request in B. This must resume the original task rather than send a new user prompt. Ordinary questions and tool-permission approvals need separate semantics; this must not implicitly approve tools.
6. **Support the assistant lifecycle.** An embedding application should be able to register and verify the binding when it creates an assistant, and disable/retire or unbind that agent when the assistant is removed. Reconciliation after an unknown API outcome should not create duplicate agents. Retirement should prevent future calls while preserving the appropriate history and attribution.

The API shape is open. Reusing the daemon's existing workspace/session backend through a supported execution adapter would work; a documented existing API that provides this complete flow would also satisfy the request. A separate daemon or remote AgentHost for each local workspace would add avoidable operational overhead to this use case.

### Why is this needed?

Native collaboration already provides useful shared-session scheduling and replies. The missing integration point for our application is selecting an **independent registered workspace as the native agent's execution context** and carrying its interaction lifecycle back to the invoking session.

We currently bridge this using a small on-demand skill that calls daemon session APIs to create a task in B, read/wait for progress, and answer an original pending question. The application also has to maintain task references and continuation state. We would prefer native `@agent` collaboration to own this lifecycle while reusing those session capabilities, without an extra model acting as a relay.

This is a same-daemon use case. The workspaces may be ordinary independent directories and do not need to be linked Git worktrees or remote hosts.

### Additional context

Checked against public `main` at `2366c440a002ba912f565a8c60fed48753d6fd1d`: local agent execution uses the invoking workspace ([orchestrator](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/2366c440a002ba912f565a8c60fed48753d6fd1d/packages/cli/src/serve/session-agents/orchestrator.ts#L2263-L2274)), and the [execution configuration](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/2366c440a002ba912f565a8c60fed48753d6fd1d/packages/core/src/agents/workspace-agents/types.ts#L167-L180) offers local or managed-host modes without an explicit target registered workspace. The native session-agent question/approval relay accepts an option selection ([route](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/2366c440a002ba912f565a8c60fed48753d6fd1d/packages/cli/src/serve/routes/session-agents.ts#L517), [adapter](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/2366c440a002ba912f565a8c60fed48753d6fd1d/packages/cli/src/serve/session-agents/adapters/qwen-acp.ts#L413)) but does not expose the full structured answer flow described above. If there is already a supported API or extension point for this scenario, please point us to an example; these observations are not a claim that Qwen Code lacks multi-agent collaboration in general.

Related requests have different execution boundaries:

- #15682 shares user-level agent/squad definitions across workspaces while keeping runtime state per workspace. Here the agent must execute in its bound workspace B when invoked from A.
- #15316 asks for per-session directories under one shared workspace configuration. Here A and B are separate registered workspaces with their own configuration.
- #13785 concerns agent identity and attribution on the public multi-agent contract. This request adds the cross-workspace execution and interaction flow that an embedding application needs.

A minimal acceptance scenario is: register A and B with distinguishable instructions/skills; bind an assistant to B; invoke it from A; verify execution uses B; relay and answer a question without creating a new prompt; receive the final result and task reference in A; retire the binding and verify it is no longer callable.

labels.name: priority/P2
labels.description: Medium - Moderately impactful, noticeable problem

labels.name: type/feature-request

labels.name: category/core

issues.body:
## What this issue tracks

#17045 moves every surface onto the shared agent loop and the event-bus kernel, turns the defaults on and removes the old loops. This issue collects what #17045 leaves out, so its freeze on 2026-11-21 does not drop it. Each item names where its decision or design is recorded.

### From #17045's scope

- [ ] A surface hands its whole turn to the loop, with no `maxRounds` and no round driver of its own. Headless's main turn does not do this either; it touches when queued input, notifications and Goal turns start a round.
- [ ] Streaming tool dispatch, on the design recorded in [Streaming tool dispatch](docs/design/2026-11-11-streaming-tool-dispatch.md), with `llm.tool_call` and `tool.cancel`, which it publishes. Worth revisiting for a provider path that ends each call during the stream, or for calls that need approval or write.
- [x] The Hosted Harness's model round on the shared loop, as a separate opt-in slice; its journaled tool batch stays ([evaluation](docs/design/2026-11-14-hosted-harness-loop-evaluation.md), #17248) — landed as #17264.

### From the speculation PR 6b decision (#17324)

The [PR 6b decision](docs/design/2026-11-15-speculation-tool-step.md) (merged as #17324) keeps speculation's own tool step and speculative loop; only its model round runs on the shared loop (PR 6a, #17029). It discharges #17045's two speculation decision boxes (the tool-step decision and the unit-parity gate decision). The gated steps and reconciliations it leaves:

- [ ] 6c — speculation on by default, then remove its current round: the record's own label for #17045's unnumbered "On by default" / "Legacy path removed" boxes. The flip must satisfy the five-step model's step-2 criteria in the [unified agent loop](docs/design/2026-10-23-unified-agent-loop.md).
- [ ] Reconcile the 6c integration gate: the parent design's integration entry expects a run "added when its default flip is prepared", but a deterministic end-to-end speculative round is impractical (a background, timing-dependent optimization). Name a nightly integration signal that satisfies the rule, or record here that the unit parity suite suffices for the default flip too.
- [x] Close the partial-batch boundary coverage before the 6c flip: the existing boundary tests cover only the zero-executed bail on the raw-chunk arm; the partial-batch hand-back and its composition with the shared round's parts have no test on either arm (the path is already reachable through the opt-in setting). Also pin an absolute count in the multi-call parity scenario. — landed as #17399.
- [x] Reconcile #17045's obsolete speculation entries: the "Kernel on by default, if PR 6b put its run on `runAgentLoop`" box is moot under the decision (speculation keeps its own run), and the 11-18 dated row "PR 6b merged, with speculation's integration scenario" is replaced by the record's unit-parity gate decision. — recorded in the PR 6b decision's numbering note; #17045's entries are left as history.
- [x] Reconcile the end-state numbers and the removal rule with the keep-its-own decisions: "1 agent loop implementation", "1 `finalizeToolResponses` caller", "1 session turn-cap formula" and #17045's "Legacy loops outside the Hosted Harness" (6 → 0) are not literally reachable — speculation keeps its speculative loop and finalizer, and the Hosted Harness keeps its journaled loop, tool step and outer-loop turn cap. The parent's End-state footnote records the shape; the Target cells and the removal rule's wording are this item's to fix. — landed as #17416.
- [x] Refresh the parent design's tracker pointers (the Status line, Related, the five-step heading and the Follow-up section) so the remaining steps route to #17045 and only the work it leaves out routes to this issue, without asserting a tracker state. — landed as #17416.

### From the capability ledger

The [capability ledger](docs/design/2026-11-15-loop-capability-ledger.md) maps each behavior of the 1.0 loop to main. These rows go here:

- [ ] L11: async hook output delivery — the `LlmClient` request-path drain is carried by #17477 (the ledger row moves `missing` → `differs`); the remaining surface gap, the ACP default legacy session-chat path, is the first item of the #17477 subsection below.
- [ ] C10: a Stop hook's `continue: false` continues the model instead of ending the turn.
- [ ] C14, T11: a PostToolUse or PreToolUse `stop` fails only the call instead of ending the turn.
- [ ] C28: headless does not fire StopFailure when a request fails, as the TUIs, ACP and the Hosted Harness do.
- [ ] C32: a detailed terminal reason (`hook_stopped`, `model_refusal`, `prompt_too_long`, …) in the headless and SDK result.
- [ ] C6: a hook output that sets the session title.
- [ ] C11: a Stop hook that clears the context before its continuation.
- [ ] L7: reminders of the turns a bounded run has left.
- [ ] T13: a notice in the result when a hook replaced a call's input.

### From the async hook output delivery (#17477)

#17477 carries the L11 delivery on the `LlmClient` request path: it drains pending async hook output at the request assembly and hands it to the model, and registers the envelope with the wire-order classifier. The delivery is in-memory only (the transcript record is built from the pre-append request, so resume does not carry the block), and it reaches the surfaces whose model round sends through `LlmClient.sendMessageStream`; the ledger row is `differs` rather than `have` because the ACP default legacy round does not drain yet. These refinements from its review are left here, not in that PR:

- [ ] Deliver on the ACP default legacy round (R2-1): that round sends through the session's own chat (`Session.ts` → `chat.sendMessageStream`), never entering `LlmClient.sendMessageStream`, so its async output is still collected and dropped. Add the same drain/append pair to the ACP session's own assembly, reusing the helper; do not route the legacy round onto `LlmClient` (the session comment says it deliberately does not).
- [ ] Tie consumption to the accepted turn (R1-2): the get-and-clear drain runs at request assembly, upstream of the send, so a turn that exits before `turn.run` (a loop-detected ToolResult, an abort, a throw from the side query / microcompact) consumes the block without delivering it, and a `Retry` rebuilds from the caller's parts without re-appending it. Retain the drained part keyed by the prompt id and re-append on the pre-send exits and a matching Retry, or drain immediately before `turn.run`. The design records this as the "selected once, not yet admitted" boundary.
- [x] Recognize the async block as injected prompt context (R1-3): `isAsyncHookContextPartText` is OR'd into `isInjectedPromptContext` so the wire reorder hoists the block ahead of the user's instruction — addressed in #17477.
- [ ] Bound the joined block size (R1-4): the registry accumulates every completion with no total cap and the formatter joins all of it, so a verbose async hook can append megabytes to the request and to the Omni side query that reuses it. Cap the joined block before wrapping, mirroring `sanitizeUserPromptExpansionAdditionalContext` (`MAX_USER_PROMPT_EXPANSION_ADDITIONAL_CONTEXT_LENGTH`, 10 000 chars).
- [ ] Gate the drain by turn ownership (R1-6): a concurrent `/btw` side query (`isConcurrentSideQuery`) reaches the same assembly and drains the running turn's block, leaving the owner turn's next request with nothing. Skip the drain for non-owner requests, matching the other ownership guards in `sendMessageStream`.
- [ ] Design the richer provenance / authority-epoch contract proposed in review: a source envelope (hook-event id, session/workspace binding, config-approval revision, completion time), an admission-time relevance/staleness decision, a consumption record tied to the accepted turn identity, and a "delivery unknown" state. The turn-binding item above sits within this broader direction; display projection and resume provenance for the async block are also follow-ups.

### Later

- [ ] Ledger rows found after 2026-11-21: the 1.0 loop directories (`event-bus/`, `tool-executor/`, `core/query-*`) are diffed against `v1.0.0-preview` every week, and a change becomes a row here.

## Linked issues

Follow-up to #17045.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 issue 跟踪什么

#17045 把每个入口迁到共享 agent loop 和事件总线内核上，打开默认值并删除旧 loop。这个 issue 收集 #17045 不做的部分，免得它在 2026-11-21 冻结时被丢掉。每一项都注明它的决定或设计记录在哪里。

### 来自 #17045 的范围

- [ ] 入口把整轮交给 loop，不再用 `maxRounds`，也不再自己驱动轮次。headless 的主轮次现在也没做到这一步；这涉及排队的输入、通知和 Goal 轮次何时开始一轮。
- [ ] 按 [流式工具派发](docs/design/2026-11-11-streaming-tool-dispatch.zh-CN.md) 记录的设计实现流式派发，以及由它发布的 `llm.tool_call` 和 `tool.cancel`。对于在流式过程中就结束每个调用的 provider 路径，或者要覆盖需要审批或会写入的调用时，值得再评估。
- [x] Hosted Harness 的模型轮迁到共享 loop，作为单独的 opt-in 一步；它的日志化工具批保留（[评估](docs/design/2026-11-14-hosted-harness-loop-evaluation.zh-CN.md)，#17248）——已随 #17264 落地。

### 来自 speculation PR 6b 决策（#17324）

[PR 6b 决策](docs/design/2026-11-15-speculation-tool-step.zh-CN.md)（经 #17324 合入）保留 speculation 自有工具步与投机循环；仅其模型轮运行在共享 loop 上（PR 6a，#17029）。#17045 的两个 speculation 决策框（工具步决策与单元 parity 门禁决策）由此清偿。它留下的门控步骤与调和项：

- [ ] 6c——speculation 默认开启，然后删除其现有模型轮：这是记录对 #17045 无编号「默认开启」/「删除旧路径」框的自有标签。翻转须满足[统一代理循环](docs/design/2026-10-23-unified-agent-loop.zh-CN.md)五步模型 step 2 的判据。
- [ ] 调和 6c 的集成门禁：父设计的集成条目期望「该运行在其准备默认开启时加入」，但确定性端到端投机轮不可行（后台、依赖时序的优化）。点名一个满足该规则的 nightly 集成信号，或在此记录单元 parity 套件对默认翻转亦足够。
- [x] 6c 翻转前补齐部分批次 boundary 覆盖：现有 boundary 测试只覆盖 raw-chunk 臂的零执行 bail；部分批次交回及其与共享轮 parts 的组合在两臂都无测试（该路径经 opt-in 设置已可达）。另在多调用 parity 场景钉住绝对计数。——已随 #17399 落地。
- [x] 调和 #17045 已过时的 speculation 条目：「内核默认开启（如果 PR 6b 把它的运行放到了 `runAgentLoop` 上）」框在本决策下 moot（speculation 保留自有运行）；11-18 日期行「PR 6b 合入，连同 speculation 的集成场景」已被记录的单元 parity 门禁决定取代。——已记录于 PR 6b 决策的编号说明；#17045 的条目作为历史保留。
- [x] 调和最终状态数字与删除规则同保留自有决策的关系：「1 个 agent loop 实现」「1 个 `finalizeToolResponses` 调用者」「1 个会话轮数上限算法」与 #17045 的「Hosted Harness 之外的旧 loop」（6 → 0）并非字面可达——speculation 保留其投机循环与 finalizer，Hosted Harness 保留其 journal 化循环、工具步与外层循环轮数上限。父设计的 End-state 脚注已记录形态；Target 单元格与删除规则措辞由本项修正。——已随 #17416 落地。
- [x] 刷新父设计的 tracker 指针（Status 行、Related、五步标题、Follow-up 段），使剩余步骤指向 #17045、仅其留出工作指向本 issue，且不断言 tracker 状态。——已随 #17416 落地。

### 来自能力台账

[能力台账](docs/design/2026-11-15-loop-capability-ledger.zh-CN.md) 把 1.0 loop 的每项行为与 main 对照。以下几行放到这里：

- [ ] L11：异步 hook 输出交付——`LlmClient` 请求路径的 drain 由 #17477 承载（台账该行 `missing` → `differs`）；剩余的入口缺口，即 ACP 默认 legacy 会话 chat 路径，是下方 #17477 子节的第一项。
- [ ] C10：Stop hook 的 `continue: false` 让模型继续，而不是结束这一轮。
- [ ] C14、T11：PostToolUse 或 PreToolUse 的 `stop` 只让这个调用失败，而不是结束这一轮。
- [ ] C28：headless 在请求失败时不触发 StopFailure，而 TUI、ACP 和 Hosted Harness 会触发。
- [ ] C32：headless 和 SDK 结果里给出详细的结束原因（`hook_stopped`、`model_refusal`、`prompt_too_long` 等）。
- [ ] C6：hook 输出设置会话标题。
- [ ] C11：Stop hook 在续写前清空上下文。
- [ ] L7：提醒有上限的运行还剩多少轮。
- [ ] T13：hook 替换了调用的输入时，在结果里加提示。

### 来自异步 hook 输出交付（#17477）

#17477 在 `LlmClient` 请求路径上承载 L11 的交付：在请求组装处 drain 待交付的异步 hook 输出并交给模型，并把该信封登记到线上顺序分类器。该交付仅在进程内（转录记录由追加前的 request 构建，故 resume 不携带该块），且到达模型轮经 `LlmClient.sendMessageStream` 发送的入口；台账该行是 `differs` 而非 `have`，因为 ACP 默认 legacy 轮次尚未 drain。其评审留下的以下细化项放在这里，不在那个 PR 里：

- [ ] 在 ACP 默认 legacy 轮次上交付（R2-1）：该轮次经会话自有 chat 发送（`Session.ts` → `chat.sendMessageStream`），从不进入 `LlmClient.sendMessageStream`，故其异步输出仍被收集后丢弃。在 ACP 会话自有的组装处加同样的 drain/append 对，复用 helper；不要把 legacy 轮次接到 `LlmClient`（会话注释明确它有意不这样做）。
- [ ] 把消费绑定到被接纳的轮次（R1-2）：取走即清空的 drain 发生在请求组装处、发送上游，因此在 `turn.run` 之前退出的轮次（触发 loop detector 的 ToolResult、abort、侧查询 / microcompact 抛错）会消费掉该块却未送达，而 `Retry` 只用调用方的 parts 重建、不会重新追加它。按 prompt id 保存已 drain 的 part，并在发送前退出与匹配的 Retry 时重新追加，或把 drain 推迟到 `turn.run` 紧前。设计已将此记为「选中一次、尚未被接纳」的边界。
- [x] 把异步块识别为注入的 prompt 上下文（R1-3）：`isAsyncHookContextPartText` 已 OR 进 `isInjectedPromptContext`，使线上重排把该块前移到用户指令之前——已在 #17477 处理。
- [ ] 给拼接块加大小上限（R1-4）：registry 无总量上限地累积每次完成，格式化器又无上限地拼接，因此一个啰嗦的异步 hook 可能把数 MB 文本追加进请求、以及复用它的 Omni 侧查询。在包裹前给拼接结果加上限，参照 `sanitizeUserPromptExpansionAdditionalContext`（`MAX_USER_PROMPT_EXPANSION_ADDITIONAL_CONTEXT_LENGTH`，10 000 字符）。
- [ ] 按轮次归属门控 drain（R1-6）：并发的 `/btw` 侧问（`isConcurrentSideQuery`）会进入同一段组装逻辑并取走当前轮次的块，使归属轮次的下一次请求一无所获。对非归属请求跳过 drain，与 `sendMessageStream` 中其他归属判断一致。
- [ ] 设计评审提出的更宽溯源 / authority-epoch 契约：源信封（hook 事件 id、会话/工作区绑定、配置批准修订、完成时间）、准入时的相关性/陈旧性判定、绑定被接纳轮次身份的消费记录，以及「交付未知」态。上面的轮次绑定项属于这一更宽方向；异步块的显示投影与 resume 溯源同样是 follow-up。

### 之后

- [ ] 2026-11-21 之后发现的台账行：1.0 的 loop 目录（`event-bus/`、`tool-executor/`、`core/query-*`）每周与 `v1.0.0-preview` 对比一次，有变化就在这里加一行。

## 关联 Issue

#17045 的后续。

</details>

issues.body:
## Background

PR #17185 (`feat(verify-pr): require a boundary declaration and own the watch state`) landed via an explicit **land-with-residual-risk** maintainer decision after 17 review rounds. The core security goal — the waiver-approval trust boundary (approval coordinates sourced only from a host-held `--context` snapshot, so a PR cannot forge its own approval) — is achieved for the sanctioned layout. The review loop did not converge (each round's fixes induced new regressions; the deferred count fluctuated 20 → 2 → 14), so the maintainer accepted the residual risks below rather than continue. This issue tracks them so they are not silently dropped.

The full three-column inventory (attack surface · attacker dependency · blast radius) is posted as a comment on #17185.

## Accepted residual risks

### Touches the core trust boundary (highest priority)

- **R17-1 — `--context` containment guard derives trust from path strings.** Two entrances: (A) a round dir directly under root-level `/tmp` yields `trustRoot='/'` so nothing is refused; (B) a hard-link alias of the round's `context.json` evades `realpath`. If triggered, a PR-writable `context.json` supplies the head OID + waiver-approval coordinates → approval forgery. **Layout-dependent**: the sanctioned `<pr-clone>/tmp/…` + `--context-root` layout is not affected; exploitation needs the plain-dir root-level-`tmp` layout with `--context-root` omitted, or same-device hard-link capability. Suggested direction: a root-aware containment predicate (`root === sep || p === root || p.startsWith(root + sep)`) plus a `dev`+`ino` alias check, applied to both the `--context` refusal and the `--context-root` containment test.

### Report integrity / local correctness / docs / liveness

- **R16-1 — container nonce is forgeable.** The nonce plaintext also rides in the PR-writable `<round-dir>/boundary-gate.json`, so a host battery can copy it into a log and mint `mode:"container"`. Report-integrity only (no host access, no approval forgery). Suggested direction: keep the plaintext only at the container-local `$HOME/.qwen-verify-nonce`, store `nonceSha256` in the record, and accept only a matching `container-nonce:` line — or drop the claim and state what the check actually proves.
- **R16-2 — watch-state shape guard too narrow.** Fires only when *no* top-level key is recognised; one identity key (`pr`/`startedAt`) + an unrecognised head spelling passes and `--start` resets state, erasing the in-flight head. Requires operator-local state write access + a hand-written shape. Suggested direction: require a state-*bearing* key and fail closed when none is present.
- **R16-4 — VM prose contradiction.** One SKILL.md paragraph still routes the VM path through the container `--require-isolation` gate the VM bullet says it skips, which can push an operator to a host fallback. Doc-level. Suggested direction: scope that sentence to the container path.
- **R17-2 — registration after prepare.** A session killed inside the prepare window leaves the delivered head in no state while the gate cursor advanced, silently dropping the head. Liveness/availability, fails toward not-certifying, not attacker-controlled. Suggested direction: register ahead of prepare (relax `--start`'s `--artifact-dir` requirement, record the dir at `--complete`) or document the guarantee honestly.

### Deferred Criticals (fails-closed / new-surface — no wrong result certified)

- **D17-1** — Step 7 reads the PR-writable `boundary-gate.json` (same surface as R16-1).
- **D17-2** — the escape hatch in the nonce guard's own error message.
- **D17-3** — widened legacy migration in `inFlightEntries` (same cluster as R16-2).

### Below-Critical deferred (11)

D17-4 … D17-14: ambient-gated pass-path tests, quote-blind negative pins, a replay that never reaches its write, an untested `[ -z "$nonce" ]` half, a dead `sandboxRuntime` field, rendered-Markdown disclosure matching, a followed `evidence/` symlink, `--context-root` accepted without `--context`, a shared size-cap / non-regular-file path, Java-recipe doc drift, and a liveness-gated dead-round recovery. See the findings artifact on #17185.

## Notes

- These are **accepted risks, not fixed defects**. None was resolved by a code change at landing.
- Post-merge, the verify checkout needs a re-sync for the enforcement to take effect there.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 背景

PR #17185（`feat(verify-pr): require a boundary declaration and own the watch state`）经 17 轮评审后，以维护者明确的 **land-with-residual-risk** 决定合入。核心安全目标——豁免批准信任边界（批准坐标只取自主机持有的 `--context` 快照，PR 无法伪造自身批准）——在受认可布局下已达成。评审循环不收敛（每轮修复诱发新回归；deferred 数波动 20 → 2 → 14），故维护者接受下列残余风险而非继续。本 issue 跟踪它们，避免被静默丢弃。

完整三列清单（攻击面·攻击者依赖·影响范围）已作为评论发布于 #17185。

## 接受的残余风险

### 触及核心信任边界（最高优先）

- **R17-1 —— `--context` 围栏守卫从路径字符串推导信任。** 两个入口：(A) 轮目录直挂根级 `/tmp` 使 `trustRoot='/'`，从而什么都不拒绝；(B) 轮 `context.json` 的硬链接别名绕过 `realpath`。若被触发，PR 可写的 `context.json` 提供 head OID + 豁免批准坐标 → 批准伪造。**依赖布局**：受认可的 `<pr-clone>/tmp/…` + `--context-root` 布局不受影响；利用需 plain-dir 根级 `tmp` 布局且省略 `--context-root`，或同设备硬链接能力。建议方向：根感知围栏谓词（`root === sep || p === root || p.startsWith(root + sep)`）加 `dev`+`ino` 别名检查，同时用于 `--context` 拒绝与 `--context-root` 包含测试。

### 报告完整性 / 本地正确性 / 文档 / 活性

- **R16-1 —— 容器 nonce 可伪造。** nonce 明文同时写入 PR 可写的 `<round-dir>/boundary-gate.json`，宿主电池可抄进日志伪造 `mode:"container"`。仅报告完整性（无主机访问、无批准伪造）。建议方向：明文只留容器本地 `$HOME/.qwen-verify-nonce`，记录存 `nonceSha256`，只接受匹配的 `container-nonce:` 行——或放弃该声明、如实说明检查实际证明什么。
- **R16-2 —— watch-state 形状守卫过窄。** 仅「无任何已知顶层键」才触发；一个身份键（`pr`/`startedAt`）+ 未识别 head 拼写即通过，`--start` 重置状态抹掉在飞 head。需操作者本地状态写权限 + 手写形状。建议方向：要求「携带状态的键」，缺失即 fail closed。
- **R16-4 —— VM 文案矛盾。** SKILL.md 某段仍把 VM 路径送进 VM 条目明说跳过的容器 `--require-isolation` 门禁，可能把操作者推向主机回落。文档级。建议方向：把该句限定到容器路径。
- **R17-2 —— 注册移到 prepare 后。** 会话在 prepare 窗口内被杀，使已投递 head 无状态而门禁游标已前进，静默丢 head。活性/可用性，朝不认证方向失败，非攻击者可控。建议方向：注册提前到 prepare 前（放宽 `--start` 的 `--artifact-dir` 要求，`--complete` 记录目录），或如实写明该保证。

### 延后 Critical（fails-closed / new-surface —— 不认证错误结果）

- **D17-1** —— 第 7 步读取 PR 可写的 `boundary-gate.json`（与 R16-1 同一面）。
- **D17-2** —— nonce 守卫自身错误文案的逃生口。
- **D17-3** —— `inFlightEntries` 加宽的遗留迁移（与 R16-2 同簇）。

### 低于 Critical 的延后（11 条）

D17-4 … D17-14：环境门控的 pass-path 用例、引号盲负向钉、从未到达其写入的回放、未测的 `[ -z "$nonce" ]` 半边、死字段 `sandboxRuntime`、按渲染 Markdown 匹配的披露检查、被跟随的 `evidence/` 符号链接、无 `--context` 也接受 `--context-root`、共享的体积上限/非常规文件路径、Java 配方文档漂移、活性判定的死轮恢复。见 #17185 的 findings 工件。

## 说明

- 这些是**接受的风险，非已修复缺陷**。合入时没有任何一条通过代码改动解决。
- 合入后，verify checkout 需再同步一次，强制才在那边生效。

</details>

prs.title: fix(core): defensive resume cached reset, telemetry mirror clear, and test pins
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Follow-up to #12066. This is a defensive reset plus test pins, not a user-visible staleness fix. When resume seeds the prompt and output counts, it now also clears the process-global telemetry mirror of the cached-content count, and keeps a defensive reset of the per-chat cached slot. Tests pin both clears after a real usage report (finite and non-finite seed inputs), and a `/context` case pins the fallback to the global cached count when no session chat exists yet.

## Why it's needed

The other review items from #12066 are already on `main`; this PR carries the remaining delta. `seedResumeTokenCounts` always runs on a freshly started chat, so the per-chat cached slot is already `0` at that point: the per-chat reset is an invariant guard, and `/context` output is unchanged between BASE and HEAD for that field (confirmed by the maintainer's real-TUI A/B run). The value that does go stale on an in-process `/resume` is the global telemetry mirror: it kept the previous session's cached count next to the newly seeded prompt count (for example prompt 12000 from session B with cached 64653 from session A). Every other writer of the per-chat cached slot already clears that mirror, and this brings the resume seed in line. The only reader of the mirror today is the no-chat fallback in `/context`, which had no test for a nonzero global value either.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. `cd packages/core && npx vitest run src/core/llm-chat.test.ts`: 530/530 pass. The resume case records a usage report with `cachedContentTokenCount: 64_653`, calls `seedResumeTokenCounts` with non-finite and then finite inputs, and after each call expects the per-chat cached slot to be `0` and `uiTelemetryService.setLastCachedContentTokenCount` to have last been called with `0`. With the new telemetry line removed, this case fails (`expected last "spy" call to have been called with [ +0 ]`).
2. `cd packages/cli && npx vitest run src/ui/commands/contextCommand.test.ts`: 49/49 pass. The no-chat case expects the displayed cached figure to be the global `1_000` when the chat is not initialized (this pins existing behavior).
3. `cd packages/core && npm run typecheck` and `npx eslint src/core/llm-chat.ts src/core/llm-chat.test.ts`: both clean.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A for the TUI: `/context` output is the same on BASE and HEAD. The observable difference is the global telemetry mirror after an in-process resume: before, it holds the previous session's cached count; after, it reads `0` until the next API usage report.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ⚠️ |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ |
|  🐧 Linux  | ✅ |

### Environment (optional)

N/A (unit tests only).

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: after resume, the global cached mirror reads `0` until the next API usage report instead of a value from a different session. The per-chat slot behaves as before.
- Not validated / out of scope: restoring the cached figure on resume (the transcript records `cachedContentTokenCount`, but `ResumeTokenCounts` does not carry it); the daemon deferred-session path.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.

## Linked Issues

Follow-up to #12066. Relates to #12047.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

#12066 的后续。本 PR 是防御性清零加测试固定行为，不是用户可见的残留值修复。resume 恢复 prompt 与 output 计数时，同时清空进程级 telemetry 镜像中的缓存计数，并保留对 per-chat 缓存槽的防御性清零。测试在真实 usage 上报之后（分别用有限值和非有限值调用 seed）固定这两处清零；另有一条 `/context` 用例固定「尚无会话 chat 时回退到全局缓存计数」的行为。

## 为什么需要

#12066 的其它评审项已经在 `main` 上，本 PR 只包含剩余增量。`seedResumeTokenCounts` 总是在新建的 chat 上执行，此时 per-chat 缓存槽本来就是 `0`，所以这一清零只是不变式保护，BASE 与 HEAD 的 `/context` 输出在这一项上完全相同（维护者的真实 TUI A/B 测试已确认）。同一进程内 `/resume` 时真正残留旧值的是全局 telemetry 镜像：它把上一个会话的缓存数和新恢复的 prompt 数放在一起（例如会话 B 的 prompt 12000 配上会话 A 的 cached 64653）。其它写 per-chat 缓存槽的地方都会同时清空镜像，本 PR 让 resume 的 seed 保持一致。镜像目前唯一的读取方是 `/context` 的无 chat 回退路径，此前也没有针对全局值非零的测试。

## 审阅者测试计划

### 如何验证

1. `cd packages/core && npx vitest run src/core/llm-chat.test.ts`：530/530 通过。resume 用例先上报 `cachedContentTokenCount: 64_653`，再依次用非有限值和有限值调用 `seedResumeTokenCounts`，每次调用后都期望 per-chat 缓存槽为 `0`，且 `uiTelemetryService.setLastCachedContentTokenCount` 最后一次以 `0` 调用。删掉新增的 telemetry 那一行后，该用例失败（`expected last "spy" call to have been called with [ +0 ]`）。
2. `cd packages/cli && npx vitest run src/ui/commands/contextCommand.test.ts`：49/49 通过。无 chat 用例期望 chat 未初始化时显示全局值 `1_000`（固定已有行为）。
3. `cd packages/core && npm run typecheck` 以及 `npx eslint src/core/llm-chat.ts src/core/llm-chat.test.ts`：均无报错。

### 证据（修改前 / 修改后）

TUI 方面 N/A：BASE 与 HEAD 的 `/context` 输出相同。可观察的差异在同一进程内 resume 之后的全局 telemetry 镜像：修改前保留上一个会话的缓存数，修改后在下一次 API usage 上报前为 `0`。

### 测试平台

macOS ⚠️ 未测；Windows ⚠️ 未测；Linux ✅。

### 环境

N/A（仅单元测试）。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险：resume 之后，全局缓存镜像在下一次 API usage 上报前为 `0`，而不是另一个会话的值。per-chat 缓存槽行为不变。
- 未验证 / 范围外：resume 时恢复缓存数（transcript 记录了 `cachedContentTokenCount`，但 `ResumeTokenCounts` 不携带它）；daemon 延迟会话路径。
- 破坏性变更：无。

## 关联 Issue

#12066 的后续，关联 #12047。

</details>

prs.title: feat(web-shell): add the unified chat surface contract and capability guards
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Lands slice 1 of the merged unified-chat-surface design: the backend-neutral chat contract and its compile-time capability guards, with no behavior change and no UI wiring yet (the adapters arrive in slices 2 and 3). Concretely: the canonical serve capability registry moves verbatim from the CLI serve layer into the daemon SDK, so the feature-tag union has a single home that both the CLI and the web shell can depend on (the CLI re-exports every name it used to define, and its remaining logic is untouched); a new `chat-core` module in the web shell defines the session chat controller contract, the admission/outcome truth table as pure functions, bounded operation retention, and phase derivation; and two exhaustive capability maps (one keyed by the daemon feature-tag union, one by the managed capability record) turn an omitted capability decision into a compile error, pinned additionally by key-set fixture tests. The contract finalizes the state rules the design review deferred to this slice: superseded approvals have an explicit pending-item status, rejected requests carry no outcome and are not tracked as operations, unsettled operations survive refresh with bounded retention, the tri-state managed terminal capability hides the region unless explicitly true, and `cancelling` is derived from an unestablished cancel operation rather than from a resolved promise.

Design: [English](docs/design/2026-11-16-unified-chat-surface.md) | [简体中文](docs/design/2026-11-16-unified-chat-surface.zh-CN.md) (merged via #17460).

## Why it's needed

The design's slice 1 establishes the contract and its guards before any extraction, so slices 2–5 move chat columns against a pinned vocabulary instead of inventing one per adapter. The registry move resolves the deferred "shared home of the feature-tag union" question with the only dependency direction that lets both consumers be compile-time exhaustive: the union lives in the SDK, which the CLI and the web shell already depend on; a new registry tag now fails the daemon capability map at compile time. The truth-table functions make "admission is not establishment" executable: a transport-level acceptance alone can never produce an established outcome, and the negative tests pin that.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

No user-visible change; verify the contract, the guards, and that the registry move is behavior-preserving.

- `cd packages/web-shell && npx vitest run client/chat-core` — truth table (including the negative: accepted admission with no witness yields unsettled, never established), retention bounds, acknowledgement, phase derivation, map key-set fixtures, tri-state terminal decision.
- `cd packages/web-shell && npx tsc -p tsconfig.lib.json` — the CI type gate; the exhaustive `Record<ServeFeature, …>` and `Record<keyof ManagedAgentSessionSummary['capabilities'], …>` maps fail to compile if any tag/key lacks a decision.
- `cd packages/cli && npx vitest run src/serve/capability-parity.test.ts src/serve/capabilities-docs-contract.test.ts --coverage.enabled=false` — the registry's existing parity and docs-contract suites pass against the re-export (223 tests).
- `cd packages/cli && NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=8192 npx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json` and `cd packages/sdk-typescript && npx tsc --noEmit` — every CLI consumer of the moved names type-checks through the re-export.
- Characterization: the existing collocated suites already pin the four behaviors the design names (composer submit, approval answering, status display, draft restore) for all three chat columns — `client/App.test.tsx`, `client/components/ChatPane.test.tsx`, `client/components/managed/ManagedSessionsPage.test.tsx` — and were run green at this head. This slice verifies those pins rather than adding a duplicate DOM harness; the design's "add characterization tests" is satisfied by the existing coverage, which is why no new test file renders the columns.
- The registry data block is byte-identical to its pre-move content (mechanical extraction; the CLI file keeps its header, re-exports the moved names, and retains the remainder verbatim).

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — no user-visible change.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |  N/A   |
|  🐧 Linux  |  N/A   |

### Environment (optional)

Local Node 22; `corepack pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` + root `npm run build` before the checks above.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the registry move touches a core CLI module; mitigated by the byte-identical data block, the full re-export surface, CLI typecheck plus the 223 parity/docs-contract tests, and the SDK typecheck. `chat-core` uses type-only imports exclusively (no daemon value imports) and is not yet part of any bundle entry, so no shipped bundle changes.
- Not validated / out of scope: adapters, ChatSurface extraction, and the DOM parity work are slices 2–5; the capability map decisions are conservative and are refined against real backend behavior in those slices. The design's open questions (managed content search, goal facts) remain open.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. The CLI re-exports every moved name; the SDK addition is additive.

## Linked Issues

Implements slice 1 of the design merged in #17460.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

落地已合入的统一聊天面设计的切片 1：后端无关的聊天契约及其编译期能力守卫，无行为变化、尚无 UI 接线（适配器在切片 2/3）。具体：规范 serve 能力注册表从 CLI serve 层逐字移入 daemon SDK，使特性标签联合拥有 CLI 与 web shell 都能依赖的唯一归属（CLI 重导出其原先定义的全部名字，其余逻辑不动）；web shell 新增 `chat-core` 模块，定义会话聊天控制器契约、受理/结果真值表纯函数、有界操作保留与 phase 派生；两张穷举能力映射（一张以 daemon 特性标签联合为键，一张以 managed 能力记录为键）使遗漏的能力决策成为编译错误，并另以键集夹具测试钉住。契约定稿了设计评审延后到本切片的状态规则：被取代审批有显式待决项状态；被拒绝请求不携带结果、不进 operations；未结算操作跨刷新保留且保留有界；三态 managed terminal 能力非显式 true 即隐藏区域；`cancelling` 由未确立的取消操作派生，而非由 Promise resolve 派生。

设计：[English](docs/design/2026-11-16-unified-chat-surface.md) | [简体中文](docs/design/2026-11-16-unified-chat-surface.zh-CN.md)（经 #17460 合入）。

## 为什么需要

切片 1 在任何抽取之前确立契约与守卫，使切片 2–5 对着钉死的语汇迁移聊天列，而不是每个适配器各造一套。注册表移动以唯一能让两个消费方都编译期穷举的依赖方向解决了延后的「特性标签联合共享归属」问题：联合放在 SDK，CLI 与 web shell 都已依赖它；新增注册表标签现在会在 daemon 能力映射处编译失败。真值表函数使「受理不等于确立」可执行：仅传输层受理绝不产生已确立结果，负例测试钉住这一点。

## 评审验证计划

### 如何验证

无用户可见变化；验证契约、守卫，以及注册表移动保持行为。

- `cd packages/web-shell && npx vitest run client/chat-core` —— 真值表（含负例：accepted 受理无见证产出 unsettled，绝不 established）、保留边界、确认、phase 派生、映射键集夹具、三态 terminal 决策。
- `cd packages/web-shell && npx tsc -p tsconfig.lib.json` —— CI 类型门禁；穷举 `Record<ServeFeature, …>` 与 `Record<keyof ManagedAgentSessionSummary['capabilities'], …>` 在任何标签/键缺决策时编译失败。
- `cd packages/cli && npx vitest run src/serve/capability-parity.test.ts src/serve/capabilities-docs-contract.test.ts --coverage.enabled=false` —— 注册表既有 parity 与 docs-contract 套件对重导出通过（223 用例）。
- `cd packages/cli && NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=8192 npx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json` 与 `cd packages/sdk-typescript && npx tsc --noEmit` —— 移动名字的全部 CLI 消费方经重导出通过类型检查。
- 特征钉桩：既有并置套件已钉住设计点名的四类行为（输入框提交、审批应答、状态展示、草稿恢复）覆盖三个聊天列——`client/App.test.tsx`、`client/components/ChatPane.test.tsx`、`client/components/managed/ManagedSessionsPage.test.tsx`——并在本 head 跑绿。本切片验证这些钉桩而非新增重复 DOM harness；设计的「新增特征测试」由既有覆盖满足，因此没有新测试文件渲染聊天列。
- 注册表数据块与移动前逐字节一致（机械抽取；CLI 文件保留头、重导出移动名字、余段逐字保留）。

### 证据（Before & After）

N/A——无用户可见变化。

### 测试平台

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :--: |
|  🍏 macOS  |  ✅  |
| 🪟 Windows | N/A  |
|  🐧 Linux  | N/A  |

### 环境（可选）

本地 Node 22；上述检查前先 `corepack pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` + 根 `npm run build`。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或权衡：注册表移动触碰 CLI 核心模块；以逐字节一致的数据块、完整重导出面、CLI 类型检查加 223 个 parity/docs-contract 测试、SDK 类型检查缓解。`chat-core` 全部为 type-only 导入（无 daemon 值导入），且尚不在任何 bundle 入口中，故无产物变化。
- 未验证 / 范围外：适配器、ChatSurface 抽取、DOM 一致性工作是切片 2–5；能力映射决策是保守的，在那些切片中对照真实后端行为精化。设计未决问题（managed 内容搜索、目标事实）仍未决。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：无。CLI 重导出全部移动名字；SDK 新增是加法的。

## 关联 Issue

实现 #17460 合入设计的切片 1。

</details>

prs.title: fix(deps): patch express-rate-limit window accounting
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Pins express-rate-limit 8.x to the compatible 8.7.2 security patch in both supported workspace installers and the independently installed Mobile MCP and CUA agent examples. Updates all three lockfiles and regenerates the IDE dependency notices. MCP SDK stays at 1.32.2; no application code or rate-limit configuration changes.

## Why it's needed

A November 17 consumer scan reports `@qwen-code/sdk@0.1.34 → @modelcontextprotocol/sdk@1.32.2 → express-rate-limit@8.7.0`. [CVE-2026-126204 / GHSA-j3cq-92fq-qg5f](https://github.com/express-rate-limit/express-rate-limit/security/advisories/GHSA-j3cq-92fq-qg5f) affects versions through 8.7.1 and is fixed in 8.7.2. The current workspace lock instead contains 8.5.2, and the two independent locks contain 8.6.2/8.6.0; all are covered by the advisory. MCP's declared `^8.2.1` already permits this patch, so upgrading MCP itself is unnecessary.

The race requires the default MemoryStore plus `skipFailedRequests` or `skipSuccessfulRequests`: an older in-flight request can incorrectly free a slot in a newer window. The maintainer rates it low; the consumer Snyk report rates it medium. No owned production source was found enabling those options or importing MCP's OAuth rate-limit handlers, so this PR does not claim a demonstrated Qwen endpoint exploit.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Confirm that workspace and independent clean installs resolve express-rate-limit 8.7.2 through their actual MCP parent, without upgrading MCP or unrelated dependencies. With the real default MemoryStore and either skip option enabled, hold a request across a window boundary, fill the next window, then finish the held request: a further request must still receive 429. Ordinary MCP transport, OAuth and tool exchanges should continue to work.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A for UI. Independent Node 22.23.2/24.19.0 loopback reproductions show 8.7.0 and 8.7.1 admitting the extra request, while 8.7.2 returns 429. Both skip options and the unaffected default-option control were checked, including a real 400ms window without replacing the clock. Fresh independent Mobile/CUA installs resolve 8.7.2 from their actual MCP parents and pass the same regression. Validation commands and final workspace acceptance are recorded in the separate test report comment.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :--- | :--- |
| macOS | Local reproduction, independent installs and regression verification |
| Windows | Not tested locally; CI pending |
| Linux | Not tested locally; CI pending |

## Risk & Scope

- The change stays within the existing 8.x dependency contract; the workspace patch also brings the release's debug dependency using the existing resolved debug version.
- Root overrides are not inherited by published-package consumers. Existing business lockfiles must be refreshed or overridden at their own root, and published SDK bundles require a rebuild/release. This PR does not rewrite the already published SDK 0.1.34.
- No npm publication, business deployment, original Snyk rescan or full audit-zero claim. Independent install audits still report unrelated findings. No change to rate-limit options, timeouts or security gates.

## Linked Issues

Related to #17099 and #16434. This new scan finding does not close their delivery/rescan tracking.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

将 express-rate-limit 8.x 定向固定到兼容修复版 8.7.2，覆盖工作区 npm/pnpm 以及独立安装的 Mobile MCP、CUA agent 示例，更新三份锁文件并重新生成 IDE 依赖许可证清单。MCP SDK 保持 1.32.2，不改应用代码或限流配置。

11 月 17 日业务扫描命中 `sdk@0.1.34 → MCP@1.32.2 → express-rate-limit@8.7.0`。上述公告影响至 8.7.1，修复版为 8.7.2。当前工作区锁为 8.5.2，两个独立锁分别为 8.6.2/8.6.0，也在公告范围内。MCP 已声明 `^8.2.1`，无需升级 MCP 本身。

漏洞要求默认 MemoryStore 与 skipFailedRequests 或 skipSuccessfulRequests 同时使用，旧窗口中的请求结束后可能错误释放新窗口额度。维护者评级低危、业务 Snyk 评级中危。自有生产源码未发现启用这些选项或导入 MCP OAuth 限流 handler，因此不声称已证实 Qwen 端点可被利用。

评审应核对工作区及独立干净安装的实际 MCP 父链都解析到 8.7.2，MCP 与其他依赖不变。使用真实默认 MemoryStore，令旧请求跨窗口悬挂，新窗口额度用尽后结束旧请求，再发请求应返回 429；普通 MCP 传输、OAuth、工具调用应继续正常。

无 UI 改动。独立 Node 22.23.2/24.19.0 本机 HTTP 对照确认 8.7.0/8.7.1 错误放行，8.7.2 返回 429；两种 skip 选项及默认选项对照均已检查，并包含不替换时钟的真实 400ms 窗口。Mobile/CUA 实际独立安装父链也通过相同回归。完整工作区验收与命令见单独测试报告评论。本机仅验证 macOS，Windows/Linux 待 CI，未冒充本机验证。

升级保持 8.x 契约，工作区新增的 debug 依赖复用既有版本。上游根 overrides 不会被发布包消费者继承：业务须自行刷新锁或在业务根覆盖，SDK 内嵌代码还需重建发布；本 PR 不会改写已发布的 0.1.34。未执行 npm 发布、业务部署或原 Snyk 复扫，不宣称全仓审计清零，独立安装仍有其他审计项。不修改限流选项、超时或安全门禁。

关联 #17099、#16434，不自动关闭发布与复扫跟踪。

</details>

prs.title: fix(core): deliver background async hook output to the model
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Fixes the capability ledger's L11 defect: background (async) hook output now reaches the model. Async hooks run between turns and their completed output (additional context and notification messages) accumulates in the async registry, but `HookSystem.getPendingAsyncOutput()` — the get-and-clear drain meant "for delivery to the next turn" — had no caller, so the output was collected and silently dropped. This drains it when the outgoing request is assembled and appends it as a reserved-tag context part, before the send and its in-chat auto-compaction. Adds a self-contained `hooks/async-hook-context.ts` helper, unit tests with mutation witnesses, and a bilingual design doc.

## Why it's needed

The ledger maps L11 ("Async hook output reaches the model") as `missing`: main collects async hook output but nothing reads it before a request, while the 1.0 loop drains the equivalent pending context in its request preparation and injects it before compression. #17284 carries L11 explicitly as a defect. A user whose background hook produces `additionalContext` or a `systemMessage` today gets nothing delivered to the model; this closes that gap.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Run `cd packages/core && npx vitest run src/hooks/async-hook-context.test.ts src/core/prompt-context-order.test.ts` — 21 + 9 tests pass. The helper tests drive a real `AsyncHookRegistry` (delivery, get-and-clear drain-once, blank output yields no part, closing-tag forgery escaped, envelope matcher); the prompt-context-order tests pin the wire reorder hoisting the async block ahead of the user's instruction. `client.test.ts` adds six call-site tests under "async hook output delivery (L11)" driving the real `sendMessageStream`: delivery, drain-once, nothing-pending, a co-occurrence UserQuery turn (sync receipt stays the last part, async immediately before it), a ToolResult turn (block appended after the unchanged `functionResponse` parts), and the in-memory-only boundary (the persisted user record carries no async block while the wire request does). `sessionTitle.test.ts` adds two cases pinning that the fallback title input excludes the async envelope (trailing and co-occurrence). Mutation witnesses (mutate → run → restore byte-identical) each kill exactly their target: drain-delivers-nothing, escape-removal, blank-guard-removal, splice-collapse, call-site-delete, wire-matcher-drop, `syncReceiptTrailing=false`, ToolResult-drain-skip, title-filter-drop, and drain-into-recorded-request. The wiring is a single call site at the `requestToSend` assembly in `LlmClient.sendMessageStream`, after the UserPromptSubmit receipt and before the IDE-context merge; the envelope is also registered with the wire-order classifier so the user's instruction stays last on the wire. A real-environment run (headless CLI against a mock OpenAI server with an `async: true` PostToolUse hook) confirmed the block reaches the outgoing provider request body.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A (no UI change; the delivered context is model-facing).

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |  N/A   |
|  🐧 Linux  |  N/A   |

### Environment (optional)

Unit tests only (vitest, real `AsyncHookRegistry`); CI covers all three platforms.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the drain runs at the request assembly of every send; it is get-and-clear (delivered once), placed immediately before the send to minimize the consume-but-not-sent window on a failed send, consistent with the existing `getPendingAsyncOutput` contract.
- Not validated / out of scope: (1) the ACP default legacy round, which sends through the session's own chat rather than `LlmClient` and so does not drain yet — the ledger row therefore moves to `differs`, not `have`, and that surface's delivery is carried in #17284; (2) display projection and resume provenance for the async tag (the synchronous UserPromptSubmit context hides itself from the transcript projection and re-stamps on resume; the async block is delivered as a tagged part but not yet wired into `projectUserTranscriptForDisplay`). These are separate concerns from "the output reaches the model" and are documented as follow-ups in the design doc.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none; a previously-dropped output is now delivered.

Design doc: [English](docs/design/2026-11-16-async-hook-output-delivery.md) | [简体中文](docs/design/2026-11-16-async-hook-output-delivery.zh-CN.md)

## Linked Issues

References #17284 (carries L11 as a defect) and the [agent loop capability ledger](docs/design/2026-11-15-loop-capability-ledger.md) row L11.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

修复能力台账 L11 缺陷：后台（异步）hook 输出现在送达模型。异步 hook 在轮次之间运行，其完成输出（additional context 与通知消息）累积在异步 registry，但 `HookSystem.getPendingAsyncOutput()`——意为「交付给下一轮」的取走即清空 drain——没有任何调用方，输出被收集后静默丢弃。本 PR 在组装外出请求时 drain 它，并作为保留标签上下文 part 追加，位于 send 及其 chat 内自动压缩之前。新增自包含 `hooks/async-hook-context.ts` helper、带变异见证的单测、双语设计文档。

## 为什么需要

台账把 L11（「异步 hook 输出送达模型」）标为 `missing`：main 收集异步 hook 输出但请求前无人读取，而 1.0 loop 在请求准备中 drain 等价待交付上下文并在压缩前注入。#17284 明确把 L11 作为缺陷承载。今天后台 hook 产出 `additionalContext` 或 `systemMessage` 的用户得不到任何交付；本 PR 关闭该缺口。

## 评审验证计划

### 如何验证

跑 `cd packages/core && npx vitest run src/hooks/async-hook-context.test.ts src/core/prompt-context-order.test.ts`——21 + 9 条通过。helper 测试驱动真实 `AsyncHookRegistry`（交付、取走即清空只 drain 一次、空白输出不产生 part、闭合标签伪造被转义、信封 matcher）；prompt-context-order 测试钉住线上重排把异步块前移到用户指令之前。`client.test.ts` 在「async hook output delivery (L11)」下新增六条调用点测试，驱动真实 `sendMessageStream`：交付、只 drain 一次、无待交付、共现 UserQuery 轮（同步回执仍是末位 part、异步紧随其前）、ToolResult 轮（块追加在原样的 `functionResponse` parts 之后）、以及仅进程内边界（持久化用户记录不含异步块而线上请求含之）。`sessionTitle.test.ts` 新增两条用例钉住回退标题输入排除异步信封（尾随与共现）。变异见证（改→跑→按字节还原）各恰杀其目标：drain 不交付、去转义、去空白守卫、splice 塌缩、删调用点、去 wire matcher、`syncReceiptTrailing=false`、ToolResult 跳过 drain、去标题过滤、drain 入被记录 request。接线是 `LlmClient.sendMessageStream` 中 `requestToSend` 组装处的单一调用点，在 UserPromptSubmit 回执之后、IDE 上下文合并之前；信封也登记到线上顺序分类器，使用户指令在线上保持末位。一次真实环境运行（headless CLI 指向 mock OpenAI server、配置 `async: true` 的 PostToolUse hook）确认该块到达外出的 provider 请求体。

### 证据（Before & After）

N/A（无 UI 改动；交付的上下文面向模型）。

### 测试平台

macOS ✅；Windows N/A；Linux N/A（CI 覆盖三平台）。

### 环境（可选）

仅单元测试（vitest，真实 `AsyncHookRegistry`）。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或权衡：drain 在每次 send 的请求组装处运行；取走即清空（交付一次），紧贴 send 之前以最小化失败 send 下「已消费未送达」窗口，与既有 `getPendingAsyncOutput` 契约一致。
- 未验证 / 范围外：(1) ACP 默认 legacy 轮次——它经会话自有 chat 而非 `LlmClient` 发送，故尚未 drain；台账该行因此移到 `differs` 而非 `have`，该入口的交付由 #17284 承载；(2) 异步标签的显示投影与 resume 溯源（同步 UserPromptSubmit 上下文会从转录投影隐藏并在 resume 重新盖章；异步块作为带标签 part 交付但尚未接入 `projectUserTranscriptForDisplay`）。这些是与「输出送达模型」不同的关注点，设计文档中记为 follow-up。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：无；此前被丢弃的输出现在交付。

设计文档：[English](docs/design/2026-11-16-async-hook-output-delivery.md) | [简体中文](docs/design/2026-11-16-async-hook-output-delivery.zh-CN.md)

## 关联 Issue

引用 #17284（把 L11 作为缺陷承载）与 [agent loop 能力台账](docs/design/2026-11-15-loop-capability-ledger.md) L11 行。

</details>

prs.title: feat(web-shell): show the session artifact count at click time from list metadata
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Session summaries now carry an artifact count. Live sessions report the count from the in-memory artifact store; cold sessions report the restorable count from a small per-session summary file that sits next to the transcript, refreshed whenever the artifact persistence path records a durable change and seeded from the journal on load. Clicking a session in the sidebar passes that count into the session switch, so the header artifact entry introduced by #17397 shows it immediately — before the load response arrives. The load-embedded artifact snapshot and the gated artifact fetch supersede the click-time count as soon as they land, and the count is keyed to the session so an optimistic switch cannot leak it across sessions. The session list enriches every workspace listing path (default, organized, metadata-filtered, and search) from the same summary file, following the existing precedent of the PR-binding and worktree sidecars.

## Why it's needed

#17397 made the session-level artifact entry paint at load-response time (~450 ms on the measured cold session), ahead of the conversation body. The count was still unknown at click time: the session list carried no artifact information, so between the click and the load response the header showed nothing about the session's artifacts. The list already carries derived per-session data (PR bindings, worktree state) hydrated best-effort from sidecar files; an artifact summary in the same metadata lets the entry show the count the instant a session is clicked. Measured against a real local daemon with headless Chromium: the entry now paints ~120 ms after the click, ~380 ms before the load response, with the correct count; clicking it opens the artifact panel populated once the load lands.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Cold-open a session that has published artifacts and watch the header: the artifact entry should appear immediately after the click, before the conversation body and before the load response, showing the count the session list reported. After the load settles the count must equal the restored artifact list. A session whose summary file holds a stale count shows that stale count at click time and is corrected by the authoritative load. A session with no summary file (older daemon, or never opened since the upgrade) behaves exactly as #17397: the entry appears at load-response time. A session without artifacts shows no entry at any point. Switching quickly from a session with artifacts to one without must never show the first session's count under the second.

Focused suites (run from the repository root; Node >= 22):

```bash
cd packages/core && npx vitest run src/services/session-artifact-summary-sidecar.test.ts src/services/sessionService.artifact-summary-sidecar.test.ts src/services/chatRecordingService.artifact-summary-sidecar.test.ts src/services/session-artifact-persistence.test.ts src/services/sessionService.test.ts
cd packages/acp-bridge && npx vitest run src/sessionArtifacts.test.ts src/bridge.test.ts
cd packages/cli && npx vitest run src/serve/server/session-list.test.ts
cd packages/web-shell && npx vitest run client/hooks/useSessionArtifacts.test.tsx client/daemon/session/actions.test.ts client/daemon/session/DaemonSessionProvider.test.tsx client/App.test.tsx
```

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before (current main, same rig): the header artifact entry paints only after the load response — measured click+516 ms entry vs click+490 ms load on a cold session with no summary file (this fallback is preserved by the PR). After: entry click+119 ms vs load click+501 ms (entry ~380 ms before load), count 3, panel populated on click. Stale-count arm: summary hand-edited to 99 → entry shows 99 at click+138 ms, corrected to 3 after the load (click+986 ms), and the load rewrote the summary file back to 3 on disk. 19/19 mutation witnesses killed across the load-bearing guards (session keying, hint retirement, live-merge drop, fork strip, event-payload count, write-after-append order, cap boundary, search enrichment, partial-read guard, click-time threading, unarchive conflict, zero-count self-heal, skip-if-equal warm load, conditional count forwarding in both directions), every restore byte-verified. Full design and E2E record: `docs/design/2026-11-17-session-list-artifact-summary.md` and the worktree test plan.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### Environment (optional)

Worktree daemon (`node scripts/dev.js serve`) with a scratch `QWEN_HOME` and a fake OpenAI-compatible peer; headless Chromium (Playwright) against the served Web Shell; Node 24. Unit suites run from each package directory.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the summary file is a best-effort derived cache — the journal stays authoritative. A failed write can leave a stale count, which the next load heals (including healing an existing positive count to zero when the restorable set becomes empty); an equal count skips the write so a warm load adds no disk write. The live count includes ephemeral artifacts while the cold count is the restorable set, so the count can drop when a session goes cold — documented and intended.
- Not validated / out of scope: standalone (Conversations) catalog rows keep today's behavior (separate summary type and catalog path); no session-row badge (the count surfaces in the chat header at click time); macOS/Windows not tested locally.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. The summary field is optional on both wire mirrors; older daemons omit it and older clients ignore it. Legacy sessions gain the count on their first open after the upgrade (load-time seed).

Design document: [English](docs/design/2026-11-17-session-list-artifact-summary.md) · [简体中文](docs/design/2026-11-17-session-list-artifact-summary.zh-CN.md)

## Linked Issues

Follow-up to #17397 (scope B of its design document).

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

会话摘要现在携带产物数量。live 会话从内存产物 store 报告数量；冷会话从 transcript 旁的小型每会话摘要文件报告可恢复数量——该文件在产物持久化路径记录 durable 变更时刷新，并在 load 时从 journal 播种。点击侧栏会话时，该数量被传入会话切换，因此 #17397 引入的头部产物入口立即显示它——早于 load 响应到达。load 内嵌的产物快照与门控产物拉取一旦落地就取代点击时刻的数量；数量按会话键控，乐观切换不会把它泄漏到别的会话。会话列表在所有工作区列表路径（默认、organized、metadata 过滤、搜索）上从同一摘要文件增强，沿用 PR 绑定与 worktree sidecar 的既有先例。

## 为什么需要

#17397 让会话级产物入口在 load 响应时刻（实测冷会话约 450 ms）先于对话正文渲染。但点击时刻仍拿不到数量：会话列表不携带任何产物信息，从点击到 load 响应之间头部对该会话的产物一无所知。列表已经携带派生的每会话数据（PR 绑定、worktree 状态），从 sidecar 文件尽力回填；把产物摘要放进同一份元数据，就能在点击会话的瞬间显示数量。对真实本地 daemon + 无头 Chromium 实测：入口现在在点击后约 120 ms 渲染，比 load 响应早约 380 ms，数量正确；点击入口在 load 落地后打开已填充的产物面板。

## 评审测试计划

### 如何验证

冷打开一个有已发布产物的会话并观察头部：产物入口应在点击后立即出现，早于对话正文与 load 响应，显示会话列表报告的数量。load 落定后数量必须等于已恢复的产物列表。摘要文件持有陈旧数量的会话在点击时显示该陈旧数量，并被权威 load 纠正。没有摘要文件的会话（旧 daemon，或升级后从未打开）行为与 #17397 完全一致：入口在 load 响应时刻出现。无产物会话在任何时刻都不显示入口。从有产物会话快速切到无产物会话，绝不能把前者的数量显示到后者名下。

聚焦套件（从仓库根运行；Node >= 22）：见英文正文命令。

### 证据（改动前后）

改动前（当前 main，同一 rig）：头部产物入口仅在 load 响应后渲染——实测无摘要文件冷会话 click+516 ms 入口 vs click+490 ms load（本 PR 保留该回退）。改动后：入口 click+119 ms vs load click+501 ms（入口早于 load 约 380 ms），数量 3，点击后面板已填充。陈旧数量臂：摘要手改为 99 → 入口在 click+138 ms 显示 99，load（click+986 ms）后纠正为 3，且 load 把摘要文件重写回 3（磁盘核实）。19/19 变异见证击杀，覆盖承重守卫（会话键控、hint 退役、live 合并丢弃、fork 剥离、event payload 计数、先 append 后写顺序、上限边界、搜索增强、部分读守卫、点击接线、unarchive 冲突、零计数自愈、等值跳过暖 load、计数转发条件双向），每次还原字节级校验。完整设计与 E2E 记录见设计文档与 worktree 测试计划。

### 测试平台

Linux ✅（本机实测）；macOS / Windows ⚠️ 未本地测试。

### 环境

worktree daemon（`node scripts/dev.js serve`）+ scratch `QWEN_HOME` + 假 OpenAI 兼容 peer；无头 Chromium（Playwright）访问所伺服的 Web Shell；Node 24。单测从各包目录运行。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险/取舍：摘要文件是尽力而为的派生缓存——journal 仍是权威。写失败可能留下陈旧计数，下一次 load 会治愈（包括可恢复集变空时把已有正数治愈为零）；数量相等时跳过写入，暖 load 不新增写盘。live 计数含 ephemeral 产物而冷计数是可恢复集，因此会话变冷时数量可能下降——已文档化且属预期。
- 未验证/范围外：standalone（Conversations）目录行保持现状（独立摘要类型与目录路径）；不做会话行徽章（数量在点击时刻显示于聊天头部）；macOS/Windows 未本地测试。
- 破坏性变更/迁移：无。摘要字段在两个 wire 镜像上均为可选；旧 daemon 省略、旧客户端忽略。legacy 会话在升级后首次打开时获得数量（load 播种）。

#17397 的后续（其设计文档的范围 B）。

</details>

prs.title: fix(cli): warn on stderr when non-TTY stdin times out in prompt mode
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds an opt-in timeout warning to non-TTY standard input reading in non-interactive prompt mode so `Warning: no stdin input received within 500ms; proceeding without stdin.` is written to stderr when a prompt is supplied, piped input has not arrived before the 500 ms read timeout expires, and execution continues without stdin. Keeps interactive startups, empty-prompt runs, default stdin calls, and sandbox host relaunches quiet (so sandboxed runs emit the warning at most once from the child process), guards stderr warning writes against synchronous and asynchronous `EPIPE` errors, and documents the warning behavior in the headless CLI guide.

## Why it's needed

When running non-interactively with `-p` under Git Bash / mintty or slow pipelines where standard input is not a TTY and no bytes arrive within 500 ms, standard input reading resolves to an empty string silently, making slow upstream pipes or mintty handle propagation look like standard input was ignored rather than dropped on timeout. Emitting a clear warning on stderr in that exact path explains why stdin was omitted without changing interactive behavior or crashing on broken stderr pipes.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Run the CLI unit tests covering `readStdin` timeout/EPIPE handling and `llm.tsx` non-interactive and sandbox relaunch paths: `pnpm --filter @qwen-code/qwen-code exec vitest run src/utils/readStdin.test.ts src/llm.test.tsx`.
2. Typecheck and lint the modified files: `npx tsc --noEmit -p packages/cli/tsconfig.json && npx eslint --max-warnings 0 packages/cli/src/utils/readStdin.ts packages/cli/src/utils/readStdin.test.ts packages/cli/src/llm.tsx packages/cli/src/llm.test.tsx`.
3. Optional slow-pipe check in non-interactive mode: `{ sleep 1; echo "extra context"; } | qwen -p "hello"` should emit `Warning: no stdin input received within 500ms; proceeding without stdin.` once on stderr after ~500 ms and proceed with the `-p` prompt.

### Evidence (Before & After)

- Before: Running with a slow or non-TTY empty stdin in `-p` mode silently dropped stdin after 500 ms without any diagnostic on stderr, and warning writes had no broken-pipe guard.
- After: Non-interactive prompt mode writes `Warning: no stdin input received within 500ms; proceeding without stdin.` to stderr once on timeout (including when relaunched into a sandbox), ignores closed/broken stderr pipes (`EPIPE`), and stays silent in default/interactive/empty-prompt paths.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ✅ tested |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested |
|  🐧 Linux  | ⚠️ not tested |

### Environment (optional)

Local vitest unit test suite, `tsc --noEmit`, and `eslint --max-warnings 0` on macOS.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: Any caller piping slow input (> 500 ms to first byte) into `-p` will now see the 1-line stderr warning; stdout output and exit codes remain unchanged, and broken stderr pipes (`EPIPE`) are handled without crashing.
- Not validated / out of scope: Live Git Bash / mintty execution on Windows and Linux runners beyond CI.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: None; `warnOnTimeout` defaults to `false`.

## Linked Issues

Refs #15907

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 的改动内容

为非交互式提示词（`-p`）模式下非 TTY 标准输入读取增加可选的超时告警：当用户传入了提示词、stdin 不是 TTY 且在 500 毫秒读取超时内未收到任何输入时，向 stderr 输出 `Warning: no stdin input received within 500ms; proceeding without stdin.` 并继续执行。交互式启动、空提示词运行、默认读取调用以及沙箱宿主重拉阶段均保持静默（从而确保沙箱模式下仅由子进程输出一次告警），对 stderr 告警写入增加同步与异步 `EPIPE` 断管防护，并在无头模式文档中补充说明该行为。

## 为什么需要此改动

在 Git Bash / mintty 等非 TTY 终端环境或上游管道较慢的情况下使用 `-p` 运行 CLI 时，若 500 毫秒内没有任何字节到达，stdin 读取此前会静默返回空字符串并直接继续执行，容易让人误以为标准输入被忽略而非读取超时。仅在此路径向 stderr 打印明确告警，可帮助排查原因，同时不影响交互模式或因 stderr 管道关闭而崩溃。

## 评审测试计划

### 验证步骤

1. 运行涵盖 `readStdin` 超时/`EPIPE` 处理以及 `llm.tsx` 非交互与沙箱重拉路径的单元测试：`pnpm --filter @qwen-code/qwen-code exec vitest run src/utils/readStdin.test.ts src/llm.test.tsx`。
2. 对修改文件执行类型检查与 lint：`npx tsc --noEmit -p packages/cli/tsconfig.json && npx eslint --max-warnings 0 packages/cli/src/utils/readStdin.ts packages/cli/src/utils/readStdin.test.ts packages/cli/src/llm.tsx packages/cli/src/llm.test.tsx`。
3. 可选慢速管道验证：`{ sleep 1; echo "extra context"; } | qwen -p "hello"` 应在约 500 毫秒后向 stderr 输出一次 `Warning: no stdin input received within 500ms; proceeding without stdin.` 并继续执行 `-p` 提示词。

### 对比证据（修改前后）

- 修改前：在 `-p` 模式下遇到慢速管道或非 TTY 空 stdin 时，500 毫秒后会静默丢弃 stdin 且无任何 stderr 提示，且告警写入缺少断管保护。
- 修改后：非交互提示词模式在超时时向 stderr 输出一次 `Warning: no stdin input received within 500ms; proceeding without stdin.`（沙箱重拉场景同样只由子进程输出一次），在 stderr 出现 `EPIPE` 时安全忽略，默认/交互/空提示词路径保持静默。

### 已测试平台

|     操作系统     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ✅ 已测试 |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ 未测试 |
|  🐧 Linux  | ⚠️ 未测试 |

### 运行环境（可选）

macOS 本地 vitest 单元测试、`tsc --noEmit` 与 `eslint --max-warnings 0`。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或权衡：首字节到达超过 500 毫秒的慢速管道在 `-p` 模式下会多出一条 stderr 告警；stdout 输出与退出码不变，stderr `EPIPE` 不会导致进程崩溃。
- 未验证 / 超出范围：Windows Git Bash / mintty 与 Linux 环境的实机运行依赖 CI 覆盖。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：无；`warnOnTimeout` 默认值为 `false`。

## 关联 Issue

Refs #15907

</details>

prs.title: feat: add qwen4-max support with native effort ladder, cache TTL, and image detail
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds first-class support for the new flagship qwen4-max model across all four channels — ModelStudio Standard (pay-as-you-go), Token Plan, QwenCloud Standard, and Qwen Subscription — following the model's published API changes. The model now appears in each channel's model list with its native three-tier reasoning ladder (low / high / xhigh) and the new default of high, and thinking can still be turned off. The automatic output budget is sized for the model's new combined thinking-plus-answer token cap instead of the legacy answer-only budget, and is clamped to the smaller non-thinking cap whenever thinking is disabled. Image and video input are accepted, the existing cache-retention setting now also drives the model's explicit cache TTL (5-minute default, optional 1-hour tier), and a new generation setting controls the image understanding detail level so users can trade resolution for tokens. The subscription channel maps the selected effort onto the model's new thinking-budget ladder. A bilingual design document records the decisions, and the user-facing provider documentation describes the new behavior.

## Why it's needed

qwen4-max changes several API-level contracts versus the previous flagship: the middle effort tier and the default changed, the output token cap now includes thinking, image understanding defaults to full resolution, and explicit caching gained a selectable TTL. Without this change the model inherits the previous flagship's ladder and default, its thinking can consume the entire answer budget, media input is treated as unsupported, and the new cache and image controls are unreachable.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- Unit tests cover the new ladder and default per channel, the thinking and non-thinking output budgets, the subscription budget mapping, the cache TTL stamping, and the image detail injection. Run them with vitest from the core and cli package directories (the changed test files are collocated with their sources).
- With a ModelStudio key that serves qwen4-max, select the model and confirm: the effort picker offers low / high / xhigh defaulting to high; turning thinking off ships the disable shape with an output budget within the non-thinking cap; attaching an image reaches the wire as an image part; setting cache retention to the extended tier adds the 1-hour TTL to cache breakpoints while the default omits it; setting image detail to low stamps the low-detail field on image parts.
- Confirm the previous flagship keeps its ladder, its default, and its subscription budget table unchanged.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — no TUI layout change; behavior is verified through wire-body unit tests (1307 core tests across the touched files, plus the cli model-configuration and effort-command suites, all green after rebasing onto current main). Real-model end-to-end runs were not performed because no serving key was available in this environment; an E2E plan covering the four channels is prepared and pending a key.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### Environment (optional)

Unit tests and typecheck only (Node 26, macOS).

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the output-budget exemption lets qwen4 requests carry a much larger output budget than before; the context-window clamp and the non-thinking clamp bound it, but third-party gateways serving qwen4 aliases may enforce different caps.
- Not validated / out of scope: real-model E2E (pending a serving key); CoT summary display and programmatic tool calling are deferred; the subscription default model is not switched (product decision). The cache TTL gate applies to the whole qwen4 prefix, matching the vendor's "Qwen4 series" explicit-cache documentation.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: existing `qwen4*` custom routes (e.g. `qwen4-plus`) now take the qwen4 generation contract — effort ladder `low/high/xhigh` (default `high`) and the thinking-sized 262,144 output budget — instead of the inherited qwen3.8-max ladder and 32K output fallback; `qwen3.8-max` and the invitation-only latest-series previews keep their shipped behavior.

Design document: [English](docs/design/2026-11-16-qwen4-max-integration.md) | [中文](docs/design/2026-11-16-qwen4-max-integration.zh-CN.md)

## Linked Issues

None.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

按照 qwen4-max 已公布的 API 变更，在四个通道——ModelStudio Standard（按量付费）、Token Plan、QwenCloud Standard、Qwen 订阅——为新旗舰 qwen4-max 提供一等支持。模型现在出现在各通道的模型列表中，带原生三档推理档位（low / high / xhigh）与新的默认档 high，且仍可关闭思考。自动输出预算按该模型新的「思考+回复」合并 token 上限 sizing，而非旧的答案-only 预算；思考禁用时夹到更小的非思考上限。接受图像与视频输入；现有缓存保留设置现在同时驱动该模型的显式缓存 TTL（默认 5 分钟，可选 1 小时档）；新增一个生成设置控制图像理解精细度，让用户以分辨率换 token。订阅通道把所选档位映射到该模型新的思考预算档位。双语设计文档记录了各项决策，用户侧 provider 文档描述了新行为。

## 为什么需要

qwen4-max 相对上一代旗舰改变了多项 API 级契约：中间档位与默认值变了、输出 token 上限现在包含思考、图像理解默认全分辨率、显式缓存新增可选 TTL。不做此变更，模型会继承上一代的档位与默认值，思考可能吃光整个回复预算，媒体输入被当作不支持，新的缓存与图像控制也无法触达。

## 评审验证计划

### 如何验证

- 单测覆盖各通道的新档位与默认值、思考/非思考输出预算、订阅预算映射、缓存 TTL 标记、图像 detail 注入。在 core 与 cli 包目录内用 vitest 运行（改动的测试文件与源码同目录）。
- 用可服务 qwen4-max 的 ModelStudio key 选择该模型并确认：effort 选择器提供 low / high / xhigh、默认 high；关闭思考时发出关闭形状且输出预算在非思考上限内；附加图像以图像 part 送达线协议；缓存保留设为扩展档时缓存断点带 1 小时 TTL、默认省略；图像精细度设为 low 时图像 part 带 low-detail 字段。
- 确认上一代旗舰的档位、默认值、订阅预算表保持不变。

### 证据（Before & After）

N/A —— 无 TUI 布局变化；行为经线协议单测验证（rebase 到当前 main 后，改动文件的 1307 个 core 测试及 cli model-configuration、effort-command 套件全绿）。因本环境无可用 key，未做真实模型端到端；覆盖四通道的 E2E 计划已备好、待 key 执行。

### 测试平台

macOS ✅；Windows ⚠️ 未测；Linux ⚠️ 未测。

### 环境

仅单测与类型检查（Node 26，macOS）。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险/权衡：输出预算豁免使 qwen4 请求可携带远大于以往的输出预算；上下文窗口夹制与非思考夹制约束它，但服务 qwen4 别名的第三方网关可能强制不同的上限。
- 未验证/范围外：真实模型 E2E（待 key）；CoT 摘要展示与 programmatic tool calling 延后；订阅默认模型不切换（产品决策）。缓存 TTL 门控作用于整个 qwen4 前缀，与厂商「Qwen4 系列」显式缓存文档一致。
- 破坏性变更/迁移说明：既有 `qwen4*` 自定义路由（如 `qwen4-plus`）现在采用 qwen4 世代契约——档位 `low/high/xhigh`（默认 `high`）与思考模式 sized 的 262,144 输出预算——而非继承的 qwen3.8-max 档位与 32K 输出回退；`qwen3.8-max` 与邀请制 latest-series 预览保持已发布行为。

设计文档：[English](docs/design/2026-11-16-qwen4-max-integration.md) | [中文](docs/design/2026-11-16-qwen4-max-integration.zh-CN.md)

## 关联 Issue

无。

</details>
