prs.title: feat(core): add local notes compaction with a strategy selector
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds an opt-in local notes compaction strategy. Users can select **Summary** or **Notes and History** under **Chat Compression Strategy** in `/settings`, or set `model.chatCompression.strategy` to `summary` or `notes` in `settings.json`. Summary remains the default; changing the selection requires restarting Qwen Code.

Eligible main sessions gain `session_notes`, `session_history`, `get_context_remaining`, and `new_context`. The model can persist a bounded working checkpoint, start a smaller context from that checkpoint and the latest consumed user request, and recover omitted evidence from the active branch of its local session log. Successful notes rollovers make no summarization request. Notes revisions live in the existing JSONL transcript, with a generated Markdown projection for inspection; checkpoint persistence must succeed before active history changes. Resume, fork, rewind, archive, and deletion handle the matching notes state.

Missing, stale, or unusable notes fall back to summary for automatic and ordinary manual compression. An explicit `new_context` requires a fresh revision and reports an error if it cannot commit. `/compress <instructions>` continues to summarize, and `/compress-fast` keeps its existing behavior. The notes tool bundle respects recording availability and tool policy and is excluded from subagents, teammates, and nested code-mode calls. Ink and OpenTUI display a notes-specific transition notice.

## Why it's needed

Repeated full-history summaries can lose constraints, decisions, and tool evidence that a long task needs later. A local working checkpoint plus bounded history retrieval gives the model a way to carry forward its current state and recover details on demand. Storage and retrieval use the existing session log and require no additional memory backend. Selected notes and retrieved history still go to the configured model provider as normal inference input. Real-model quality, total token cost, and latency remain to be measured before considering a default change.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Start the local build with no strategy configured and confirm summary behavior. Open `/settings`, search for `compression`, switch to **Notes and History**, and confirm the saved value is `model.chatCompression.strategy: "notes"` and the restart notice appears. Restart and check that the four notes tools are available. Repeat with `summary`, including activation through `settings.json`.
2. In an isolated recorded session, have the model write notes and request a new context in separate tool-only responses using the returned revision. Repeat three times. Each new context should retain the checkpoint and current user constraints, with no summarizer request. Deliberately omit an earlier identifier from the notes, then recover it through history search/read. Resume the session and check that its latest notes revision and old history reference still work.
3. Check that missing/stale revisions, oversized notes, and notes/reset calls mixed with ordinary text or tools cannot install a new context. Disabling recording or denying a required notes tool should disable the complete bundle. After switching to a smaller model window, existing bounded notes should remain readable, while an oversized checkpoint must be shortened before it can authorize a reset.
4. Compare compression commands: `/compress` with fresh notes should use notes; missing/stale notes should fall back to summary; `/compress <instructions>` should forward those instructions to the summarizer even with fresh notes; `/compress-fast` should retain its current tool-output clearing behavior. Check that the next model request uses the committed context and that notes transitions show the notes-specific notice.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Actual tmux captures of `/settings`, with the search set to `compression`:

**Before — global `qwen` `0.23.3-nightly.20260913.faa395885e`:**

```text
No settings match your search.
```

**After — local bundle `0.24.1`:**

```text
Chat Compression Strategy                                                   Notes and History*
Choose summary compression or local notes with history recovery. Restart Qwen Code to apply.
To see changes, Qwen Code must be restarted. Press r to exit and apply changes now.
```

The fresh-notes `/compress` case displayed `Started a new context from local notes` in the actual TUI. The complete deterministic headless/tmux run passed settings persistence, tool availability, history recovery/resume, six rejection cases, and all six manual-compression cases. After the final fixes, the rebuilt handoff rerun again committed **three distinct notes windows in 15 main requests with zero summarizer requests**; resume took three requests and restored the same notes revision and historical reference.

`npm run build`, `npm run typecheck`, and `npm run bundle` passed. Relevant core, ACP, settings/schema/i18n, and Ink/OpenTUI regression tests passed. The final focused rerun passed 23 core tests and 54 event-adapter tests; the commit hook also passed formatting and ESLint. A separate comment contains the E2E matrix and coverage limits.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ✅ |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ Not tested locally |
|  🐧 Linux  | ⚠️ Not tested locally |

### Environment (optional)

macOS arm64, Node.js `v26.8.2`; local bundled CLI `0.24.1`; isolated temporary settings and runtime directories; deterministic localhost OpenAI-compatible provider; headless CLI and real tmux interaction. The user's normal settings and sessions were not modified by the tests.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: This changes core recording, compaction, and replay paths. Correctness depends on fresh notes, successful checkpoint persistence, and branch-correct recovery; note completeness still depends on the model. The Markdown file is a generated view, so editing it directly does not update canonical notes.
- Not validated / out of scope: Real-model task quality, token/cost/latency comparisons, full ACP/Web Shell E2E, other provider wire protocols, process-crash/disk/lease fault injection, and Windows/Linux execution. The deterministic E2E suite does not cover automatic/hard-overflow triggers, nested code mode, or fork/rewind/archive lifecycle operations; focused regression tests cover relevant runtime paths, without claiming end-to-end coverage. Cross-session memory, multi-file notes, and a notes editor are out of scope.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: No settings migration is required. `summary` remains the default, existing transcripts remain supported, and enabling or disabling `notes` requires a restart. Ordinary compression can use summary fallback; an explicit `new_context` never silently summarizes.

Design: [English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/158a0511ddcdd465e14083c56d0f9c7cc8ac629a/docs/design/2026-09-19-local-notes-compaction.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/158a0511ddcdd465e14083c56d0f9c7cc8ac629a/docs/design/2026-09-19-local-notes-compaction.zh-CN.md). Both versions are complete and synchronized, including decisions, constraints, acceptance criteria, and follow-up validation.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #12257

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 的内容

增加可选的本地 notes 压缩策略。用户可以在 `/settings` 的 **上下文压缩方式** 中选择 **摘要** 或 **笔记与历史**，也可以在 `settings.json` 中把 `model.chatCompression.strategy` 设为 `summary` 或 `notes`。默认仍为摘要；修改选项后需要重启 Qwen Code。

符合条件的主会话获得 `session_notes`、`session_history`、`get_context_remaining` 和 `new_context` 四个工具。模型可以保存有大小限制的工作笔记，从笔记和最近已消费的用户请求启动更小的上下文，再从本地 session log 的有效分支找回遗漏证据。成功的 notes 换窗口不发起摘要请求。笔记版本保存在现有 JSONL transcript 中，并生成方便查看的 Markdown 文件；只有恢复 checkpoint 持久化成功后才替换当前历史。恢复、分叉、回退、归档和删除操作会处理对应的笔记状态。

自动压缩和普通手动压缩在笔记缺失、过期或不可用时回退到摘要。显式调用 `new_context` 必须提供新鲜的笔记版本，无法提交时返回错误。`/compress <instructions>` 继续生成摘要，`/compress-fast` 保持现有行为。笔记工具组遵循录制可用性及工具策略，并对 subagent、teammate 和嵌套 code-mode 调用关闭。Ink 和 OpenTUI 会显示专门的 notes 换窗口提示。

## 为什么需要

反复生成全历史摘要可能丢失长任务后续需要的约束、决策和工具证据。本地工作笔记加上有界历史检索，使模型能够保留当前工作状态并按需找回细节。存储和检索复用现有 session log，不需要新增 memory 后端。选中的笔记和检索出的历史仍会作为正常推理输入发送给配置的模型 provider。在考虑修改默认策略前，仍需评估真实模型的任务质量、总 token 成本和延迟。

## 审阅者测试计划

### 如何验证

1. 使用本地构建启动，不配置策略时确认仍使用摘要。打开 `/settings`，搜索 `compression`，切换到 **Notes and History**，确认保存的值为 `model.chatCompression.strategy: "notes"` 并显示重启提示。重启后检查四个笔记工具可用。再切回 `summary`，并验证通过 `settings.json` 启用的行为一致。
2. 在隔离且开启录制的会话中，让模型先写笔记，再用返回的 revision 请求新上下文；两次调用分别放在独立且只含该工具的回复中。重复三次。每个新上下文都应保留 checkpoint 和当前用户约束，且不发起摘要请求。故意不把某个早期标识符写入笔记，再通过历史搜索和读取找回。恢复会话后，检查最新笔记版本和旧历史引用仍可用。
3. 检查缺失或过期的 revision、超限笔记，以及混入普通文本或其他工具的笔记/换窗口调用，都不能安装新上下文。关闭录制或拒绝任一必需工具后，整个笔记工具组应被关闭。切换到窗口更小的模型后，已有且满足固定大小上限的笔记仍应可读，但超过当前模型预算的 checkpoint 必须缩短后才能用于换窗口。
4. 对比压缩命令：笔记新鲜时 `/compress` 应使用笔记；笔记缺失或过期时应回退到摘要；即使有新鲜笔记，`/compress <instructions>` 也应把指定要求转交摘要模型；`/compress-fast` 应保留现有清理工具输出的行为。检查下一次模型请求使用已提交的上下文，且 notes 换窗口显示对应提示。

### 证据（前后对比）

以下为真实 tmux 捕获的 `/settings` 画面节选，搜索词为 `compression`：

**修改前：全局 `qwen` `0.23.3-nightly.20260913.faa395885e`：**

```text

```

**修改后：本地 bundle `0.24.1`：**

```text
Chat Compression Strategy                                                   Notes and History*
Choose summary compression or local notes with history recovery. Restart Qwen Code to apply.
To see changes, Qwen Code must be restarted. Press r to exit and apply changes now.
```

使用新鲜笔记执行 `/compress` 时，真实 TUI 显示 `Started a new context from local notes`。完整的确定性 headless/tmux 测试通过了设置持久化、工具可用性、历史找回与会话恢复、六项拒绝场景以及全部六项手动压缩场景。最终修复后重新构建并复测交接，再次在 **15 次主模型请求中提交了三个不同的 notes 窗口，摘要请求为零**；恢复过程使用三次请求，恢复了相同的笔记版本和历史引用。

`npm run build`、`npm run typecheck` 和 `npm run bundle` 均通过。相关 core、ACP、设置/schema/国际化、Ink/OpenTUI 回归测试均通过。最后的针对性复测通过了 23 个 core 测试和 54 个 event-adapter 测试；提交钩子的格式和 ESLint 检查也通过。另附评论列出 E2E 场景矩阵和覆盖范围。

### 测试平台

| 平台 | 状态 |
| :---: | :---: |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ 未在本地测试 |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ 未在本地测试 |

### 环境（可选）

macOS arm64、Node.js `v26.8.2`、本地 CLI bundle `0.24.1`；使用隔离的临时设置和 runtime 目录、确定性的 localhost OpenAI 兼容模型服务、headless CLI 和真实 tmux 交互。测试未修改用户日常使用的设置和会话。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：涉及 core 的录制、压缩和回放路径。正确性依赖笔记新鲜度、checkpoint 成功持久化以及有效分支恢复；笔记内容是否完整仍依赖模型。Markdown 文件只是生成视图，直接编辑不会更新权威笔记。
- 未验证或不在范围内：真实模型任务质量、token/成本/延迟对比、完整 ACP/Web Shell E2E、其他 provider 的通信协议、进程崩溃/磁盘/写入租约故障注入，以及 Windows/Linux 运行。确定性 E2E 未覆盖自动/硬溢出触发、嵌套 code mode 或分叉/回退/归档生命周期操作；针对性回归测试覆盖了相关运行时路径，但不代表完成了这些场景的端到端验证。跨会话记忆、多文件笔记和笔记编辑器不在本次范围内。
- 破坏性变更或迁移说明：无需迁移设置。默认仍为 `summary`，继续支持已有 transcript；开启或关闭 `notes` 需要重启。普通压缩可以回退到摘要；显式 `new_context` 绝不会悄悄改用摘要。

设计文档：[English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/158a0511ddcdd465e14083c56d0f9c7cc8ac629a/docs/design/2026-09-19-local-notes-compaction.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/158a0511ddcdd465e14083c56d0f9c7cc8ac629a/docs/design/2026-09-19-local-notes-compaction.zh-CN.md)。两个版本完整同步，包括决策、约束、验收标准和后续验证。

prs.title: fix(managed-agent): close over the resources a config_install record names
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds `managed-config_install` to the two lists in `http-managed-session-store.ts` that decide what a commit closes over: the `collectNestedResourceRefs` walk branch and `isReferenceContainer`. Eight production lines, no behaviour change for any other kind.

## Why it's needed

Three lists are meant to agree about this kind, and on `main` two of them do while the one that actually walks does not:

| List | Location | Has the kind? |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `RESOURCE_REF_PATHS` — declares its six edges | `managed-session-resource-references.ts:99` | yes |
| `RESTORE_CONTAINER_KINDS` — cold-load descent queue | `hosted-harness-session.ts:460` | yes |
| `collectNestedResourceRefs` + `isReferenceContainer` | `http-managed-session-store.ts:4049` / `:4100` | **no** |

`collectNestedResourceRefs` is a standalone implementation — it neither reads `RESOURCE_REF_PATHS` nor delegates to `managedSessionNestedResourceRefs` — so its chain of `if (ref.kind === …)` branches falls through to a bare `return []` for this kind. Both arms of `commitResources` call it (staged at `:936`, persisted at `:951` behind `isReferenceContainer`), so the record ships alone: its `bundleRef`, `rootSnapshotRef`, `previousBundleRef`, `restoresBundleRef`, `stageAckRefs`, `enableAckRefs` and `previousRecordRef` are all left out of the transaction.

The cold-load path reaches the same dead end. `verifyRef` (`hosted-harness-session.ts:2924`) has no branch for this kind either, so a ref that `RESTORE_CONTAINER_KINDS` pushed onto `descend` (`:2906`) is read once and yields no children.

Two consumers walk exactly the chain this breaks, both written as though the closure were complete:

- `hosted-mcp-settings.ts:213` follows `previousRecordRef` while requiring `kind === 'managed-config_install'`, visited-set bounded.
- `ManagedSessionResourcesService.java:183` / `:210` resolves the effective package selection along the same chain, with `MAX_CONFIG_RECORDS` and explicit cycle detection, and reads `previousBundleRef` when the predecessor is not a package config.

Adding the kind to `RESOURCE_REF_PATHS` alone would not fix this, which is why the change is in the walker's own two lists.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. `cd packages/core && npx vitest run src/managed-runtime/http-managed-session-store.test.ts` — 249 pass.
2. Revert either production line and run only the new case: it fails with `expected [] to have a length of 7 but got +0`. The `[]` is the defect exactly — not a partial walk, no children at all.
3. Confirm no other kind changed behaviour: the whole file's 249 cases pass unchanged, and the added lines only widen membership for one kind.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before, on `main` (`c3cb25bf10f07`), a record naming all six declared edges plus a predecessor:

```
FAIL  collectNestedResourceRefs > closes over a config_install record and every resource it names
AssertionError: expected [] to have a length of 7 but got +0
 ❯ src/managed-runtime/http-managed-session-store.test.ts:9987:20
```

After: the same assertion returns all seven refs, and the first-revision shape (no predecessor, no restore target, empty ack arrays) returns exactly its two own edges.

Mutation check: with the production file stashed back to `main`, only the new case fails and the other 248 still pass; restoring it is byte-identical (`diff -q` clean).

Non-UI change.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   N/A  |
|  🐧 Linux  |   N/A  |

### Environment (optional)

`packages/core` unit tier (Vitest 3.2.7, Node 22). No MySQL, no daemon, no deployment needed — the walker is pure. ESLint and Prettier clean on both touched files.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: a commit whose closure reaches a `managed-config_install` record now also ships that record's children, so its transaction carries more resources. That is the intended contract — the same one an extension bundle's `contributionsRef` already follows — and `maxResourcesPerTransaction` still bounds it. The existing `LEGACY_EXTENSION_CLOSURE_KINDS` tolerance for a never-staged child is unchanged and still applies to these edges.
- Not validated / out of scope: no real-deployment cold-reopen run in this PR. The defect and the fix are both fully determined by the pure walker, and the unit assertion reproduces the exact `[]`; an end-to-end reopen check belongs with the deployment that consumes it.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. Records already committed without their closure keep the shape they have; this only stops new commits from dropping it.

## Linked Issues

Refs #17467

---

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

把 `managed-config_install` 加进 `http-managed-session-store.ts` 里决定「提交闭包包含什么」的两处清单：`collectNestedResourceRefs` 的遍历分支和 `isReferenceContainer`。生产改动 8 行，其他 kind 行为不变。

## 为什么需要

三份清单本应对这个 kind 一致，`main` 上两份有、真正执行遍历的那份没有：

- `managed-session-resource-references.ts:99` 的 `RESOURCE_REF_PATHS` **已声明**六条边
- `hosted-harness-session.ts:460` 的 `RESTORE_CONTAINER_KINDS`（冷加载下降队列）**已包含**
- `http-managed-session-store.ts:4049` / `:4100` 的遍历分支与 `isReferenceContainer` **都没有**

`collectNestedResourceRefs` 是独立实现——既不读 `RESOURCE_REF_PATHS`，也不委托 `managedSessionNestedResourceRefs`——所以它那一串 `if (ref.kind === …)` 对这个 kind 直落到裸的 `return []`。`commitResources` 两条臂都调它（staged 在 `:936`，persisted 在 `:951`、由 `isReferenceContainer` 把关），于是记录单独出运：`bundleRef`、`rootSnapshotRef`、`previousBundleRef`、`restoresBundleRef`、`stageAckRefs`、`enableAckRefs` 和 `previousRecordRef` 全部被漏在事务外。

冷加载侧同样走到这个死角：`verifyRef`（`hosted-harness-session.ts:2924`）也没有该 kind 的分支，所以被 `RESTORE_CONTAINER_KINDS` 推入 `descend`（`:2906`）的 ref 读一次后取不出任何子 ref。

有两个消费方正是沿这条断掉的链走，且都是按「闭包完整」写的：`hosted-mcp-settings.ts:213` 沿 `previousRecordRef` 且要求 kind 匹配、visited 集合兜底；服务端 `ManagedSessionResourcesService.java:183`/`:210` 沿同一条链解析生效的包选择，带 `MAX_CONFIG_RECORDS` 与显式环检测，前驱不是包配置时读 `previousBundleRef`。

只往 `RESOURCE_REF_PATHS` 里加是修不好的，这也是改动落在 walker 自己那两处清单的原因。

## 评审测试计划

1. `cd packages/core && npx vitest run src/managed-runtime/http-managed-session-store.test.ts` —— 249 通过。
2. 还原任一处生产改动、只跑新用例：报 `expected [] to have a length of 7 but got +0`。`[]` 就是缺陷本身——不是走漏一部分，而是一个子 ref 都没有。
3. 确认其他 kind 行为未变：整文件 249 例原样通过，新增行只放宽了一个 kind 的成员判定。

**前后证据**：修复前在 `main`（`c3cb25bf10f07`）上，一条声明全部六条边加前驱的记录断言失败（输出见英文段）；修复后返回全部 7 个 ref，首个 revision 形态（无前驱、无 restore、ack 数组为空）恰好返回它自己的 2 条边。

**变异验证**：把生产文件 stash 回 `main` 后，只有新用例失败、其余 248 例仍通过；恢复后逐字节一致（`diff -q` 干净）。

## 风险与范围

- 主要权衡：闭包到达 `managed-config_install` 记录的提交现在会一并出运其子资源，事务携带的资源变多。这正是既定契约（扩展 bundle 的 `contributionsRef` 早已如此），且仍受 `maxResourcesPerTransaction` 约束。既有对「从未 staged 的子资源」的 `LEGACY_EXTENSION_CLOSURE_KINDS` 容忍未变，对这些边同样适用。
- 未验证 / 超出范围：本 PR 未做真实部署的冷重开验证。缺陷与修复都由这个纯函数完全决定，单测断言即复现了那个 `[]`；端到端重开检查应与消费它的部署一起做。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移：无。已按旧形态提交的记录保持原样，本改动只是让新提交不再丢闭包。

</details>

prs.title: fix(channels): address Aone channel deferred review findings (#17517)
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Follow-up to the merged Aone Code channel plugin (#17442), addressing the non-blocking review suggestions tracked in #17517. It is based on latest `main` and changes only the Aone adapter's connect-time diagnostics, its error logging, and the bilingual design docs — no dispatch, cursor, polling, or outbound behavior change, and no core change.

- **R4-1 — aged-out cursor diagnostic.** The diagnostic now fires only for a real prior cursor (`cursorId > 0`). An empty-window first poll baselines to `0`, which no event id can reach, so a filling window was previously misreported as "events lost to aging" when those events are actually dropped by the creation-time floor. The genuine aging case (cursor fell out of the 3-day window) now also records a durable `cursor_aged_out` journal event beside the stderr line, so the permanent loss is visible on the status page even though the poll itself resolves ok.
- **R4-2 — posture diagnostics.** The posture-by-posture warning enumeration is replaced with one per-repo posture-resolution pass that reproduces the base `groupConfigFor` key match (exact, then normalized) and the `senders`/`allowedUsers` repo→`*`→empty fallback chains. It adds two previously-missing diagnostics: **sender-dead** (a reachable repo whose effective senders is `allowlist` with an empty resolved `allowedUsers` list — every event dies `group_sender_denied` while the poll journals ok) and **pairing-open** (under `groupPolicy: pairing`, open senders are warned as a post-approval posture, not immediate reachability). The existing permissive / all-dead / mixed-dead warnings are preserved.
- **R4-3 — documentation accuracy.** The design docs (EN + zh-CN) now state that Aone is configured by hand in `settings.json`: it is not in the Web Shell's `SUPPORTED_CHANNEL_TYPES`, so the channel editor cannot create or edit it and the descriptor's `default: open` never seeds an editor draft; an absent `groupPolicy` resolves to `disabled` (connect warns). The previous "management UI seeds groupPolicy / editor-created channel" narrative described a path that does not exist for this plugin.
- **R4-4 — stderr sanitization.** The three raw `${err}` stderr interpolations (per-repo poll failure, per-event dispatch failure, MR-view failure) now pass through `sanitizeLogText`, so an a1-derived error cause carrying newlines cannot forge a second `[Channel:…]` log line and a long cause stays bounded. The per-repo poll failure shares one sanitized message between the journal record and stderr.
- **verify-r4 M17/M21 coverage gaps.** The all-dead test now also asserts the mixed dead-repo wording is absent (the two diagnostics are exclusive), and a new mixed-allowlist test with two entry-less repos asserts every dead repo is named.

## Why it's needed

These are genuine improvements deferred from #17442's round-4 review under its convergence posture (the PR was merge-ready with two approvals; a new commit there would have dismissed them). #17517 tracked them so they could land as a real fix based on `main` rather than being lost. Each is verified against the code: the aging over-fire, the sender-dead and pairing blind spots, the false editor narrative, and the unsanitized stderr were all reproducible.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Unit and meta tests (no credentials needed):

```
cd packages/channels/aone && npx vitest run
npx vitest run scripts/tests/package-scripts.test.js scripts/tests/unit-vitest-configs.test.ts
```

Expected: 98 passed / 1 skipped in the channel package (the skip is the `AONE_LIVE_SMOKE=1` live smoke); the workspace-mirror and vitest-config meta-tests stay green.

Behavioral checks, each pinned by a named test in `packages/channels/aone/src/AoneAdapter.test.ts`:

- R4-1: `an empty-window baseline (cursor 0) does not over-report aging` (no `aged out` line when a cursor-0 window fills) and `an aged-out cursor jump is diagnosed; a dormant repo is not` (now also asserts a `cursor_aged_out` journal record with `detail.cursor`/`detail.resumedFrom`). Removing the `cursorId > 0` guard, or the record call, turns the respective test red.
- R4-2: `senders allowlist with no allowedUsers anywhere warns sender-dead`, `senders allowlist whose list lives on "*" is NOT sender-dead` (pins the repo→`*` fallback — reading only the repo entry would falsely warn), and `pairing with open senders warns the post-approval posture`.
- R4-4: `the poll-failure stderr is sanitized: no forged line, bounded` seeds a newline-bearing 537-char cause and asserts the captured `poll failed for <repo>` stderr line has no forged column-0 `[Channel:…]` line and is bounded. This is the adapter-only guard (the journal write path does not cover stderr); reverting the stderr interpolation to raw turns it red.
- M17/M21: `allowlist with no watched-repo groups entry warns dead channel` (asserts no mixed wording) and `mixed allowlist names EVERY dead repo, not just the first`.

The existing 92 tests are unchanged and still pass, confirming the posture-resolution refactor preserves the prior warning behavior.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A (non-UI channel service). Before: a mixed allowlist with a sender-dead repo connected silently; an empty-window baseline printed a spurious aging warning; a newline-bearing a1 error forged a stderr log line. After: each posture is diagnosed, the aging diagnostic is gated and durable, and stderr is sanitized — as pinned by the tests above.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### Environment (optional)

`npm run build && npm run bundle`, `node dist/cli.js channel start` (standalone ACP-backed runtime), real model via the host's configured provider, real `a1` reads against `middleware/tddl5` with the only write command intercepted. Windows/Linux rely on CI.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the change is confined to connect-time diagnostics and error logging. The posture-resolution pass reproduces the base gate order and fallback chains (verified against `ChannelBase.groupConfigFor`/`groupAllowedUsersFor`/`groupSendersFor`); an empty allowlist denies everyone (it does not fall through to open). The pairing-open warning deliberately does not claim immediate reachability (a pairing group needs one-time approval). No dispatch, cursor, dedup, budget, or outbound behavior is altered.
- Not validated / out of scope: the actual comment-create POST against the live platform (intercepted in verification — its argv contract is unchanged), Windows/Linux real machines (CI). Adding `aone` to the Web Shell `SUPPORTED_CHANNEL_TYPES` (the alternative R4-3 fix) is deliberately NOT done here — it would expand into the editor UI; this PR takes the documentation-accuracy branch instead.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none — diagnostics and logging only; existing configs behave identically (the 92 prior tests pass unchanged).

Design docs: [English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/fix/aone-channel-r4-followup/docs/design/2026-11-16-aone-channel-plugin.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/fix/aone-channel-r4-followup/docs/design/2026-11-16-aone-channel-plugin.zh-CN.md) (updated and synchronized).

## Linked Issues

Closes #17517 (the deferred-suggestion tracker). Follow-up to #17442 (merged).

- **verify-r4 M17/M21 覆盖缺口**：全死测试加断言不含混合措辞（两诊断互斥）；新增含两个无条目仓库的混合 allowlist 测试断言点名每个死仓库。

prs.title: fix(web-shell): stop the sidebar auto-restore from reverting the first workspace selection
prs.body:
## What this PR does

The Web Shell sidebar has an auto-restore effect for cold drafts (no active session, no workspace selection yet): when the daemon connection's workspace is non-primary, it expands the projects section in the sidebar and additionally calls `onSelectWorkspace` with the connected workspace's cwd so that a new draft "inherits" that workspace. That selection write is the bug: the composer's workspace picker spells the primary workspace as `undefined` (it calls `onSelectWorkspace(undefined)` when the primary row is picked), so the picker's own selection puts the draft back into the effect's trigger condition (`selectedWorkspaceCwd === undefined`). Whenever the effect re-triggers with its once-per-context guard re-armed (for example around the connection re-bind that happens for "New session"), it writes the leftover non-primary cwd back into the selection and the user's first pick is silently reverted to the previous workspace. A second click works because the reverting run consumes the guard. This PR removes the `onSelectWorkspace` call from the auto-restore effect (and the now-unused `onSelectWorkspace` dependency): the effect only expands the sidebar and never writes to the draft's selection.

## Why it's needed

The first selection in the composer's workspace picker is intermittently reverted to the previous workspace — the user has to click the same entry a second time. It reproduces whenever the daemon connection's workspace differs from the workspace the user picks (I reproduced it against a live Web Shell with CDP in #16992: before the fix the chip stays on the stale workspace for ~1.8 s after the pick, after the fix the pick applies on the first click). The chip, the picker, and the session that actually gets created should all follow the user's pick.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Start the Web Shell (Qwen Code Desktop, or `pnpm run dev`).
2. Be on a daemon whose connection workspace is non-primary (e.g. use a non-primary project, then open a new session; the draft chip shows that non-primary workspace).
3. Pick the primary workspace from the composer's workspace picker.
4. Expected: the chip shows the primary workspace immediately and stays there.
5. Before this PR the chip reverts to the non-primary workspace (first click fails, second click works).
6. Unit tests: `pnpm --dir packages/web-shell exec vitest run client/components/sidebar/WebShellSidebar.workspace-restore.test.tsx` — the new cases pin that the auto-restore effect never calls `onSelectWorkspace` (cold non-primary draft and active session) and that the expansion behavior is preserved.

### Evidence (Before & After)

The unit tests pin the selection write at the effect boundary where the revert happens: they render the sidebar with no session, no selection, and a stale non-primary connection and assert the `onSelectWorkspace` spy is never called — before this PR the effect called it with the connected workspace's cwd on mount, which is the call that reverts the user's first pick. A second case pins that the projects section still expands (`aria-expanded="true"`), so the expansion half of auto-restore is kept. I also reproduced the user-visible symptom against a live Web Shell with CDP before and after the fix: before, the first picker click is reverted (the chip flips back ~1.8 s later and a second click is needed); after, the pick applies on the first click (applied in 30 ms, no flip-back) — that live patch is the minified equivalent of this source change.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |  ✅    |
| 🪟 Windows |  ⚠️    |
|  🐧 Linux  |  ✅    |

macOS: live CDP reproduction of the picker revert before/after the fix. Linux: all unit and static runs (vitest, tsc, eslint, prettier) in a `node:22-bookworm` container. Windows: not tested — the change is browser-side TypeScript only.

### Environment (optional)

N/A — unit tests; manual reproduction needs Desktop/Web Shell.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: a cold new-session draft on a non-primary connection no longer pre-selects that workspace — the draft starts at the primary workspace and the sidebar only expands the connected one. This tradeoff is accepted and documented in #16992: the previous "inherit the leftover workspace" behavior is exactly what made the picker's first selection unreliable.
- Not validated / out of scope: the session-context auto-restore effect (active sessions) is unchanged; daemon-side connection routing is unchanged.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none — client-side only; no API or persistence changes.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #16992

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

Web Shell 侧边栏有一个针对"冷启动草稿"（没有活动会话、也还没有 workspace 选择）的自动恢复效果：当 daemon 连接所在的 workspace 非 primary 时，它会展开侧边栏的 projects 区块，并且额外用连接 workspace 的 cwd 调用 `onSelectWorkspace`，让新草稿"继承"该 workspace。这个选择写入正是 bug 本身：composer 的 workspace 选择器用 `undefined` 表示 primary workspace（选中 primary 行时调用 `onSelectWorkspace(undefined)`），所以选择器自己的选择会把草稿重新放回该效果的触发条件（`selectedWorkspaceCwd === undefined`）。只要该效果在 once-per-context 守卫重新就绪后再次触发（例如 "New session" 引发的连接重绑定前后），它就会把残留的非 primary cwd 写回选择，用户的第一个选择被静默地回退到上一个 workspace。第二次点击之所以有效，是因为造成回退的那次执行消耗掉了守卫。本 PR 从自动恢复效果中移除 `onSelectWorkspace` 调用（以及随之不再使用的 `onSelectWorkspace` 依赖）：该效果只展开侧边栏，绝不写入草稿的选择。

## 为什么需要

composer workspace 选择器里的第一次选择会被间歇性地回退到上一个 workspace —— 用户必须对同一条目点第二次。只要 daemon 连接所在的 workspace 与用户所选的 workspace 不同就能复现（我在 #16992 里用 CDP 对着 live Web Shell 复现了：修复前点击后 chip 停留在旧 workspace 上约 1.8 秒，修复后第一次点击即生效）。chip、选择器和实际创建的会话都应跟随用户的选择。

## 评审测试计划

### 如何验证

1. 启动 Web Shell（Qwen Code Desktop，或 `pnpm run dev`）。
2. 处于一个连接 workspace 为非 primary 的 daemon 上（例如先使用一个非 primary 项目，再打开新会话；草稿 chip 显示该非 primary workspace）。
3. 从 composer 的 workspace 选择器中选择 primary workspace。
4. 预期：chip 立即显示 primary workspace 并保持不变。
5. 本 PR 之前，chip 会回退到非 primary workspace（第一次点击失败，第二次点击有效）。
6. 单元测试：`pnpm --dir packages/web-shell exec vitest run client/components/sidebar/WebShellSidebar.workspace-restore.test.tsx` —— 新增用例固定了自动恢复效果绝不调用 `onSelectWorkspace`（冷启动非 primary 草稿、活动会话），且展开行为保持不变。

### 证据（前后对比）

单元测试在发生回退的效果边界上固定了这个选择写入：以"无会话、无选择、残留非 primary 连接"渲染侧边栏，断言 `onSelectWorkspace` spy 从未被调用 —— 本 PR 之前该效果在挂载时会用连接 workspace 的 cwd 调用它，这正是回退用户第一次选择的调用。第二个用例固定了 projects 区块仍然展开（`aria-expanded="true"`），即自动恢复的展开部分被保留。我还用 CDP 对着 live Web Shell 在修复前后复现了用户可见的症状：修复前第一次点击选择器会被回退（chip 约 1.8 秒后翻回，需要第二次点击）；修复后第一次点击即生效（30 ms 内应用，无回退）—— 该 live 补丁是同一源码改动的 minified 等价物。

### 测试平台

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |  ✅    |
| 🪟 Windows |  ⚠️    |
|  🐧 Linux  |  ✅    |

macOS：修复前后对选择器回退的 live CDP 复现。Linux：全部单元与静态检查（vitest、tsc、eslint、prettier）在 `node:22-bookworm` 容器内运行。Windows：未测试 —— 该改动仅为浏览器端 TypeScript。

### 环境（可选）

N/A —— 单元测试；手动复现需要 Desktop/Web Shell。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或权衡：非 primary 连接上的冷启动新会话草稿不再预选该 workspace —— 草稿从 primary workspace 开始，侧边栏只展开已连接的那个。这一权衡已被接受并在 #16992 中记录：之前的"继承残留 workspace"行为正是让选择器第一次选择不可靠的原因。
- 未验证/不在范围内：会话上下文自动恢复效果（活动会话）不变；daemon 侧连接路由不变。
- 破坏性变更/迁移说明：无 —— 仅客户端；无 API 或持久化变更。

## 关联 Issue

Fixes #16992

prs.title: fix(web-shell): scope the change overview commit fallback to the session start commit
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Retires the two display residuals that #17378 landed with maintainer acceptance, and clears the cheap witness-bearing items of that PR's deferred hardening ledger (the status-route perf items and the behavior-change items — permanent-400 rendering, stale-state on session switch, persisted workspaceId staleness — remain deferred). The change overview's commit fallback now lists only the session's own loose work: the window is the commits since the session's immutable start commit (else its base branch), minus every commit reachable from any bound PR head, computed in a single native git invocation. When no trustworthy start exists the fallback is suppressed rather than walked unscoped. The session start commit is persisted on branch and worktree sessions (including the journaled branch-worktree and worktree-reset paths, and durably across a daemon restart via the sidecar) and projected through the session summary; the log route gains an additive exclude parameter under a new capability tag; the now-redundant ancestry probe is removed. Two degradations keep the overview useful at the edges: a bound PR head missing from the local object database retries the same window without exclusion instead of blanking every unit, and a new client against an older daemon without the exclude capability suppresses the fallback rather than duplicating PR commits. The scope selector becomes a keyboard-operable ARIA tab widget, and the missing witness-bearing test pins, typing, and documentation fixes are added.

## Why it's needed

The shipped commit fallback could re-list history that is not this session's loose work. With no recorded boundary it walked HEAD unscoped, so a worktree session (created at the base tip, carrying the base branch's history) rendered up to twenty pre-session commits as its own loose units — the "worktree sessions start fresh" premise was false. With several bound PRs it bounded by the last-bound head, so two ancestor-but-incomparable heads made the window re-list a sibling PR's commits already shown under that PR's unit. Both are read-only display defects, but they misrepresent the delivery scale the overview exists to report. A unified reachability-exclusion boundary fixes both at once and removes the falsified premise entirely, instead of carrying it as accepted risk.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

The boundary model is verified against real git (not mocks) at three layers, plus a real-HTTP route smoke. From the repository root:

- Core exclusion semantics (real temp repos): `cd packages/core && npx vitest run src/utils/gitDiff.test.ts` — the `fetchGitLog excludeRefs` cases fork PRs from the base so a loose commit survives, build the two-incomparable-heads shape and show single-head exclusion leaks the sibling while the union drops both, and refuse an option-injection ref (`--max-count=1`) that git would otherwise accept.
- Hook boundary (jsdom): `cd packages/web-shell && npx vitest run client/components/artifacts/useChangeOverview.test.tsx client/components/artifacts/change-overview.test.ts` — no start commit and no base branch suppresses the fallback (no log call is issued); the start commit is preferred over the base branch; the detached-HEAD sentinel and whitelist-unsafe refs suppress; an unavailable log surfaces a retryable failure, not an empty session.
- Keyboard tab contract (jsdom): `cd packages/web-shell && npx vitest run client/components/artifacts/ChangeOverviewPanel.test.tsx` — roving tabindex, Arrow/Home/End move focus and selection with wrap, and a labelled tabpanel.
- Route + persistence (supertest): `cd packages/cli && npx vitest run src/serve/server.test.ts src/serve/routes/workspace-git-log.test.ts` — branch/worktree sessions record the start commit; the exclude query parameter forwards as refs; an unreadable hydration sidecar still serves the summary; the capability baselines carry the new tag.

A reviewer should confirm: a session with no trustworthy boundary shows no loose commit units (rather than pre-session history); two diverged bound PRs do not duplicate each other's commits as loose; and the scope chips are reachable and switchable by keyboard alone.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Real-git route smoke (real temp repo + real log route + real HTTP socket, no mocks), before/after for each residual:

- R7-1 — Before: a range-less `git log` over HEAD includes `base history` (pre-session). After: `<start>..HEAD` excludes `base history` and keeps `loose work`.
- R7-2 — Before: excluding only the last-bound head leaves `PR1 work` in the window. After: excluding the union of both heads drops `PR1 work` and `PR2 work` while `loose work` survives.
- Fail-closed: an unsafe exclude ref (`--max-count=1`) returns `available:false`; absent exclude leaves the window unchanged.

Mutation witnesses (byte-level restore, tree unchanged): 5/5 panel keyboard guards killed, 2/2 core exclusion guards killed, 2/2 composer boundary guards killed. The fail-closed guard was initially not witnessable (the test's bad refs were ones git rejects anyway, returning null via the error path); an accepted-option ref was added so deleting the pre-spawn guard turns the suite red.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### Environment (optional)

Node v24.22.1 (web-shell vitest requires Node 22/24, not the default Node 26). Local unit/component suites, five-package `tsc --noEmit`, and a real-git + real-HTTP route smoke. No agent model calls.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the start commit is a new optional field on branch/worktree metadata; legacy sessions without it fall back to the base branch or suppress, so the boundary degrades safely rather than walking unscoped. The exclude parameter is additive and capability-gated, so an older daemon ignores it and the hook does not pass it.
- Not validated / out of scope: macOS/Windows not run locally (CI covers them). The heavier residual-inventory items that are behavior changes rather than test pins (permanent-400 rendering, stale-state on session switch, persisted workspaceId staleness) remain deferred; this PR clears the cheap witness-bearing ledger and the ARIA contract only.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. The removed `headIsAncestor` probe field was optional and is no longer read by any client; the new fields are optional.

Design documents (English and Chinese, synchronized): [change overview boundary fix](docs/design/2026-11-17-change-overview-boundary-fix.md) · [变更总览边界修复](docs/design/2026-11-17-change-overview-boundary-fix.zh-CN.md). The original [change overview design](docs/design/2026-11-16-web-shell-change-overview.md) Known limitations are marked resolved.

## Linked Issues

Follow-up to #17378 (merged `6db070d787`); retires its two maintainer-accepted display residuals and the deferred hardening ledger.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 的作用

退役 #17378 经维护者接受携带合入的两条展示残留，并清理该 PR 延后加固清单中廉价且带见证的项（status 路由性能项与行为变化项——永久 400 渲染、切换会话陈旧态、持久化 workspaceId 陈旧——仍延后）。变更总览的 commit 兜底如今只列会话自身的松散工作：窗口是会话不可变起点 commit（否则其基线分支）以来的提交，减去从任一绑定 PR head 可达的所有提交，由单次原生 git 调用算出。无可信起点时抑制兜底，而非无范围遍历。会话起点 commit 持久化于分支与 worktree 会话（含日志式 branch-worktree 与 worktree-reset 路径，并经 sidecar 在 daemon 重启后保持 durable）并经会话摘要投影；log 路由在新 capability 标签下新增附加 exclude 参数；移除如今冗余的祖先探针。两处降级使总览在边界情形仍可用：绑定 PR head 不在本地对象库时，在同一窗口不带排除重试而非清空全部单元；新客户端对无 exclude 能力的旧 daemon 则抑制兜底而非重复 PR 提交。范围选择器成为可键盘操作的 ARIA tab 组件，并补齐缺失的带见证测试钉住、类型与文档修复。

## 为何需要

已交付的 commit 兜底可能重复列不属于本会话松散工作的历史。无记录边界时无范围遍历 HEAD，于是 worktree 会话（在基线顶端创建、携带基线分支历史）将至多二十条会话前提交渲染为自身松散单元——「worktree 会话从零开始」的前提不成立。有多个绑定 PR 时按最后绑定 head 定界，于是两个同为祖先但彼此不可比的 head 使窗口重复列兄弟 PR 的提交（这些提交已在该 PR 单元下展示）。两者均为只读展示缺陷，但歪曲了总览本应报告的交付规模。统一的可达性排除边界一次性修复两者，并彻底移除证伪前提，而非作为接受风险携带。

## 评审测试计划

### 如何验证

边界模型在三层针对真实 git（非 mock）验证，另加真实 HTTP 路由冒烟。从仓库根：

- core 排除语义（真实临时仓库）：`cd packages/core && npx vitest run src/utils/gitDiff.test.ts`——`fetchGitLog excludeRefs` 用例从基线 fork PR 使松散提交存活，构造两不可比 head 形状并展示单 head 排除泄漏兄弟、并集排除两者皆丢弃，拒绝 git 本会接受的选项注入 ref（`--max-count=1`）。
- hook 边界（jsdom）：`cd packages/web-shell && npx vitest run client/components/artifacts/useChangeOverview.test.tsx client/components/artifacts/change-overview.test.ts`——无起点 commit 且无基线分支抑制兜底（不发起 log 调用）；起点 commit 优先于基线分支；detached-HEAD 哨兵与白名单不安全 ref 抑制；不可用 log 呈现可重试失败而非空会话。
- 键盘 tab 契约（jsdom）：`cd packages/web-shell && npx vitest run client/components/artifacts/ChangeOverviewPanel.test.tsx`——roving tabindex、Arrow/Home/End 移动焦点与选择并回绕、带标签 tabpanel。
- 路由 + 持久化（supertest）：`cd packages/cli && npx vitest run src/serve/server.test.ts src/serve/routes/workspace-git-log.test.ts`——分支/worktree 会话记录起点 commit；exclude 查询参数转发为 refs；不可读水合 sidecar 仍提供摘要；capability 基线携带新标签。

评审应确认：无可信边界的会话不显示松散 commit 单元（而非会话前历史）；两个分叉绑定 PR 不互相重复提交为松散；范围芯片可仅凭键盘到达与切换。

### 证据（前后对比）

真实 git 路由冒烟（真实临时仓库 + 真实 log 路由 + 真实 HTTP socket，无 mock），每条残留前后对比：

- R7-1——前：HEAD 无范围 `git log` 含 `base history`（会话前）。后：`<start>..HEAD` 排除 `base history`、保留 `loose work`。
- R7-2——前：仅排除最后绑定 head 使窗口留有 `PR1 work`。后：排除两 head 并集丢弃 `PR1 work` 与 `PR2 work`，`loose work` 存活。
- 失败闭合：不安全 exclude ref（`--max-count=1`）返回 `available:false`；缺省 exclude 窗口不变。

变异见证（字节级还原、树不变）：面板键盘守卫 5/5 击杀、core 排除守卫 2/2 击杀、组合器边界守卫 2/2 击杀。失败闭合守卫起初不可见证（测试坏 ref 均为 git 本就拒绝者，经错误路径返回 null）；新增一个被接受的选项 ref，使删除预 spawn 守卫即令套件变红。

### 测试平台

🍏 macOS ⚠️ 未本地跑 · 🪟 Windows ⚠️ 未本地跑 · 🐧 Linux ✅ 已测。

### 环境

Node v24.22.1（web-shell vitest 需 Node 22/24，非默认 Node 26）。本地单测/组件套件、五包 `tsc --noEmit`、真实 git + 真实 HTTP 路由冒烟。无 agent 模型调用。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险/权衡：起点 commit 是分支/worktree 元数据上的新可选字段；无此字段的遗留会话回退基线分支或抑制，边界安全降级而非无范围遍历。exclude 参数附加且按 capability 门控，旧 daemon 忽略它、hook 不传它。
- 未验证/范围外：macOS/Windows 未本地跑（CI 覆盖）。残留清单中属行为变化而非测试钉住的较重项（永久 400 渲染、切换会话陈旧态、持久化 workspaceId 陈旧）仍延后；本 PR 仅清理廉价带见证清单与 ARIA 契约。
- 破坏性变更/迁移说明：无。移除的 `headIsAncestor` 探针字段本为可选且不再被任何客户端读取；新字段均可选。

设计文档（中英同步）：[change overview boundary fix](docs/design/2026-11-17-change-overview-boundary-fix.md) · [变更总览边界修复](docs/design/2026-11-17-change-overview-boundary-fix.zh-CN.md)。原[变更总览设计](docs/design/2026-11-16-web-shell-change-overview.zh-CN.md)的已知限制标记为已解决。

## 关联议题

#17378 的跟进（合入 `6db070d787`）；退役其两条维护者接受的展示残留与延后加固清单。

</details>

prs.title: feat(acp): connect durable team reports and session approvals [13902 B/3]
prs.body:
Stack: **[#15657](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15657) → [#15658](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15658) → [#15659](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15659)**. This is **B**, based on A (`split/13902-agent-identity`, `3294001f39040a668fcbad20045b64e03dc1b6e6`); base branch: `split/13902-agent-identity`. C (`split/13902-teammate-activity`) depends on B. Split from #13902 at source commit `6ed7884c381dfe1c59bd975d6cf61dbb41ef441c`; candidate B: `435e4f949eca7232c2b48d3a259f5083cb788b8a`. Review B against A to isolate the coordination change.

## What this PR does

Connects an ACP-hosted leader to Team reports, roster membership and teammate approvals. Reports and join/exit notices enter the existing peer notification path with canonical teammate identity, survive recording and replay, and receive teammate attribution in the Web Shell. Pending reports participate in work holds, reversible close, queue overflow and shutdown flushing.

Teammate approvals reach the host independently of the leader's permission queue. Session scope, request UUIDs, binding epochs, ownership checks and retirement on manager replacement or teammate exit keep approval lifetime tied to the owning session. B includes producer, persistence, bridge, SDK/UI consumers and their tests. It consumes A's shared identity contract without depending on subagent runtime behavior. Tool activity and inter-agent message display arrive in C.

## Why it's needed

Without a leader sink, ACP-hosted teammate reports remain unread and teammate approval events have no consumer. The leader and its client need a delivery path that carries attribution, preserves undrained reports and exposes teammate approval requests.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. At candidate `435e4f949eca7232c2b48d3a259f5083cb788b8a`, run `npm run build` from the repository root, then run the package-local commands below serially. Each Vitest command runs from the stated package directory.
2. Deliver a teammate report and roster join/exit, then reload the transcript. Confirm canonical attribution, peer semantics and turn-marker correlation. Exercise reversible close, pending-report holds, overflow, repeat flush and shutdown with undrained reports.
3. Leave a teammate approval unanswered while the leader requests its own tool approval. Confirm the leader request remains visible. Exercise host answer/failure, standalone policy, session ownership, manager rebinding, teammate exit and cancellation; evaluate the inherited feedback below separately.

```sh
# cwd: packages/acp-bridge
../../node_modules/.bin/vitest run src/bridge-workflow-ancestor-trust.test.ts src/bridgeClient.test.ts src/transcript-replay.test.ts
# cwd: packages/cli
../../node_modules/.bin/vitest run src/acp-integration/acpAgent.test.ts src/acp-integration/session/Session.test.ts src/acp-integration/session/team-sink.test.ts
# cwd: packages/core
../../node_modules/.bin/vitest run src/agents/team/test-utils/coordination-harness.test.ts src/services/api-user-prompt.test.ts
# cwd: packages/sdk-typescript
../../node_modules/.bin/vitest run test/agent-identity.test.ts
# cwd: packages/web-shell
../../node_modules/.bin/vitest run client/adapters/transcriptToMessages.test.ts client/components/messages/SystemMessage.test.tsx
```

### Evidence (Before & After)

On candidate `435e4f949eca7232c2b48d3a259f5083cb788b8a`, `npm run build` exited 0. The focused package-local Vitest runs passed **3058 tests in 11 test files**: ACP bridge 356, CLI 2246, core 130, SDK 13 and Web Shell 313. These counts come from this split candidate, not the original PR.

Runtime, UI E2E and standalone typecheck were not run. Matched before/after protocol, persistence and UI evidence is not available. The build and focused tests do not establish that all verification obligations are complete; this PR remains a draft and the unresolved feedback below remains open.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :---: | :---: |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ Build and focused tests; runtime/UI E2E and standalone typecheck not run |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ Not tested |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ Not tested |

### Environment (optional)

Local isolated worktree; repository-root build followed by serial package-local Vitest runs.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: notification durability and session-scoped approval lifetime cross queue, recording, bridge and shutdown boundaries. Roster transitions are event-based; there is no current-state snapshot for late attach or reconnect.
- Not validated / out of scope: exact-SHA runtime/UI and cross-platform validation are pending. Observational activity belongs to C. The source's unresolved feedback is retained.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: optional identity/attribution fields and session-scoped teammate permission metadata are added; no transcript migration is introduced.

Inherited unresolved feedback is not fixed by splitting:

- [R8-3: blanket XML escaping changes report/notice envelope fidelity across hosts](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/13902#discussion_r4372372660).
- [R9-2: team teardown can queue a leader wake for each roster exit](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/13902#discussion_r4372372667).
- [R9-5: the inserted permission interface changes BridgeClient JSDoc attachment](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/13902#discussion_r4372372676).
- [R9-7: the abort fake does not reproduce reject-on-abort behavior](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/13902#discussion_r4372372682).
- [R9-8: detach coverage does not establish that exit handling stays silent](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/13902#discussion_r4372372686).
- [R9-9: an unoffered permission option can be reported as host failure](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/13902#discussion_r4372372690).

A's unresolved replay feedback is inherited through the stack; its ownership remains with A.

Design: [English](docs/design/2026-10-11-agent-team-identity-projection.md) · [中文](docs/design/2026-10-11-agent-team-identity-projection.zh-CN.md). Both documents expand A with coordination decisions, constraints, acceptance criteria and the C follow-up boundary.

## Linked Issues

Related: #13785. Split source: #13902. This PR remains a draft. No automatic issue or PR closure is requested.

Stack links:

- A: [#15657](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15657) — prerequisite.
- B: [#15658](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15658) — this PR.
- C: [#15659](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15659) — depends on B.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

堆叠顺序：**[#15657](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15657) → [#15658](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15658) → [#15659](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15659)**。本 PR 是 **B**，基于 A（`split/13902-agent-identity`，`3294001f39040a668fcbad20045b64e03dc1b6e6`）；以 `split/13902-agent-identity` 为 base。C（`split/13902-teammate-activity`）依赖 B。拆分来源 #13902，固定源提交 `6ed7884c381dfe1c59bd975d6cf61dbb41ef441c`；B 候选为 `435e4f949eca7232c2b48d3a259f5083cb788b8a`。请相对 A 评审 B，以隔离协调层改动。

### 本 PR 做什么

将 ACP-hosted leader 接入 Team 报告、成员变更和队友审批。报告及加入/退出通知携带规范队友身份，进入现有 peer 通知路径，通过录制和重放保留，并在 Web Shell 中标注队友。待处理报告参与 work hold、可逆关闭、队列溢出和关机 flush。

队友审批独立于 leader 权限队列到达 host。会话范围、请求 UUID、binding epoch、所有权检查及 manager 替换或队友退出时的撤回，将审批生命周期绑定到所属会话。B 包含生产者、持久化、bridge、SDK/UI 消费方及配套测试。它消费 A 的共享身份契约，不依赖 subagent 运行时行为。工具活动与 agent 间消息展示由 C 交付。

### 为什么需要

缺少 leader sink 时，ACP-hosted 队友报告保持未读，队友审批事件没有消费方。leader 和客户端需要能传递归因、保存未排空报告并展示队友审批请求的投递路径。

### 评审测试计划

1. 在候选 `435e4f949eca7232c2b48d3a259f5083cb788b8a` 上从仓库根目录运行 `npm run build`，再串行执行英文部分列出的各包命令。每条 Vitest 命令均从标明的包目录执行。
2. 投递队友报告及成员加入/退出，再重载 transcript。确认规范归因、peer 语义和轮次标记关联。覆盖可逆关闭、待处理报告 hold、溢出、重复 flush 及含未排空报告的关机。
3. 保持队友审批未答复，同时让 leader 请求自己的工具审批，确认 leader 请求仍可见。覆盖 host 答复/失败、standalone 策略、会话所有权、manager 重绑定、队友退出及取消；下述继承反馈需另行验证。

**前后证据：**候选 `435e4f949eca7232c2b48d3a259f5083cb788b8a` 的 `npm run build` 退出码为 0。各包目录内的聚焦 Vitest 共通过 **11 个测试文件、3058 项测试**：ACP bridge 356、CLI 2246、core 130、SDK 13、Web Shell 313。这些数字来自本次拆分候选，不是原 PR 的历史结果。

未运行 runtime、UI E2E 或独立 typecheck，也没有匹配的协议、持久化和 UI 前后证据。构建与聚焦测试不代表所有验证义务均已完成；本 PR 保持 draft，下述未解决反馈仍然开放。

**测试平台：**macOS 已执行构建及聚焦测试，未运行 runtime/UI E2E 或独立 typecheck；Windows、Linux 未测试。

**环境：**本地隔离 worktree；从仓库根目录构建，再串行运行各包目录内的 Vitest。

### 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：通知持久性及会话级审批生命周期横跨队列、录制、bridge 和关机边界。成员变更基于事件，晚挂接或重连没有当前状态快照。
- 未验证或范围外：精确 SHA 的运行时/UI 及跨平台验证待完成。观察性活动属于 C。源提交的未解决反馈继续保留。
- 兼容性与迁移：新增可选身份/归因字段及会话级队友审批元数据；没有引入 transcript 迁移。

以下继承的未解决反馈未因拆分而修复：

- [R8-3：完整 XML 转义改变报告/通知 envelope 保真性及跨 host 行为](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/13902#discussion_r4372372660)。
- [R9-2：Team teardown 可能为每个成员退出排入一次 leader 唤醒](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/13902#discussion_r4372372667)。

prs.title: feat(models): managed model endpoint allowlist and empty built-in auth-type model lists
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds a first-class managed allowlist for model endpoints: a new `model.allowedBaseUrls` setting (an array of endpoint base URLs). When the setting is set, the model registry only registers models — built-in providers and custom `providerProtocol` providers alike — whose resolved baseUrl matches an entry, either exactly or under it across a path boundary (so `https://corp.example` covers `https://corp.example/v1` but not `https://corp.example.evil.com`). Hosts match case-insensitively, paths case-sensitively, and trailing slashes are ignored on both sides. A model without an explicit baseUrl is checked against its protocol's default endpoint — the same default table on the registry and the resolution side — so an allowlist that omits that default blocks such models (fail closed). An empty list registers no models at all; leaving the key unset keeps today's behavior. The same predicate gates where the outbound endpoint is resolved — `--model`, `--openaiBaseUrl`, env vars, the protocol default endpoint dialed when no baseUrl is set, and the credential restore/capture paths — so an off-list endpoint fails closed with an error that names the setting instead of being dialed. The list is also applied to the Live Voice (realtime wss) path, which reads raw settings and never touches the registry (wss judged in its https form), and to the remaining model-registry construction sites (voice model picker, workspace provider status, workspace settings writes, provider-install probe). A non-array value is a startup error naming the key; entries that are not non-empty URL strings with a hostname are warned about and skipped, and can never match anything (a degenerate entry cannot turn the control into a wildcard). Matching is URL-semantic: scheme and host are compared directly (an explicit default port counts as absent, so `https://corp.example:443/v1` matches `https://corp.example`); a workspace-scope list is honored only when no User, System, or SystemDefaults scope defines one — a repository cannot replace an operator-configured list — and a workspace-scope list narrows configured provider endpoints without disabling the built-in Qwen OAuth models.

The built-in Qwen OAuth (personal Qwen login) models are hard-coded and can be disabled only by an operator: set `model.qwenOAuthBuiltinsDisabled: true` in System, User, or SystemDefaults settings (a workspace-scope attempt is stripped from the merge with a warning, and an active setting warns at load naming the scope). An explicit empty model list (`"qwen-oauth": []`) is just an empty provider list — it is not a disable switch, because the settings migration and the provider-removal route synthesize it without operator intent. While the disable is active, Qwen OAuth resolution fails closed with an error that names the setting, so `--model` and a persisted `model.name` cannot re-admit the dynamic endpoint. Note that an operator-scope `model.allowedBaseUrls` also disables the built-in Qwen OAuth models, because their endpoint is discovered dynamically at login and cannot be listed (a workspace-scope list does not — the built-ins are exempt from a workspace-scoped policy); a deployment that needs personal Qwen login should do neither.

The allowlist and the disable flag are read from merged settings at config load and are boot-frozen: model reloads re-apply the boot-time values (the list is not a `reloadModels` parameter at all, unlike the `providerProtocol` mapping, which the reload API can replace), so a mid-session policy edit takes effect only after a restart. Because the settings merge gives the system scope senior priority, a system-defined list cannot be overridden or widened by user or workspace settings — that is the "managed" guarantee. Lower scopes may define their own list only when the system scope defines none (self-restriction). Also regenerates the VS Code companion's `settings.schema.json` and documents the setting.

## Why it's needed

Managed (enterprise) deployments pin model traffic to a corporate endpoint via system-scope settings, but two gaps let user settings route traffic elsewhere (both independently confirmed on main, see #12805): (1) a custom provider declared under a user-scope `modelProviders` key with a `providerProtocol` mapping survives the merge — `REPLACE` on a nested object degrades to a recursive key-union, so any user-scope key absent from the system scope is preserved, and the external model then appears in the model picker and works via `--model`; (2) the qwen-oauth built-ins are registered unconditionally, with no operator switch to disable them. Combined with in-session model selection, these are ways out of the managed model set. The reporter's current workaround is a post-install bundle patch against minified anchors, which has to be re-verified on every CLI update.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Unit tests (no credentials or network needed): `pnpm --filter @qwen-code/qwen-code-core test -- src/models/modelRegistry.test.ts` and `pnpm --filter @qwen-code/qwen-code test -- src/config/settings.test.ts`. The new suites cover: a custom provider with an external baseUrl is not registered when the allowlist is set (and a warn is logged); the same provider registers when its baseUrl is on the list; behavior is unchanged when the key is unset; a sibling domain (`corp.example.evil.com`) is not treated as a path prefix; a scheme mismatch (`http://` vs `https://`) never matches; an empty allowlist registers nothing; a model whose protocol default endpoint is not listed is blocked; `model.qwenOAuthBuiltinsDisabled: true` disables the built-ins while `false`/absent keeps them; workspace-scope values for both keys are stripped with a warning; a workspace-scope-only allowlist exempts the built-ins; reloads preserve the boot-frozen policy; and the system-scope list wins over a user-scope list in the settings merge.
2. Manual (optional): with a system settings file containing `"model": { "allowedBaseUrls": ["https://corp.example/v1"] }` and a user settings file declaring a custom provider under an external baseUrl with a `providerProtocol` mapping, start the CLI and open the model picker — the external model must not be listed, and `--model custom:ext` must not select it. With `"model": { "qwenOAuthBuiltinsDisabled": true }` in the system file, the qwen-oauth built-in must not be selectable, and resolution must fail closed with an error naming the setting.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A (non-UI change; the model picker list changes are covered by the unit tests above).

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |  ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |  ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |  ✅   |

### Environment (optional)

Linux: Docker `node:22-bookworm`, pnpm 11.24.0 (frozen lockfile), head `808a061948`: full CLI vitest suite (42920 tests: 42630 passed; the 52 failures are all in files this PR does not touch — 2 attributed environment failures: the pem-certificate-blocks loader-oracle divergence between node 22 in the container and node 26 on the host, and the managed-runtime-bootstrap real-SSH-process tests; the remainder are timing-sensitive flakes whose failing-file set shifts between runs; every test file this PR touches passes), core model suites 315/315 (modelRegistry, modelsConfig, modelConfigResolver, model-catalog), `tsc --noEmit` (core + cli) clean, `eslint` clean, `prettier --check` clean for the touched packages, and the regenerated `settings.schema.json` (regeneration check: no diff). Unit tests only, no running CLI.

macOS: host (Apple Silicon, macOS `26.6.2`, node `26.5.0`), head `808a061948`: the PR-relevant node-environment suites — core model suites (modelRegistry, modelsConfig, modelConfigResolver) and CLI `config`, `settings`, `modelConfigUtils`, `migration`, `serve` routes, `advisor-command`, and `batch` — plus `tsc --noEmit` (core + cli). The jsdom-environment suites (`llm.test.tsx`, web-shell) cannot run on this host (vitest-jsdom is broken under host node 26) and are covered by the Linux Docker run above.

Windows: no Windows runner available at `808a061948`.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: `model.qwenOAuthBuiltinsDisabled` is a new operator-only switch (default `false` = unchanged behavior), and an explicit empty list (`"qwen-oauth": []`) is now inert — a deployment that used it as a disable switch must set the new key instead. Failing closed on protocol default endpoints is deliberate: with an allowlist set, a model whose default endpoint is external must not register unless the operator lists that endpoint.
- Out of scope: per-request endpoint policy enforcement inside the SDK — the gate is at resolution time, not per request. The optional in-session switching restriction (ask #3) is not added — the picker and `--model` listings are built from the registry, so they are already confined to the managed set once the allowlist filters registration. A trusted workspace can still replace a non-empty operator `modelProviders` list for non-qwen-oauth provider ids (the workspace non-overriding rule currently covers the `model.allowedBaseUrls` and `model.qwenOAuthBuiltinsDisabled` keys only); generalizing it is a follow-up. A design doc covering the enforcement points, matching semantics, and the built-ins disable is at `docs/design/2026-10-17-managed-model-endpoint-allowlist.md` (EN + zh-CN).
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none by default (unset keys = unchanged behavior). Existing managed configs that pinned `"qwen-oauth": []` as a disable switch start with the built-ins re-enabled; set `model.qwenOAuthBuiltinsDisabled: true` in an operator scope to restore the disable.

白名单与禁用键在配置加载时从合并后的 settings 读取，且在启动时冻结：模型 reload 重新应用启动时的值（该列表根本不是 `reloadModels` 的参数，与 reload API 可以替换的 `providerProtocol` 映射不同），因此会话中途的策略修改只在重启后生效。由于 settings 合并中 system scope 具有最高优先级，system 定义的列表无法被 user 或 workspace 设置覆盖或扩大——这就是 "managed" 保证；低优先级 scope 只有在 system scope 未定义时才能定义自己的列表（自我限制）。另外重新生成了 VS Code 插件的 `settings.schema.json` 并补充了文档。

## 为什么需要

managed（企业）部署通过 system-scope settings 把模型流量固定到公司端点，但有两个缺口允许用户设置把流量引到别处（均已在 main 上独立确认，见 #12805）：(1) 用户 scope 中声明的自定义 provider（`modelProviders` 自定义键 + `providerProtocol` 映射）在合并后幸存——嵌套对象上的 `REPLACE` 退化为递归键并集，system scope 中不存在的 user-scope 键会被保留，外部模型随后出现在模型选择器中并可通过 `--model` 使用；(2) qwen-oauth 内建模型无条件注册，操作者没有禁用它们的开关。再叠加会话内模型切换，这两条就是绕出 managed 模型集合的途径。报告者目前的临时方案是安装后针对混淆锚点的 bundle 补丁，每次 CLI 更新都要重新验证。

## 评审测试计划

### 如何验证

1. 单元测试（无需凭据或网络）：`pnpm --filter @qwen-code/qwen-code-core test -- src/models/modelRegistry.test.ts` 与 `pnpm --filter @qwen-code/qwen-code test -- src/config/settings.test.ts`。新套件覆盖：设置白名单时，外部 baseUrl 的自定义 provider 不被注册（并记录 warn）；同一 provider 的 baseUrl 在白名单内时正常注册；未设置该键时行为不变；兄弟域名（`corp.example.evil.com`）不被当作路径前缀；scheme 不匹配（`http://` 与 `https://`）永不匹配；空白名单不注册任何模型；协议默认端点未列入的模型被阻止；`model.qwenOAuthBuiltinsDisabled: true` 禁用内建模型而 `false`/缺省保留；两个键的 workspace-scope 值都被剥离并警告；仅 workspace 的白名单豁免内建模型；热重载保留启动时冻结的策略；settings 合并中 system-scope 列表优先于 user-scope 列表。

prs.title: test(managed-agent): observe a real scheduled /loop fire in the full-stack E2E
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds a thirtieth deterministic arm to the managed-agent full-stack E2E runner and wires it into the full-tier `hosted-failover-e2e` CI job. The new exclusive `--loop-fire` mode creates a files/4 Session whose `/loop 1m …` input drives `cron_create` at the cron minimum cadence, then sends no further client input: the Java scanner must claim the armed definition, fire the next real minute slot through the Harness relay, and the wake pump must drive a model turn whose automation framing reaches the model. A `/loop clear` client turn then retires the schedule so no live every-minute definition survives the arm. The witness is bidirectional and tied to one occurrence: the public runs route must answer an occurrence with trigger `scheduled`, outcome `fired`, state `completed`, and that occurrence's key must appear verbatim in the wake round's framing, which must also name the minted schedule id and the scheduled trigger. A top-level pure guard enforces the tie and the meta-test extracts and executes it (every refusal direction plus the pass), so a severed guard reddens executable assertions while text pins stay green. A race-free negative asserts no create-turn round carries the framing. The mode sets a 1s scanner scan delay; the cadence itself is never faked. CI wiring follows the established arm pattern (npm script, workflow step with the same prerequisites gate and 10-minute ceiling, job ceiling 315 → 325, meta-test pins for the arm table, flag exclusivity, ceiling arithmetic and arm count). The skill-asset design's out-of-scope sentence now points at this follow-up in both languages.

## Why it's needed

The managed `/loop` chain is merged end to end (#16835 wakeup, #17088/#17197/#17235 fixed interval, #17272 skill asset, #17433/#17470 skill E2E + CI wiring), but the skill-asset design names one remaining gap explicitly: "observing a scheduled fire remains out of scope." The existing skill E2E retires its schedule before any fire, so nothing on the packaged stack proves that a committed schedule fires on its own — that the scanner claims the armed definition, relays `fire_run` to the Harness, that the wake pump drives a model turn whose framing reaches the model, and that the control plane settles the occurrence `fired` with trigger `scheduled`. The Java integration tests run the scanner against a fake Harness; the CLI unit tests run the fire route against an in-process store. The two halves had never been observed together on the real socket/filesystem/route stack. This arm closes that gap.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Build the packaged stack (`npm run build && npm run bundle`, then `mvn -B -pl server -am package -DskipTests -Dcheckstyle.skip=true -Dspotbugs.skip=true` under `packages/managed-agent-server`), then run `npm run test:e2e:managed-loop-fire` from the repository root with JDK 21, MySQL 8.4 binaries and Node 22+ on PATH. Expect a green run whose result JSON carries `fireTrigger: "scheduled"`, `fireOutcome: "fired"`, `fireState: "completed"`, a minted `asch_` scheduleId, the tied occurrenceKey, `scheduledFire`/`wakeModelRound`/`cronDelete` true and `modelRounds: 5` (create 2 + wake 1 + clear 2). Worst-case wall time ≈ 90s: the arm waits for a real minute boundary (the cron minimum), so a run started just after a boundary waits nearly a full minute. The fast meta suites (`npx vitest run --config ./scripts/tests/vitest.config.ts scripts/tests/managed-agent-server-e2e.test.js scripts/tests/hosted-process-ci.test.js`) pin the arm's contracts and execute the guard without the stack. A reviewer can also confirm the scheduled-trigger discrimination by swapping the scanner's relayed `trigger` to `"manual"` (AutomationScanner.java, `fire`), rebuilding the jar and re-running: the arm must go red at the guard (`it is not the fire's turn`) while the wake turn still runs and the ledger still settles scheduled/fired/completed; restoring the bytes and rebuilding returns green.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A (non-UI). Before implementation, `--loop-fire` was rejected at the runner's usage line (the gap); the existing `--loop-skill` arm was green on the rebuilt base and retired its schedule before any fire. After implementation, on the merged-main build (MySQL 8.4 + packaged Spring jar + hosted harness + embedded runtime broker + fake OpenAI server):

```json
{
  "mode": "loop-fire",
  "sessionId": "fa0a0923-7efb-4577-8816-91488c7bbf06",
  "definitionId": "agent_5b1587ec07fb4b7a920b08f19afd07ec",
  "scheduleId": "asch_979b1196b0637ee5a24fadda44e43e52",
  "occurrenceKey": "schedule:2026-11-17T02:18:00Z",
  "fireTrigger": "scheduled",
  "fireOutcome": "fired",
  "fireState": "completed",
  "scheduledFire": true,
  "wakeModelRound": true,
  "cronDelete": true,
  "modelRounds": 5
}
```

Mutation witnesses: severing the guard's first branch reddens the executable meta assertions while text pins stay green (byte-equal restore returns green); the Java relayed-trigger swap above reddens the arm at the guard (byte-equal restore + rebuild returns green); the round-1 acceptance mutations (delete the guard's `Trigger: scheduled` clause, drop `&& !loopFire` from the default-scenario gate, drop `|| loopFire` from the profile assignment) each redden exactly their new pin/direction and restore green. Meta suites 180/180; eslint, actionlint and the workflow-size gate clean (+948 bytes, within the 4096 allowance); `--loop-skill` green on the final build (no regression). Investigation note: the first runs went red at a public-event-stream wait even though the fire chain worked — a harness-driven wake turn does not ride the public turn event stream (that stream is written only by the control plane's dispatched-turn pipeline), so its public lifecycle is the automation run mirror, whose `state=completed` settles from the wake turn's own committed result. The arm witnesses the wake on the runs route; this is a test-design correction, not a production defect, and the design doc records the surface choice in D3.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### Environment (optional)

Local packaged stack: MySQL 8.4.6 (runner-private mysqld), Spring executable jar (JDK 21.0.9), `dist/cli.js serve --profile hosted-harness` with the embedded runtime broker, fake OpenAI server; Node 24.22.1 for the runner. No sandbox.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the arm adds a real minute-boundary wait (worst case ≈ 60s + tick + relay + turn) to the full-tier job, whose ceiling rises 315 → 325 accordingly; the model is scripted, so the arm tests the fire chain, not model behavior. The wake turn is witnessed through the automation run mirror rather than the public turn event stream, because harness-driven turns do not ride that stream — the runs route is their public lifecycle surface.
- Not validated / out of scope: `manual` and `catch_up` triggers (the guard rejects a manual occurrence as a witness), gated fires (files/4 declares no Shell lane and a gate is refused at create), overlap/catch-up policies, multi-fire endurance, the self-paced `loop_wakeup` sibling, and local macOS/Windows runs (CI covers the Linux full-tier lane).
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. The change adds an exclusive runner mode, a CI arm and tests/docs; no production code is modified. Design: [English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/main/docs/design/2026-11-17-managed-loop-fire-e2e.md) / [中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/main/docs/design/2026-11-17-managed-loop-fire-e2e.zh-CN.md) (both complete and synchronized; the updated skill-asset design links them in both languages).

## Linked Issues

Follow-up to the managed loop chain: #16835, #17088, #17197, #17235, #17272, #17433, #17470 (referenced without closing keywords — this PR closes no issue; it closes the scheduled-fire observation gap those PRs left out of scope).

<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

给 managed-agent 全栈 E2E runner 增加第三十条确定性臂，并接入 full-tier `hosted-failover-e2e` CI job。新互斥模式 `--loop-fire` 创建 files/4 Session，其 `/loop 1m …` 输入以 cron 最小节奏驱动 `cron_create`，此后不再发送任何客户端输入：Java scanner 必须认领 armed 定义、经 Harness 中继触发下一个真实分钟槽，wake pump 必须驱动一个 automation 框架到达模型的回合。随后 `/loop clear` 客户端回合退役 schedule，臂结束无存活的每分钟定义。见证双向且绑到同一次 occurrence：公共 runs 路由必须应答 trigger `scheduled`、outcome `fired`、state `completed` 的 occurrence，其 key 必须逐字出现在 wake 回合的框架内，框架还须点名铸造的 schedule id 与 scheduled trigger。顶层纯守卫强制该绑定，元测试提取并执行它（每个拒绝方向加通过），剪断守卫使可执行断言红而文本钉保持绿。无竞态负例断言任何 create 回合都不带框架。本模式设 1s scanner scan 延迟；节奏本身绝不伪造。CI 接线遵循既有臂模式（npm 脚本、同前置门与 10 分钟 ceiling 的 workflow 步骤、job ceiling 315 → 325、臂表/flag 排他/ceiling 算术/臂数的元测试钉子）。skill 资产设计的 out-of-scope 句双语指向本跟进。

## 为什么需要

Managed `/loop` 链路已端到端合入（#16835 唤醒、#17088/#17197/#17235 固定间隔、#17272 skill 资产、#17433/#17470 skill E2E + CI 接线），但 skill 资产设计明示唯一剩余缺口：「观察定时触发仍在范围外」。既有 skill E2E 在任何触发前就退役 schedule，因此打包栈上没有任何东西证明已提交的 schedule 会自行触发——scanner 认领 armed 定义、向 Harness 中继 `fire_run`、wake pump 驱动框架到达模型的回合、控制面把 occurrence 结算为 `fired` 且 trigger 为 `scheduled`。Java 集成测试用假 Harness 跑 scanner；CLI 单测用进程内 store 跑 fire 路由。两半从未在真实 socket/文件系统/路由栈上被一起观察。本臂补上该缺口。

## 评审测试计划

### 如何验证

构建打包栈（`npm run build && npm run bundle`，再在 `packages/managed-agent-server` 下 `mvn -B -pl server -am package -DskipTests -Dcheckstyle.skip=true -Dspotbugs.skip=true`），然后在仓库根以 PATH 上的 JDK 21、MySQL 8.4 二进制与 Node 22+ 跑 `npm run test:e2e:managed-loop-fire`。预期绿跑，结果 JSON 携带 `fireTrigger: "scheduled"`、`fireOutcome: "fired"`、`fireState: "completed"`、铸造的 `asch_` scheduleId、绑定的 occurrenceKey、`scheduledFire`/`wakeModelRound`/`cronDelete` 为真、`modelRounds: 5`（create 2 + wake 1 + clear 2）。最坏墙钟 ≈ 90s：臂等待真实分钟边界（cron 最小粒度），刚过边界启动的运行要等近一整分钟。快速元套件（`npx vitest run --config ./scripts/tests/vitest.config.ts scripts/tests/managed-agent-server-e2e.test.js scripts/tests/hosted-process-ci.test.js`）无需打包栈即钉住臂契约并执行守卫。评审也可把 scanner 中继的 `trigger` 换成 `"manual"`（AutomationScanner.java `fire`）、重建 jar 复跑来确认 scheduled-trigger 判别：臂必须在守卫处红（`it is not the fire's turn`），而 wake 回合仍跑、账本仍结算 scheduled/fired/completed；还原字节并重建复绿。

### 证据（前后对比）

N/A（非 UI）。实现前 `--loop-fire` 在 runner usage 行被拒（缺口）；既有 `--loop-skill` 臂在重建基线上绿，且在任何触发前退役 schedule。实现后，在合并 main 的构建上（MySQL 8.4 + 打包 Spring jar + hosted harness + 内嵌 runtime broker + 假 OpenAI 服务器）：结果 JSON 见上方英文正文（sessionId fa0a0923，occurrenceKey schedule:2026-11-17T02:18:00Z，scheduled/fired/completed，modelRounds=5）。

变异见证：剪断守卫第一分支使可执行元断言红而文本钉绿（字节级还原复绿）；上述 Java 中继 trigger 替换使臂在守卫处红（字节级还原 + 重建复绿）；round-1 验收变异（删守卫 `Trigger: scheduled` 条件、删默认场景门的 `&& !loopFire`、删 profile 赋值的 `|| loopFire`）各使对应新钉子/方向红，还原复绿。元套件 180/180；eslint、actionlint、workflow 尺寸门净（+948 字节，4096 容差内）；最终构建上 `--loop-skill` 绿（无回归）。勘察注记：首跑在公共事件流等待上红，但 fire 链路本身正常——harness 自驱的 wake 回合不进入公共回合事件流（该流仅由控制面的派发回合管线写入），其公共生命周期是 automation run 镜像，`state=completed` 从 wake 回合自身的已提交结果结算。臂据此走 runs 路由见证 wake；这是测试设计修正，非生产缺陷，设计文档 D3 记录了观察面选择。

### 测试平台

🍏 macOS ⚠️ 未测 · 🪟 Windows ⚠️ 未测 · 🐧 Linux ✅ 已测（见上方矩阵）。

### 环境（可选）

本地打包栈：MySQL 8.4.6（runner 私有 mysqld）、Spring 可执行 jar（JDK 21.0.9）、`dist/cli.js serve --profile hosted-harness` 带内嵌 runtime broker、假 OpenAI 服务器；runner 用 Node 24.22.1。无沙箱。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险/取舍：臂给 full-tier job 增加真实分钟边界等待（最坏 ≈ 60s + tick + 中继 + 回合），job ceiling 相应 315 → 325；模型是脚本化的，臂测的是 fire 链路而非模型行为。wake 回合经 automation run 镜像见证而非公共回合事件流，因为 harness 自驱回合不进入该流——runs 路由是其公共生命周期面。
- 未验证/范围外：`manual` 与 `catch_up` trigger（守卫拒绝 manual occurrence 作为见证）、带 gate 的触发（files/4 不声明 Shell lane，gate 在 create 时即被拒）、overlap/catch-up 策略、多次触发耐久、自定步调 `loop_wakeup` 姊妹切片、本地 macOS/Windows 运行（CI 覆盖 Linux full-tier 车道）。
- 破坏性变更/迁移说明：无。变更新增互斥 runner 模式、CI 臂与测试/文档；不修改任何生产代码。设计：[英文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/main/docs/design/2026-11-17-managed-loop-fire-e2e.md) / [中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/main/docs/design/2026-11-17-managed-loop-fire-e2e.zh-CN.md)（双语完整同步；更新的 skill 资产设计双语链接它们）。

## 关联 issue

Managed loop 链路的跟进：#16835、#17088、#17197、#17235、#17272、#17433、#17470（不用关闭关键词引用——本 PR 不关闭任何 issue；它补上这些 PR 留在范围外的定时触发观察缺口）。

</details>
