prs.title: feat(web-shell): pin the read-turn prompt in split view panes
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Extends the pinned turn prompt feature (first cut in #16095) to Split View panes. This branch builds on top of #16095 (Yash Kakade's first cut) and adds the missing opt-in at the second `TranscriptViewport` call site: `ChatPane` now passes `pinnedPrompt`, so a split pane shows the same pinned prompt overlay as the main transcript. Adds a unit test asserting the pane viewport receives the prop, and updates the design doc (EN + zh-CN): Split View moves from the out-of-scope list to covered scope.

## Why it's needed

#15683 is about losing track of which prompt the visible output belongs to when scrolling a long transcript. That problem exists equally in Split View panes, but the first cut deliberately opted in only at the main transcript call site. The overlay mechanics from #16095 already support panes: the follow range runs while the navigation rail is hidden when `pinnedPrompt` is set, which is exactly the pane situation (panes always pass `hideSessionTimeline`). So extending coverage is a one-line opt-in plus a regression test, with no changes to the overlay itself.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Unit: `cd packages/web-shell && npx vitest run client/components/ChatPane.test.tsx client/components/TranscriptViewport.pinned.test.tsx` — expect all tests green, including the new `pins the prompt of the turn being read in its transcript viewport` test (the mocked pane viewport is asserted to receive `pinnedPrompt`) and all 18 pinned-overlay cases from #16095.
2. Manual (split view): open two sessions in Split View, run a long turn in one pane, scroll the pane transcript above the prompt row — expect the pinned pill with the turn's prompt label at the top of the pane; scroll back to the prompt row — expect the pill to hide. The same behavior already covered by `web-shell.pinned-prompt.spec.ts` for the main transcript now also holds in panes.
3. Typecheck/lint: `tsc -p packages/web-shell/tsconfig.json --noEmit` and eslint on the changed files pass (one pre-existing, unrelated error in `WorkspaceFileBrowser.tsx` against the published `@pierre/trees@1.0.0-beta.6` types exists on `main` as of this branch's base and is out of scope here).

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: in Split View, scrolling a pane transcript above the prompt row shows nothing — no label says which prompt the visible output belongs to (the situation reported in #15683 for the main transcript; the user-facing complaint that started this extension). After: the pane shows the same pinned pill as the main transcript (verified in the local Web Shell with the pane call site opted in). A before/after screenshot pair can be added once the #16095 base is merged and the e2e environment is available.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |  ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️    |
|  🐧 Linux  | ⚠️    |

### Environment (optional)

Local `pnpm` checkout of this branch; unit tests and typecheck run directly (no daemon runtime needed for the unit-level assertions).

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: very low. The change is a single opt-in prop at the second existing `TranscriptViewport` call site; the overlay, its constraints (no layout shift, `pointer-events: none`, `aria-hidden`) and the follow-range behavior are unchanged and already covered by #16095's unit and e2e suites for the main transcript.
- Not validated / out of scope: a pane-specific e2e scenario (split view harness) is not added here; the existing e2e spec targets the main transcript. Interaction of the pill with very narrow panes is covered only by the CSS clamp already in #16095.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. No protocol, public API, or settings changes.

Design doc (EN): docs/design/web-shell/web-shell-pinned-turn-prompt.md
Design doc (zh-CN): docs/design/web-shell/web-shell-pinned-turn-prompt.zh-CN.md

## Linked Issues

Extends the coverage of #16095, which implements #15683.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做什么

将固定显示当前轮次提示功能（#16095 的首版）扩展到 Split View 面板。本分支建立在 #16095（Yash Kakade 的首版）之上，补上了第二个 `TranscriptViewport` 调用点的显式开启：`ChatPane` 现在传入 `pinnedPrompt`，因此 Split View 面板会像主转录一样显示固定提示浮层。新增一个单元测试断言面板视口收到了该属性，并更新设计文档（英文 + 中文）：Split View 从「本次不包含」列表移入覆盖范围。

## 为什么需要

#15683 的问题是：在长转录中向上滚动后，丢失「当前可见输出属于哪条提示」的上下文。这个问题在 Split View 面板中同样存在，但首版有意只在主转录调用点开启。#16095 的浮层机制本身已支持面板：当设置 `pinnedPrompt` 时，跟随范围在导航条隐藏时也会运行，而这正是面板的常态（面板始终传入 `hideSessionTimeline`）。因此扩展覆盖只需要一行 opt-in 加一个回归测试，浮层本身没有任何改动。

## 评审测试计划

### 如何验证

1. 单元测试：`cd packages/web-shell && npx vitest run client/components/ChatPane.test.tsx client/components/TranscriptViewport.pinned.test.tsx` —— 预期全部通过，包括新增的 `pins the prompt of the turn being read in its transcript viewport`（断言 mock 的面板视口收到 `pinnedPrompt`）以及 #16095 的 18 个固定浮层用例。
2. 手工验证（Split View）：在 Split View 中打开两个会话，在一个面板里运行一个长轮次，将面板转录滚动到提示行之上 —— 预期面板顶部出现带该轮次提示标签的固定浮层；滚回提示行 —— 预期浮层隐藏。`web-shell.pinned-prompt.spec.ts` 已为主转录覆盖的同一行为现在在面板中同样成立。
3. 类型检查/lint：`tsc -p packages/web-shell/tsconfig.json --noEmit` 与对改动文件的 eslint 通过（`WorkspaceFileBrowser.tsx` 针对已发布的 `@pierre/trees@1.0.0-beta.6` 类型存在一个与本次改动无关的既有错误，在本分支基线的 `main` 上同样存在，不在本 PR 范围内）。

### 证据（前后对比）

之前：在 Split View 中，将面板转录滚动到提示行之上时什么都看不到 —— 没有任何标签说明当前可见输出属于哪条提示（即 #15683 中针对主转录报告的情况，也是本次扩展的起点）。之后：面板显示与主转录相同的固定浮层（已在本地 Web Shell 中验证面板调用点开启后的效果）。待 #16095 基础合并且 e2e 环境可用后，可补充前后对比截图。

### 测试环境

|     操作系统     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |  ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️    |
|  🐧 Linux  | ⚠️    |

### 环境（可选）

本地 `pnpm` 检出本分支；单元测试与类型检查直接运行（单元级断言不需要 daemon 运行时）。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或权衡：很低。改动是第二个既有 `TranscriptViewport` 调用点上的单个 opt-in 属性；浮层本身及其约束（不改变布局、`pointer-events: none`、`aria-hidden`）和跟随范围行为均无变化，且已由 #16095 的单元与 e2e 套件针对主转录覆盖。
- 未验证 / 范围之外：未新增面板专属的 e2e 场景（Split View 测试台）；既有 e2e 规格针对主转录。浮层与极窄面板的交互仅由 #16095 已有的 CSS 限幅覆盖。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：无。无协议、公共 API 或设置变更。

设计文档（英文）：docs/design/web-shell/web-shell-pinned-turn-prompt.md
设计文档（中文）：docs/design/web-shell/web-shell-pinned-turn-prompt.zh-CN.md

## 关联问题

扩展 #16095 的覆盖范围；#16095 实现的是 #15683。

</details>

prs.title: chore(managed-agent): deduplicate verification Failsafe profiles and land #17139 follow-ups
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Hoists the shared Maven integration-test plugin version and execution binding into the verification module's plugin management so the fifteen gate profiles inherit them instead of repeating identical boilerplate XML, and closes the non-blocking post-merge review items from the convergence-alignment change: the embedding-isolation regression now covers every declared managed scheduler and executor pool (including the capability-gated ones) rather than a subset, and the release Javadoc guard now also rejects the two warning-demotion properties and a continue-on-error bypass on the publication step. The bilingual convergence, ratchet-trim and retirement design records are synchronized with the merged state.

## Why it's needed

The gate profiles repeated the same plugin version and execution block fifteen times, so any change to the binding had to be made in fifteen places. The earlier embedding pin named only five pools while sixteen exist, and the Javadoc guard missed two properties that demote doclint errors to warnings plus a step-level continue-on-error, each of which would let a broken Javadoc publish to an immutable repository. Two design documents also still described the profile deduplication as blocked by a pin that has since been removed, contradicting the merged convergence record.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Run the script meta-tests that parse the verification POM and the release workflow (they assert each profile's selection, timeout, Surefire skip and the Javadoc guard), run the embedding regression test, and run both Checkstyle executions. To confirm the deduplication is behavior-preserving, generate the effective POM for a few representative profiles (mysql-integration, hosted-harness-mysql, o4-mysql-gates, event-transport-broker-gates) and check the integration-test plugin still resolves the same version, the same integration-test/verify goals and the same merged system properties. Profiles that do not declare the integration-test plugin (fault-gates, central-release) must not gain a new execution.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A (build/test configuration and docs). Local results: 285 script meta-tests passed; the embedding test class 9/9 including the new declared-pool assertion; both Checkstyle executions 0 violations; effective-POM version/goals/system-properties identical for the four representative profiles.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |  N/A   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### Environment (optional)

JDK 21 + Maven 3.9 with a task-isolated local repository; Node for the script meta-tests. Full unit/H2, SpotBugs, MySQL and Hosted gates left to CI.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: none intended — profile selection, timeouts and Surefire behavior are unchanged and are asserted by the meta-tests; the embedding and Javadoc changes only widen coverage.
- Not validated / out of scope: full Maven verify, MySQL/Hosted profiles and the release workflow end-to-end run (CI).
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.
- Design documents updated (both languages): [convergence EN](docs/design/2026-11-12-managed-agent-preproduction-convergence.md) / [ZH](docs/design/2026-11-12-managed-agent-preproduction-convergence.zh-CN.md); [ratchet-trim EN](docs/design/2026-11-12-managed-verification-ratchet-trim.md) / [ZH](docs/design/2026-11-12-managed-verification-ratchet-trim.zh-CN.md); [retirement EN](docs/design/managed-runtime-0263-test-repair.md) / [ZH](docs/design/managed-runtime-0263-test-repair.zh-CN.md).

## Linked Issues

Follow-up to #17139 (post-merge review items); part of the pre-production convergence effort. No auto-close.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做什么

把共享的 Maven 集成测试插件版本与执行绑定上移到 verification 模块的 pluginManagement，使 15 个门禁 profile 继承而非重复相同的样板 XML；并收尾收敛对齐变更合并后评审留下的非阻塞项：嵌入隔离回归现在覆盖每一个声明的 managed 调度器与执行器池（含能力门控的池）而非子集；发布 Javadoc 守卫现在另外拒绝两个把 doclint 错误降级为警告的属性以及发布步骤上的 continue-on-error 绕过。双语收敛、棘轮裁剪与退役设计记录同步到已合并状态。

## 为什么需要

门禁 profile 把同一插件版本与执行块重复了 15 次，改绑定要改 15 处。早先嵌入钉子只点名 5 个池而实际有 16 个；Javadoc 守卫漏了两个降级属性和步骤级 continue-on-error，任一都会让坏 Javadoc 发布到不可变仓库。两份设计文档仍把 profile 去重描述为被一个已删除的钉死阻塞，与已合并的收敛记录矛盾。

## 评审测试计划

### 如何验证

跑解析 verification POM 与发布工作流的脚本元测试（它们断言各 profile 的选择、超时、Surefire skip 与 Javadoc 守卫），跑嵌入回归测试，跑两个 Checkstyle execution。为确认去重保持行为，对几个代表 profile（mysql-integration、hosted-harness-mysql、o4-mysql-gates、event-transport-broker-gates）生成 effective POM，检查集成测试插件仍解析出相同版本、相同 integration-test/verify goals、相同合并系统属性。不声明集成测试插件的 profile（fault-gates、central-release）不得新增执行。

### 证据（Before & After）

N/A（构建/测试配置与文档）。本地结果：285 个脚本元测试通过；嵌入测试类 9/9 含新增声明池断言；两个 Checkstyle execution 0 违规；四个代表 profile 的 effective-POM 版本/goals/系统属性一致。

prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds a "Scheduled tasks" option to the Web Shell sidebar's Session source switch (and the archived switch). Selecting it lists exactly the bound controller sessions of persistent scheduled tasks — the conversations a task's prompts are injected into — which today have no place in the session list. The default "Tasks" tab is unchanged for daemons with session source metadata: bound controller sessions stay outside the default catalog, as the session-source-filter design documents. On a daemon without that metadata, the bound conversation stays listed on the default tab, but is now grouped under its task instead of standing as an independent row. On the new tab the bound session renders with the existing clock marker and groups under its task, mirroring how per-run `scheduled_task_run:` sessions are grouped in the Tasks tab. The daemon needed no change: the public `sourceType` query parameter already accepts arbitrary source types and matches them exactly, and `scheduled_task` was never part of the hidden-catalog exclusion list.

## Why it's needed

Issue #12576: bound controller sessions of scheduled tasks are invisible in the sidebar. The root cause was confirmed by @doudouOUC — the default catalog's `sourceType=default` filter only admits `undefined`/`default`/`qwen-live`, and the sidebar offered no way to switch to the `scheduled_task` catalog. The alternative path (Scheduled tasks panel → task card → View conversation) still exists and is untouched; this adds a direct discoverability affordance. The earlier attempt (#11635, closed unmerged) took a broader approach; its deferred review findings live in #11738 and are not touched by this PR (the archive/delete guards there key on the live task binding, which is unchanged here).

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Create a persistent scheduled task (e.g. via the Scheduled tasks panel with "Dedicated task conversation"), run it once so the bound controller session exists. In the Web Shell sidebar, open the Session source switch: "Tasks" does not list the bound conversation (unchanged); "Scheduled tasks" lists it, clock marker included, grouped under the task. Archived variant: archive the bound conversation and check the archived switch. Non-UI evidence below (unit tests).

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A (unit-level; sidebar tab is a two-option segmented control gaining a third option).

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ⚠️ not tested |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested |
|  🐧 Linux  | ✅ tested |

### Environment (optional)

Docker `node:22-bookworm` (aarch64): `npx vitest run --pool=forks` on the three touched test files, `npx tsc --noEmit` (packages/web-shell), `npx eslint --max-warnings 0` and `npx prettier --check` on the touched files. A/B negative control: the new tests fail against the pre-change sources (red before / green after).

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the new tab is a pure opt-in client-side switch plus one exact-match source value already accepted by the daemon; default catalog behavior is untouched.
- Not validated / out of scope: the deferred findings of #11738 (task-binding guards, cron final-branch stamping) — separate follow-ups; Windows/macOS local runs pending.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.

prs.title: fix(web-shell): keep the report final when a background shell ack follows
prs.body:
## What this PR does

The collapsed Web Shell view of a turn shows only the turn's "final answer" plus non-hideable rows, and `findFinalAnswerIndex` picked the last non-empty assistant message with no later work step. A background shell completion notification is a system message, not a turn boundary, so when a background shell command finished mid-turn the model's bookkeeping ack to the notification became the "final answer" and the real report was hidden behind the chevron.

This PR teaches `findFinalAnswerIndex` to skip a shell-completion ack: an assistant reply is no longer treated as the final answer when it (1) follows a background-turn marker, (2) is preceded only by thinking blocks after that marker (no further work, no user steering), (3) the marker is a shell completion, and (4) the turn already produced a candidate answer before the marker. Agent/peer completions — whose summaries the parent synthesizes into its reply — and genuine post-marker continuations are never reclassified.

A second bot-review round asked for the fold decision to be one testable rule instead of a set of ad-hoc guards. The rule now lives in `utils/shellCompletionAck.ts` as a single `spanClear` scan shared by the collapse path and `/copy`: a reply folds only when the nearest preceding marker is a shell completion, the turn already produced an assistant main answer before that marker (a raw machine notification never licenses a fold), and only thoughts, markers, daemon bookkeeping rows, and turn chrome sit in the spans around the reply. Turn chrome (a new `isTurnChrome` row class) makes a `turn_outputs` card spliced into the turn transparent instead of a veto. The `turnAwaitsBackgroundSummary` gate passes the rule with ack-skipping off, so a completed shell turn still collapses, and `/copy` bounds its span at the turn's own end. The now-redundant `includeBackgroundNotifications` parameter was deleted rather than reconciled across call sites.

Round 3 addresses a second hijack of the same heuristic reported in #13998: a
turn that ends with a one-line completion note (a Todo Stop Guard or similar
closer) after a substantial answer folds the report and shows the note. A new
resolution step in the collapse path (`resolveDeliverableAnswerIdx` in
`MessageList.tsx`) now stands the final candidate only if it is a deliverable
— an ordinary assistant reply (never an agent reply) of at least 1000
characters carrying a Markdown heading. Otherwise the nearest preceding
deliverable in the same turn stands instead, and with none the original
candidate stands (fail-toward-showing-more, so nothing is hidden). The step
applies in the collapse path only, composes with the shell-ack fold (a
well-formed ack never carries report text), and leaves the shared
`findFinalAnswerIndex` and the `/copy` span untouched. The round also repairs
the integration typecheck: `shellCompletionAck.ts` imported
`../adapters/types` without the `.js` extension required by the
integration-tests nodenext module resolution.

Round 4 relaxes the deliverable predicate after a live report against the
patched build: a final report that opens with a plain summary line or a pipe
table (no Markdown heading) was folded in favor of an earlier headed plan,
hiding the actual result. `isDeliverableAnswer` no longer requires a heading
— a deliverable is an ordinary assistant reply (never an agent reply) of at
least 1000 characters. The 1000-character floor alone keeps short closers and
guard lines out of the rule; the heading requirement was the only
over-restrictive part of the predicate.

## Why it's needed

When a long-running background shell command (e.g. a scheduled/cron job) completes, the user's turn ends with a short model ack ("Done.") while the actual multi-paragraph report written moments earlier disappears from the collapsed view. The user sees only the ack and must expand the chevron to find the deliverable; in practice the report was effectively invisible. Reported in #13998 with a deterministic repro.

A second report with the same root cause followed: a long-running session
whose final answer was a multi-paragraph report (3,360 characters) closed
with a short Todo Stop Guard line. The guard line — a plain assistant message
with no later work step — won the final-answer scan, and the collapsed turn
showed only the closer. The deliverable rule keeps the report visible in this
shape: the short final line stands only when no deliverable precedes it.

A third report with the same root cause followed, observed on a live patched
build: a session whose final answer was a heading-less report (1,332
characters, a pipe table) collapsed to an earlier 3,291-character headed plan
line — the turn showed the plan, not the result. The heading requirement in
the deliverable predicate was over-restrictive for this shape; round 4
removes it, leaving the length floor as the only gate.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

The behavior lives in `findFinalAnswerIndex` (packages/web-shell/client/components/MessageList.tsx) and is exercised at the `applyTurnCollapse` level. Five new tests in `components/MessageList.test.ts`:

- `retains the main reply when a background task ack follows the notification marker` — the production shape (report → shell marker → ack); **fails on main, passes with this PR**
- `keeps the last ordinary reply final when no background marker is present` — regression guard for the no-marker path
- `keeps the post-marker summary final for an agent completion` — agent summaries stay final even with a thinking-only gap
- `keeps the reply final when further work follows the shell marker` — work after the marker makes the reply a real continuation
- `keeps the reply final when the user steers after the shell marker` — steering after the marker makes the reply a real continuation

Round 2 added the unified rule's test surface: 10 new tests in `components/MessageList.test.ts` (a `turn_outputs` card no longer vetoes the fold; the gate collapses a completed shell turn; the raw notification is neither the final answer nor a fold license; two consecutive background completions fold both acks; no answer before the marker keeps the ack final; a `completed` marker status still folds; work or a parallel-agent group after the main answer keeps the ack final; the timeline detail is the ack, not the notification), 4 in `utils/copyCommand.test.ts` (the copy span is bounded at the turn's end), and 2 in `components/MessageList.dom.test.tsx` (the footer lands on the main reply with a `turn_outputs` card present). Every mutant named in the round-2 review is pinned red by one of these tests and green on the fixed code.

Round 3 adds the `turn-collapse deliverable final answer` block: 8 new tests
in `components/MessageList.test.ts` (the report stands over a short closer;
long text without a heading does not stand; a plain interim note before the
report keeps the report final; the last of several deliverables stands; a
headed reply below the length floor does not stand; the tagged shell ack
still folds next to a report; an agent reply is never a deliverable; a reply
at exactly the length floor stands). Each named mutant is pinned red:
candidate-check, heading-check, length-floor, backward-scan.

Round 4 reworks one of the eight (long text without a heading now stands over
the short closer — the v2 expectation was the bug) and adds the live-repro
regression: a heading-less long final keeps standing even when a headed plan
precedes it. The deliverable block now has 9 tests; every mutant is still
pinned red — candidate-check, length-floor, backward-scan (the heading-check
mutant is retired with the heading requirement).

Run:

```
cd packages/web-shell
npx vitest run --config vitest.config.ts components/MessageList.test.ts
```

Expected: all green, including the five round-1 tests, the 16 new round-2 tests, and the pre-existing turn-collapse suite.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Unit-level (the collapsed rows are exactly the user-visible rows). Before — on main, the new repro test is RED:

```
 FAIL  components/MessageList.test.ts > retains the main reply when a background task ack follows the notification marker
AssertionError: expected false to be true
```

After — with the PR, the targeted suites are green:

```
 Test Files  3 passed (3)
      Tests  398 passed (398)
```

(`MessageList.test.ts` 194 + `MessageList.dom.test.tsx` 186 + `copyCommand.test.ts` 18.) Full web-shell `client` on this head: 11 545/11 546 tests across 429/430 files — the single failure is the bundle-ceiling assertion in `build-artifact.test.ts`, documented in Risk & Scope below.

Round 3 — with the deliverable rule, the targeted suites are green on the
round-3 head (Docker, node:22-bookworm, head bbe794f839):

```
 Test Files  2 passed (2)
      Tests  438 passed (438)
```

(`MessageList.test.ts` 202, including the 8 new deliverable tests, +
`transcriptToMessages.test.ts` 236.) Each of the four named mutants
(candidate-check, heading-check, length-floor, backward-scan) goes red
against the fixed test and green on the pristine code; the integration
typecheck this round repairs is at 0.

Round 4 — with the heading requirement dropped, the deliverable suite is
green on the round-4 head c6d852fa9cb2b4207d0cbd6d6c3649be080a1f84 (Docker, node:22-bookworm):

```
 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  203 passed (203)
```

(`MessageList.test.ts` 203, including the 9 deliverable tests; the new
regression is red on the round-3 code and green on the round-4 head.)

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ✅   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### Environment

Docker `node:22-bookworm` container running the web-shell vitest suites (tests cannot run on the host). The full web-shell suite ran on head 5ae80d84 on all three platforms: macOS (host, node 22.23.1, darwin-arm64) 430/430 files, 11 514/11 514 tests; Linux (Docker, node:22-bookworm, aarch64) full 11 483/11 514 (31 failures across 4 files: build-artifact 28 = dist not built without prepare, browser-turn-notifications/BranchPickerPopover/vite-config 1 each = full-suite load artifacts; all 4 green in isolation with dist: 28/28, 42/42, 145/145, 21/21) with tsc and eslint at 0; Windows (UTM Win11 ARM VM, node 22.23.3) full 11 512/11 514 — the 2 failures are 5s vite-startup timeouts under WinOnArm emulation, reproduced in isolation (build-artifact 27/28, vite-config 20/21 — the documented platform-timing class), tsc at 0. The round-2 head 049f77a802 was re-verified in Docker (node:22-bookworm): full `client` 11 545/11 546 (the single failure is the bundle-ceiling assertion below), the three targeted suites 398/398, and eslint/prettier clean on the changed files. The original bug was observed live in the Web Shell on macOS (Desktop 0.25.0) with a cron-scheduled background shell task. The round-3 head bbe794f839 was re-verified in Docker (node:22-bookworm): the targeted suites 438/438, integration and web-shell tsc at 0, eslint and prettier clean, and the four named mutants pinned red. The round-4 head c6d852fa9cb2b4207d0cbd6d6c3649be080a1f84 was re-verified in Docker (node:22-bookworm): `MessageList.test.ts` 203/203, integration and web-shell tsc at 0, eslint and prettier clean on the changed files.

## Risk & Scope

- Deliverable threshold: a genuine final line of under 1000 characters that
  follows a substantial report now yields to the report (the note remains
  visible on expand). This is the intended tradeoff of the rule; turns with
  no deliverable are untouched (fail-toward-showing-more). The 1000-character
  floor keeps ordinary short answers ("Done.", guard lines) out of the rule.
  Round 4 dropped the heading requirement: heading-less reports (pipe tables,
  plain summary lines) count as deliverables, fixing the live repro where a
  1,332-character pipe-table report lost to a headed plan line.
- Bundle size: the round-2 finding (the transcript entry measuring 1,330,262 bytes stylesheet-stripped, 762 bytes over the then-1,329,500-byte ceiling) is superseded upstream: main removed the fixed ceiling itself (`test(web-shell): remove fixed transcript bundle size ceiling`, #14703), which this head carries — `build-artifact.test.ts` is fully green (40/40) on the round-3 head and no further bundle change is required. The round-2 module compaction (−326 bytes) remains in the diff.
- Main risk or tradeoff: a genuine reply to a shell completion could be misclassified as an ack and hidden. Mitigated: the reclassification requires all four conditions simultaneously (shell-kind marker, thinking-only gap, prior main candidate, no later work/steering); agent/peer completions and any real continuation keep their reply final. All four boundaries are pinned by the new tests.
- Not validated / out of scope: visual e2e (visuals harness); the change is covered at the `collapseItems` unit level, which decides exactly which rows render.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.

## Linked Issues

Closes #13998

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

Web Shell 的折叠视图只展示一轮对话的"最终回答"加上不可隐藏的行，而 `findFinalAnswerIndex` 选取的是最后一个"其后没有工作步骤"的非空 assistant 消息。后台 shell 命令完成时的通知是 system 消息，不构成回合边界，因此当后台 shell 命令在回合中完成时，模型对通知的事务性应答（ack）会被当作"最终回答"，真正的报告就被藏在折叠箭头后面。

本 PR 让 `findFinalAnswerIndex` 学会跳过 shell 完成应答：当一条 assistant 回复 (1) 紧跟后台回合标记（background-turn marker）之后，(2) 标记之后到该回复之间只有思考块（没有进一步的工作、没有用户介入），(3) 该标记是 shell 完成，且 (4) 回合在标记之前已经产生了候选回答时，它不再被当作最终回答。agent/peer 完成（其摘要会被父级综合进回复）以及标记后的真实续写永远不会被重新归类。

第二轮 bot 评审要求把折叠判定从一组临时守卫变成一条可测试的规则。规则现在位于 `utils/shellCompletionAck.ts`，作为折叠路径与 `/copy` 共享的一次 `spanClear` 扫描：只有当最近的前置标记是 shell 完成、该标记之前回合已产生 assistant 主回答（原始机器通知永远不构成折叠许可）、且回复两侧的区间内只有思考块、标记、daemon 记账行与回合 chrome 时，回复才被折叠。回合 chrome（新增 `isTurnChrome` 行类）使插入回合中的 `turn_outputs` 卡片透明而非一票否决。`turnAwaitsBackgroundSummary` 门以关闭 ack 跳过的方式调用规则，因此完成的 shell 回合仍能折叠；`/copy` 的区间现在以回合自身结尾为界。冗余的 `includeBackgroundNotifications` 参数被删除，而不是在各调用点间协调。

第三轮处理 #13998 中同一启发式被劫持的第二个形态：回合在实质性回答之后以简短的
完成注记（Todo Stop Guard 或类似收尾行）结束时，折叠视图会把报告折掉、只显示收尾行。
折叠路径中新增的解析步骤（`MessageList.tsx` 中的 `resolveDeliverableAnswerIdx`）
现在只有在最终候选本身是"交付物"时才让它站住——交付物定义为普通 assistant 回复
（agent 回复永远不算）、至少 1000 字符且带 Markdown 标题。否则，同一回合中最近的
先前交付物代替站住；若没有任何交付物，原候选站住（fail-toward-showing-more，
即不额外隐藏任何内容）。该步骤只作用于折叠路径，与 shell-ack 折叠规则组合
（规范的 ack 从不携带报告文本），共享的 `findFinalAnswerIndex` 与 `/copy`
区间不受影响。同一提交还修复了集成类型检查：`shellCompletionAck.ts` 导入
`../adapters/types` 时缺少 integration-tests 的 nodenext 模块解析所要求的 `.js` 扩展名。

第四轮针对打在打过补丁的构建上的现场报告放宽了交付物谓词：以普通总结行或
管道表格开头（无 Markdown 标题）的最终报告，会被折叠成一个更早的带标题计划，
实际结果被隐藏。`isDeliverableAnswer` 不再要求标题——交付物即普通 assistant
回复（agent 回复永远不算）、至少 1000 字符。仅靠 1000 字符下限就能把短收尾
行和 guard 行排除在规则之外；标题要求是谓词中唯一过严的部分。

## 为什么需要

当一个长时间运行的后台 shell 命令（例如定时/cron 任务）完成时，用户回合以一个简短的模型应答（"Done."）结束，而此前刚写出的多段落实际报告从折叠视图中消失。用户只能看到应答，必须展开箭头才能找到真正的交付内容——实际上报告基本不可见。已在 #13998 中报告并附可复现步骤。

随后出现同一根因的第二例报告：一个长会话的最终回答是多段落报告（3,360 字符），
末尾以简短的 Todo Stop Guard 行收尾。该 Guard 行——一条其后没有工作步骤的普通
assistant 消息——赢得了最终回答扫描，折叠回合只显示收尾行。交付物规则在这种形态下
保留报告可见：只有当收尾行之前没有交付物时，这条简短的最终行才站住。

第三例同源报告出现在打过补丁的构建上：一个会话的最终回答是无标题报告
（1,332 字符，管道表格），折叠后展示的却是更早的一条 3,291 字符带标题计划行
——回合显示的是计划，而不是结果。交付物谓词中的标题要求对这种形态过严；
第四轮将其移除，长度下限成为唯一的门。

- `retains the main reply when a background task ack follows the notification marker`——生产环境形态（报告 → shell 标记 → 应答）；**在 main 上失败，本 PR 通过**

- `keeps the post-marker summary final for an agent completion`——即使只有思考块间隔，agent 摘要仍保持最终
- `keeps the reply final when further work follows the shell marker`——标记后还有工作时，回复是真实续写
- `keeps the reply final when the user steers after the shell marker`——标记后用户介入时，回复是真实续写

第二轮新增了统一规则的测试面：`components/MessageList.test.ts` 10 个新测试（`turn_outputs` 卡片不再一票否决折叠；门使完成的 shell 回合折叠；原始通知既不是最终回答也不构成折叠许可；两个连续后台完成折叠两条 ack；标记前无回答时 ack 保持最终；标记带 `completed` 状态仍折叠；主回答后的工作或并行 agent 组使 ack 保持最终；时间线详情是 ack 而非通知）、`utils/copyCommand.test.ts` 4 个（复制区间以回合结尾为界）、`components/MessageList.dom.test.tsx` 2 个（存在 `turn_outputs` 卡片时 footer 落在主回答上）。第二轮评审点名的每个突变体都被其中一个测试固定为红、在修复代码上为绿。

prs.title: fix(web-shell, cli): localize Goal budget stop-reason
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Localizes the Goal budget stop-reason at render time (scope B of #15954), so a token/turn/active-time budget exhaustion reads in the client language instead of the EN prose persisted by the core. The core stop-reason generators (`goalTokenBudgetReason` and friends) and the wire/`lastReason` storage are untouched — the persisted EN sentence stays the fallback, and the machine-readable half of the stop (`limitKind` + the budget figure) is already on the Goal record, so composition happens purely at the render sites.

- CLI: a new `composeGoalBudgetReason` helper (`packages/cli/src/ui/utils/goal-budget-reason.ts`) plus 15 `goal.reason.*` keys in all 9 shipped locale files (EN, RU, ZH, ZH-TW, DE, FR, JA, PT, CA), with the keys registered in `scripts/check-i18n.ts` exceptions. Render sites: the goal card (`describeGoalCard` takes an optional budget-reason closure), the transcript `GoalStatusMessage`, the opentui `transcript-view`, and the non-interactive `/goal` output (`formatGoalState`).
- Web Shell: the same helper in `client/utils/goalBudgetReason.ts` plus the 15 keys in the en/zh-CN/ru catalogs. `withGoalBudgetContext` threads `limitKind` + `tokenBudget`/`turnBudget`/`activeTimeBudgetMs` from the canonical goal state carried in the same daemon event onto the goal status card, and the transcript card and `GoalsDialog` compose the phrase from it, falling back to the raw `lastReason` when the record is not a budget stop (or predates `limitKind`).
- EN parity is pinned by tests: for an en client the composed phrase is byte-identical to the core generator output, so English users see exactly what was always persisted.

## Why it's needed

#15954: when the UI language is not English, a budget stop still renders the EN sentence the core wrote into `lastReason` (e.g. a ru/zh-CN user sees "The Goal spent its autonomous token budget (30,000,000 tokens). Resume the Goal to authorize another budget window, or clear it."). Every other Goal stop reason is already localized; the budget reason was the remaining gap.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- CLI helper: `packages/cli/src/ui/utils/goal-budget-reason.test.ts` (23 tests) — EN byte-parity with `goalTokenBudgetReason`/`goalTurnBudgetReason`/`goalActiveTimeBudgetReason` across 1/2/30 000 000/1 000 005 tokens, 1/2/20 turns and sub-minute/whole-minute budgets; RU plural forms (1/2/5/11/21/101/102/111) and NBSP grouping; fallbacks return `undefined` (no `limitKind`, evidence sentinel, non-budget kind against a permissive dictionary — pins the budget-kind gate, missing figure, keyless dictionary).
- CLI render points: `goal-card-view.test.ts` (composed reason + raw fallback for a pre-`limitKind` record) and the `nonInteractiveCli.test.ts` `/goal` cases (EN composition with the closure, raw without it).
- Web Shell: `client/utils/goalBudgetReason.test.ts` (same parity/decline matrix over `getTranslator`), `client/i18n.test.ts` (the 15 keys present in every shipped catalog, EN pinned to the core generator prose), `components/messages/GoalStatusMessage.test.tsx` (RU composition, EN parity, raw fallback, serialize/parse round-trip of the threaded fields), `DaemonSessionProvider.test.tsx` (threading: budget fields land on the card only when the canonical goal state carries them; non-record goal state is a no-op), `components/dialogs/GoalsDialog.test.tsx` (RU composed reason on a budget-limited Goal; raw reason kept for a non-budget stop).
- Mutation proof (all RED, evidence below): M1 kind-gate bypassed → the non-budget-kind decline test under a permissive dictionary fails (the gate is otherwise shadowed by the sentence-key lookup); M2 form always `many` → the singular unit test fails; M3 render drops the raw `lastReason` fallback → the legacy-record test fails; M4 figure locale pinned to `en-US` → the RU NBSP-grouping test fails; M5 figure-presence check removed → the missing-figure decline test fails.
- Mutation proof run (hermetic fresh-volume Docker `node:22-bookworm`, `tools/mutation-harness/harness.mjs`, 2026-11-14): each of the 5 mutants applied to the branch head fails exactly one named test (`RED 1 failed`); post-restore sanity suites pass (rc=0 ×2), all mutated files are byte-identical to the pre-run snapshot, and `GIT-STATUS: unchanged by harness (clean restore)`. Summary line: `SUMMARY: 5 RED / 0 SURVIVED / 0 issue(s) of 5 mutants`.

- Full gates, in Docker (node:22-bookworm one-shot containers, `--network=host`): `tools/upstream-pr-check.sh` over the PR branch — packages/cli `--vitest "src"` (1457 test files / 49655 tests), packages/web-shell `--vitest "client"` (548 test files / 15272 tests — all pass), tsc `--noEmit`, eslint `--max-warnings 0`, prettier `--check` on the changed files — all green; the only cli-suite failures are 19 in the `src/serve` real-process suites, which reproduce identically on the unmodified `upstream/main` base (A/B verified: empty diff of the FAIL lines) — pre-existing/environmental, covered by CI lanes on disposable runners — plus one `BackgroundTasksDialog` timeout under full-suite load, in a file this PR does not touch (isolated single-file rerun passes — flake, not a regression); plus `pnpm exec tsx scripts/check-i18n.ts` → exit 0.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before (ru client, budget stop): the card shows the persisted EN sentence `The Goal spent its autonomous token budget (30,000,000 tokens). Resume the Goal to authorize another budget window, or clear it.`
After: `Цель исчерпала автономный бюджет токенов (30 000 000 токенов). Возобновите цель, чтобы выдать ещё одно окно бюджета, или снимите её.` (NBSP grouping; zh-CN: `目标已用完自主 token 预算（30,000,000 token）。恢复目标以授权另一个预算窗口，或将其清除。`)

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ✅ |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ |
|  🐧 Linux  | ✅ |

- macOS: Docker gates (node:22-bookworm) on the macOS host (Apple Silicon) — full cli + web-shell suites, tsc, eslint, prettier, check-i18n (numbers under Environment).
- Linux: the same Docker gates (the gate image is the Linux node:22-bookworm; CI lanes cover the Linux runner).
- Windows: deferred by decision — the change is platform-independent (pure TS i18n composition; node/jsdom tests, no platform-specific code) and is covered by the CI lanes; no local UTM Windows run this round.

### Environment

Host: macOS (Apple Silicon); one-shot Docker containers `node:22-bookworm` (Node v22.23.3, pnpm v11.24.0, `--network=host`). Branch head: `01182dc53b` (`feat/goal-budget-reason-i18n`, base `upstream/main` `65e1f1aeaa`, 7 commits). Gate runs: 2026-11-11/14 (cli full + mutation on 11-14; web-shell on 11-12, code unchanged since).

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: render-time composition only — the core generators, the wire format and the persisted `lastReason` are unchanged, so an older client (or any fallback path) still renders the EN prose it always rendered. A stale budget context cannot leak into a resumed window: the core reducer clears `limitKind` on resume, and the web-shell threads the fields only from the canonical state of the same event that carries the stop card.
- Not validated / out of scope: no local Windows runner (⚠️ row above); web-shell catalogs beyond en/zh-CN/ru do not exist to ship; non-budget stop reasons are out of scope (unchanged).
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. The new card fields (`limitKind`, budget figures) are additive and ignored by any consumer that does not read them.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #15954

<summary>中文说明</summary>

## What this PR does

在渲染时本地化 Goal 预算停止原因（#15954 的 B 范围），使 token/轮次/活跃时间预算耗尽的提示按客户端语言显示，而不是 core 持久化的英文句子。core 的停止原因生成器（`goalTokenBudgetReason` 等）与 wire/`lastReason` 存储保持不变——持久化的英文句子仍是回退值；停止的机器可读部分（`limitKind` + 预算数值）本就在 Goal 记录上，因此组合完全发生在渲染点。

- CLI：新增 `composeGoalBudgetReason` 助手（`packages/cli/src/ui/utils/goal-budget-reason.ts`），并在全部 9 个已发布语言文件（EN、RU、ZH、ZH-TW、DE、FR、JA、PT、CA）中加入 15 个 `goal.reason.*` 键，同时在 `scripts/check-i18n.ts` 的例外清单中登记。渲染点：goal 卡片（`describeGoalCard` 接受可选的预算原因闭包）、transcript `GoalStatusMessage`、opentui `transcript-view`、非交互 `/goal` 输出（`formatGoalState`）。
- Web Shell：`client/utils/goalBudgetReason.ts` 中的同一助手，以及 en/zh-CN/ru 三个目录中的 15 个键。`withGoalBudgetContext` 把同一 daemon 事件中 canonical goal state 携带的 `limitKind` + `tokenBudget`/`turnBudget`/`activeTimeBudgetMs` 透传到 goal 状态卡片；transcript 卡片与 `GoalsDialog` 据此组合句子，当记录不是预算停止（或早于 `limitKind`）时回退到原始 `lastReason`。
- EN 一致性由测试钉住：en 客户端下组合出的句子与 core 生成器输出逐字节相同，英语用户看到的与一直持久化的完全一致。

## Why it's needed

#15954：当 UI 语言不是英语时，预算停止仍渲染 core 写入 `lastReason` 的英文句子（例如 ru/zh-CN 用户看到 "The Goal spent its autonomous token budget (30,000,000 tokens). Resume the Goal to authorize another budget window, or clear it."）。其他 Goal 停止原因均已本地化，预算原因是剩下的缺口。

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- CLI 助手：`packages/cli/src/ui/utils/goal-budget-reason.test.ts`（23 个测试）——与 `goalTokenBudgetReason`/`goalTurnBudgetReason`/`goalActiveTimeBudgetReason` 的 EN 逐字节一致性（1/2/30 000 000/1 000 005 token、1/2/20 轮次、亚分钟与整分钟预算）；RU 复数形式（1/2/5/11/21/101/102/111）与 NBSP 分组；回退返回 `undefined`（无 `limitKind`、evidence 哨兵、宽松字典下的非预算 kind——钉住预算 kind 门禁、缺数值、无键字典）。
- CLI 渲染点：`goal-card-view.test.ts`（组合原因 + 早于 `limitKind` 的记录回退 raw）与 `nonInteractiveCli.test.ts` 的 `/goal` 用例（带闭包时 EN 组合、不带时 raw）。
- Web Shell：`client/utils/goalBudgetReason.test.ts`（基于 `getTranslator` 的同一一致性/回退矩阵）、`client/i18n.test.ts`（15 个键在每个已发布目录中齐全，EN 钉住 core 生成器文案）、`components/messages/GoalStatusMessage.test.tsx`（RU 组合、EN 一致、raw 回退、透传字段的序列化/解析往返）、`DaemonSessionProvider.test.tsx`（透传：仅当 canonical goal state 携带字段时卡片才带字段；非 record 的 goal state 为 no-op）、`components/dialogs/GoalsDialog.test.tsx`（预算受限 Goal 的 RU 组合原因；非预算停止保留 raw）。

prs.title: feat(web-shell): open inline rename on single click of a session title
prs.body:
## What this PR does

In the Web Shell, the session title shown at the top of the session window (the pane header) is display-only plain text: clicking it does nothing, and the only inline rename is a double-click on the session row in the left sidebar. This change makes the pane title its own click target: a single click on the title (or Enter when it is focused) opens an inline rename input in place of the title text — prefilled with the current name, auto-focused and selected; Enter saves the new name through the same session-scoped rename API the sidebar's double-click and the `/rename` command use (for standalone sessions, the workspace client's standalone rename), Escape or blur cancels, and an empty name simply closes the editor. Submitting the name unchanged (Enter without editing) also just closes the editor without any daemon write, so a no-op submission cannot persist the id-prefix placeholder on sessions without a displayName. The header input works in both the single-session view and split view — each pane's header renames that pane's session. A click that finishes a text selection on the title, a pane without a session, or a rename already in flight leaves the click inert. The title click is not stopped on its way to document, so already-open Radix surfaces (session details, context usage, branch picker) still receive the native click for deferred outside-press dismissal.

## Why it's needed

Issue #14327: the pane header is where the user identifies — and wants to act on — the session in front of them, but the title was display-only, so renaming required finding the session in the sidebar and a hard-to-discover double-click. Making the header title a direct entry point to rename matches the "click a title to edit it" affordance the issue asks for. Note: the issue was originally scoped to the sidebar; on 2026-10-17 the scope was clarified to the pane header, and this PR was reworked accordingly (the sidebar's double-click rename is unchanged). The branch was also rebased onto the then-current `main` tip (`f9de111a13`, 2026-10-20) so it applies on today's tree.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

I extended `packages/web-shell/client/components/ChatPane.test.tsx` with a 12-case suite (`ChatPane pane title single-click rename`) covering: single-click opens the inline rename input prefilled and focused; Enter saves the trimmed name and reconciles the session catalog; a split pane's title (supplied via the `title` prop) renames; standalone sessions save through the workspace client; Escape cancels without saving; blur cancels without saving; an empty name closes without saving; a click that follows a text selection does not open rename; the title is inert without a session id; a failed save is reported and the editor closes; a single title click dismisses an already-open Radix popover while starting the rename (real `@radix-ui` popover, deferred outside-press path); and submitting the name unchanged (Enter without editing) closes the editor without any daemon write. The same path is covered for the header component itself: `packages/web-shell/client/components/ChatContextHeader.test.tsx` gained a 7-case suite (`ChatContextHeader session title single-click rename`) — open/prefill/focus, Enter save with catalog reconcile, no-change bail, standalone save through the workspace client, Escape cancel, empty-name close, and inert titles (no session id, non-string content).

- Run the new tests: from the repo root, `pnpm install && pnpm --filter @qwen-code/web-shell exec vitest run --config vitest.config.ts client/components/ChatPane.test.tsx client/components/ChatContextHeader.test.tsx` — ChatPane.test.tsx 192/192 and ChatContextHeader.test.tsx 25/25 (217/217, 0 failures; both numbers include the pre-existing cases in those files, including upstream's new `pane approval mode allowlist` cases).
- Post-rebase note: upstream's new `ManagedSessionsPage.test.tsx` shell-slot tests render the pane header, which imports the `useConnection`/`useActions` SDK hooks; the file gained mocks for those hooks (the rename UI is inert there — a managed session row has no session of its own).
- Manual check: start a daemon with the Web Shell (`node packages/cli/dist/index.js serve --workspace <dir>`), open the Web Shell, then: (1) single-click the session title in the header → the inline rename input appears prefilled with the current name; (2) type a new name and press Enter → the header (and the sidebar) show the new name; (3) single-click the title again and press Escape → the input closes, the name is unchanged; (4) in split view, single-click the second pane's title → its pane's session is renamed; (5) single-click the title, type nothing, press Enter → the input closes, the name is unchanged, and no rename request reaches the daemon (visible in the network tab).

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before (upstream behavior): the pane header title was display-only; renaming required a double-click on the session row in the sidebar (see issue #14327).

After: a single click on the pane title opens the inline rename input prefilled with the current name; saving updates the header and the sidebar in the same run. The live end-to-end run (real Chrome against a daemon built from this branch, steps S0–S5) is described under "Tested on" / macOS; no screenshots are attached — the behavior is described here and in the issue.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ✅ |
| 🪟 Windows | ⏳ |
|  🐧 Linux  | ✅ |

Machine evidence (2026-10-19, run on head `b90270059bfa6750f939ee0d89a684ffcda59bff` — a previous head of this PR, force-pushed to the current head `64e3423758a29bcbd151537030208f8d7f8fcda8`):

On the current head (2026-10-20, Docker `node:22-bookworm`): targeted re-run — ChatPane.test.tsx 192/192, ChatContextHeader.test.tsx 25/25, ManagedSessionsPage.test.tsx 105/105 (322/322, 0 failures). The full-suite rows below are on the head above; CI re-runs the full suite on the current head.

- 🍏 macOS — Docker `node:22-bookworm` (aarch64) on the macOS host (host node v26.5.0 cannot run vitest-jsdom — `window.localStorage` undefined in jsdom, established environment limitation): fresh container, copy of the branch tree, `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` + root build — full web-shell client suite `vitest run --config vitest.config.ts` — 450 files / 12188 tests, all passed (12188/12188, 0 failures, 256.5s); `tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit` — clean (0 errors); `eslint` on the changed files — 0 errors; `prettier --check` on the changed files — clean. Live E2E: 6-step CDP run (real user Chrome, daemon built from the branch) — S0–S5 PASS; this E2E ran on the previous head `68117bc7e5` (same feature, built before the rebase onto the current `main` tip). The machine evidence above was run on `b90270059b` (2026-10-19), a previous head of this PR; the force-push to the current head rebased the branch onto a newer `main` tip, and within this PR's own changes the only web-shell file that differs between the two heads is `ChatPane.test.tsx` (a test-only mock identity fix, covered by the targeted re-run on the current head above). The S5 scenario was additionally verified on the current head — see the Linux e2e line below.
- 🐧 Linux — same recipe (Docker `node:22-bookworm` (aarch64), fresh container, `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`) — single fresh-container run on the macOS host (head `b90270059bfa6750f939ee0d89a684ffcda59bff`) — same numbers as the macOS row: 450 files / 12188 tests, all passed (12188/12188); tsc clean (0 errors); eslint 0 errors; prettier clean.
- 🪟 Windows — ⏳ pending: the UTM Win11 ARM VM was unavailable at publication time (full VM crash on 2026-10-18; power-on is a manual step in the UTM GUI). The earlier Windows run (ChatPane.test.tsx + tsc) was on the superseded head `f96df108d3` and is not cited here; the affected suites plus `tsc --noEmit` will be run on this head with `--pool=forks --poolOptions.forks.singleFork` and this row will be updated with the results.
- 🐧 Linux — S5 (2-pane Split View, rename of the second pane): PASS — separate Linux e2e container, 2026-10-20, PR head `64e3423758a29bcbd151537030208f8d7f8fcda8` (daemon serve built from the branch, real Chrome via CDP). Rename save produced exactly one `PATCH /session/<id>/metadata` in the daemon log with `displayName` persisted (`titleSource=manual`); Esc cancel produced 0 new PATCHes; 6 screenshots kept as local artifacts.

### Environment

macOS: Docker `node:22-bookworm` (aarch64) on macOS 26.6.2, fresh container (branch-tree copy, `--frozen-lockfile`); the live E2E used a daemon built from the branch (`node packages/cli/dist/index.js serve`) driven through real user Chrome via CDP. Linux: same Docker recipe as the macOS row. The S5 e2e used a separate e2e container (daemon built from the branch, `node packages/cli/dist/index.js serve`, real user Chrome driven via CDP). Windows (pending): UTM Win11 ARM VM (WinOnArm x64 emulation), node v22.23.3, pnpm 11.24.0, repo from the codeload archive of the branch base + sha256-verified overlay of the changed files.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: a single click on the header title now opens rename — this is the intended behavior change requested in #14327. A click that finishes a text selection keeps its old behavior (the selection guard), a pane without a session has no rename affordance, and the title click does not stop propagation, so Radix deferred outside-press dismissal is preserved (covered by the real-popover regression test).
- Not validated / out of scope: the sidebar's double-click rename and all other sidebar surfaces are untouched; the Session Overview table and the TUI are unaffected. Standalone sessions are covered (they use the workspace client's standalone rename, mirroring the `/rename` command). The Windows machine run is pending (see Tested on).
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. No API, config, or data changes.

<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

在 Web Shell 中，显示在会话窗口顶部（面板标题栏）的会话标题是纯展示文本：点击它没有任何反应，唯一的重命名入口是左侧边栏中会话行的双击。此变更使面板标题本身成为一个独立的点击目标：单击标题（或在标题聚焦时按 Enter）会在标题文本原位打开一个内联重命名输入框——预填当前名称、自动聚焦并全选；按 Enter 通过与会话行双击和 `/rename` 命令相同的会话级重命名 API 保存新名称（对于 standalone 会话，使用 workspace client 的 standalone 重命名），按 Escape 或失焦取消，空名称则直接关闭编辑框。提交与当前名称完全相同的新名称（未编辑直接按 Enter）同样只是关闭编辑框，不产生任何 daemon 写入，因此空操作提交不会为没有 displayName 的会话持久化 id 前缀占位符。该标题输入框同时支持单会话视图和分屏视图——每个面板的标题重命名该面板的会话。结束文本拖选的点击、没有会话的面板、或已有重命名正在进行时，点击保持惰性。标题点击不会 stopPropagation，因此已打开的 Radix 弹层（会话详情、上下文用量、分支选择器）仍能收到原生 document 点击以完成延迟的 outside-press 关闭。

## 为什么需要

Issue #14327：面板标题是用户识别——并想要操作——当前会话的地方，但标题此前是纯展示的，重命名需要到侧边栏找到会话并进行不易发现的双击。将面板标题变成重命名的直接入口符合该 issue 所要求的「点击标题即编辑」交互。说明：该 issue 最初的范围是侧边栏；2026-10-17 明确为面板标题后，本 PR 已按新范围重做（侧边栏的双击重命名保持不变）。分支也已变基到当时的 `main` 顶点（`f9de111a13`，2026-10-20），可以直接应用在今天的代码树上。

## 审查者测试计划

### 如何验证

我在 `packages/web-shell/client/components/ChatPane.test.tsx` 中扩展了 12 个用例的测试套件（`ChatPane pane title single-click rename`），覆盖：单击标题打开预填且聚焦的内联重命名输入框；Enter 保存修剪后的名称并同步会话目录；通过 `title` prop 提供的分屏面板标题可重命名；standalone 会话通过 workspace client 保存；Escape 取消且不保存；失焦取消且不保存；空名称关闭且不保存；结束文本拖选的点击不打开重命名；没有会话 id 时标题为惰性元素；保存失败时上报错误并关闭编辑框；单击标题时已打开的 Radix 弹层随之关闭并开始重命名（使用真实的 `@radix-ui` popover，延迟 outside-press 路径）；未编辑直接提交（Enter）时编辑框关闭且无任何 daemon 写入。标题组件自身同样覆盖：`packages/web-shell/client/components/ChatContextHeader.test.tsx` 新增 7 个用例的套件（`ChatContextHeader session title single-click rename`）——打开/预填/聚焦、Enter 保存并同步会话目录、未修改时 bail、standalone 会话通过 workspace client 保存、Escape 取消、空名称关闭、惰性标题（无会话 id、非字符串内容）。

- 运行新测试：在仓库根目录执行 `pnpm install && pnpm --filter @qwen-code/web-shell exec vitest run --config vitest.config.ts client/components/ChatPane.test.tsx client/components/ChatContextHeader.test.tsx`——ChatPane.test.tsx 192/192，ChatContextHeader.test.tsx 25/25（合计 217/217，0 失败；两个数字均包含相应文件中的既有用例，含上游新增的 pane approval mode allowlist 用例）。
- 变基后说明：上游新增的 `ManagedSessionsPage.test.tsx` shell-slot 测试会渲染面板标题栏，从而引入 `useConnection`/`useActions` SDK hook；该文件新增了对应 mock（该处重命名 UI 不生效——托管会话行没有自己的会话）。

macOS：macOS 26.6.2 上的 Docker `node:22-bookworm`（aarch64），每次运行全新容器（分支树拷贝、`--frozen-lockfile`）；实机 E2E 使用本分支构建的 daemon（`node packages/cli/dist/index.js serve`），经 CDP 驱动真实用户 Chrome。Linux：与 macOS 行相同的 Docker 配方；S5 e2e 使用独立的 e2e 容器（本分支构建的 daemon，`node packages/cli/dist/index.js serve`，经 CDP 驱动真实用户 Chrome）。Windows（待补）：UTM Win11 ARM 虚拟机（WinOnArm x64 模拟），node v22.23.3，pnpm 11.24.0，代码来自分支基线的 codeload 归档 + 变更文件的 sha256 校验覆盖层。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：单击面板标题现在打开重命名——这正是 #14327 请求的预期行为变更。结束文本拖选的点击保持原有行为（selection-guard），没有会话的面板没有重命名入口，标题点击不做 stopPropagation，因此 Radix 延迟 outside-press 关闭保持不变（由真实 popover 回归测试覆盖）。
- 未验证 / 超出范围：侧边栏的双击重命名及其他所有侧边栏表面未改动；Session Overview 表格和 TUI 不受影响。Standalone 会话已覆盖（使用 workspace client 的 standalone 重命名，与 `/rename` 命令一致）。Windows 机器跑批待补（见「测试平台」）。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：无。无 API、配置或数据变更。

## 关联 Issue

prs.title: fix(web-shell): degrade markdown images with unloadable sources to a readable chip
prs.body:
## What this PR does Markdown images in Web Shell that reference a local filesystem path — a POSIX absolute path such as `/Users/foo/screenshot.png`, a Windows drive path such as `C:\temp\shot.png`, a UNC path such as `\\server\share\shot.png`, or a `~` home path — no longer render as a broken `` placeholder. Such `src` values pass the existing same-origin URL check (any single leading `/` is accepted as a same-origin route) but are never valid browser URLs, so the image could never load. The component now detects those paths and renders a selectable monospaced chip showing the path — prefixed with the alt text when present — instead of the broken placeholder. Every rendered image additionally gets an `onError` handler: any load failure — a dead http(s) link, a missing same-origin asset, a src the sanitizer rewrote — degrades to the same chip, so the user always sees a readable source instead of an empty box. The src values the chip must display are let through the sanitizer in interactive mode, scoped to the image `src` attribute only (link hrefs keep the sanitizer): local filesystem paths and safe base64 `data:image` sources. The markdown pipeline percent-encodes backslashes before the predicate runs (`C:\…` arrives as `C:%5C…`), so the predicate accepts both the raw and the encoded separator, and the chip decodes them back to show the path the user wrote. Inline base64 data images keep rendering as real images. Document mode (transcript export) is unchanged in policy: it never writes a remote or local `src` into the export DOM, and its no-alt placeholder stays a fixed English literal because the standalone export renderer runs without the i18n provider; in interactive mode the placeholder is the i18n key `markdown.imageMissingSource` (en/zh-CN/ru). ## Why it's needed Agents legitimately emit local image references when they save a screenshot to disk and point the message at it — the user saw a broken image box where a visible, usable path should be. Making the path readable (selectable, copyable) turns a dead end into a usable reference, and the load-error fallback closes the same hole for any other unloadable src. Live reproduction in the linked issue thread. ## Reviewer Test Plan ### How to verify 1. Run the web-shell unit suite: `cd packages/web-shell && npx vitest run client/components/messages/Markdown.test.ts` (jsdom). Expected: the `markdown image fallback` tests pass — POSIX path → chip `shot — /Users/foo/shot.png` with no ``; Windows drive path → chip showing the decoded `C:\Users\foo\shot.png`; UNC path → chip `unc — \\server\share\shot.png`; local path without alt → the path alone; unsafe src without alt → the localized `(missing image source)` placeholder; `file:` scheme → chip; failed http load → chip; safe http image → unchanged ``; inline base64 data image → real ``. 2. Manually in Web Shell: send a message containing `![shot](/Users//screenshot.png)` (a path that exists on your machine). Before: broken image placeholder. After: a dashed-border chip reading `shot — /Users//screenshot.png`; the path is selectable text. ### Evidence (Before & After) Before: the reproduction screenshot in #17452 (broken `` with the local path as alt). After: the chip DOM is pinned by full-string assertions in `Markdown.test.ts` (e.g. `shot — /Users/foo/shot.png`, `C:\temp\shot.png`, `(missing image source)`); no new screenshots captured — the chip is a static CSS class (`.imageFallback`: dashed border, muted mono text), so the DOM assertion is the observable contract. ### Tested on | OS | Status | | :--------: | :----: | | 🍏 macOS | ✅ | | 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ | | 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ | macOS: local vitest (jsdom) under Node 22. Windows/Linux: CI only — the Windows path forms (drive/UNC/percent-encoded backslashes) are covered by unit assertions derived from the pipeline's actual percent-encoding behavior, not by a live Windows browser run. ### Environment Local: jsdom vitest under Node 22 in `packages/web-shell`; no dev server needed for the unit tests. The export path (document mode) is covered by the unchanged `integration-tests/chat-transcript-document.test.ts` contract in CI. ## Risk & Scope - Main risk or tradeoff: the local-path detection is a string predicate (drive letter, UNC, `~`, and a fixed set of well-known POSIX roots); a local path rooted outside that set (e.g. `/data2/shot.png`) still renders as a broken `` first and then degrades to the error chip — acceptable, because the error chip is the general fallback. - Not validated / out of scope: live rendering in a real Windows/Linux browser; the footnote preview path keeps the plain `markdownUrlTransform` (unchanged by design); the standalone export renderer's chip placeholder stays English (no i18n provider in that context). - Breaking changes / migration notes: none. `isLocalFilesystemImageSrc` is exported for unit coverage only; no API or protocol change. ## Linked Issues Fixes #17452
中文说明 ## 本 PR 做了什么 Web Shell 中引用本地文件系统路径的 markdown 图片——POSIX 绝对路径（如 `/Users/foo/screenshot.png`）、Windows 盘符路径（如 `C:\temp\shot.png`）、UNC 路径（如 `\\server\share\shot.png`）或 `~` 家目录路径——不再渲染成损坏的 `` 占位符。这类 `src` 值能通过现有的同源 URL 检查（单个前导 `/` 被视为同源路由），但永远不是有效的浏览器 URL，图片根本不可能加载。组件现在会检测这些路径，并渲染一个可选择的等宽 chip，显示该路径（有 alt 文本时以 alt 作前缀），取代损坏的占位图。 每个渲染出的图片还会挂上 `onError` 处理器：任何加载失败——失效的 http(s) 链接、缺失的同源资源、被净化器改写的 src——都会降级为同样的 chip，用户始终能看到可读的来源，而不是空框。chip 需要展示的 src 值在交互模式下放行净化器，范围仅限图片的 `src` 属性（链接 href 保持净化）：本地文件系统路径与安全的 base64 `data:image` 源。markdown 管线在谓词运行前会把反斜杠百分号编码（`C:\…` 到达时为 `C:%5C…`），因此谓词同时接受原始与编码两种分隔符，chip 再把它们解码回来，显示用户写下的路径。内联 base64 data 图片仍按真实图片渲染。文档模式（转录导出）策略不变：导出 DOM 中绝不写入远程或本地 `src`；无 alt 时的占位符在该模式下保持固定的英文字面量，因为独立导出渲染器没有 i18n provider；交互模式下的占位符使用 i18n 键 `markdown.imageMissingSource`（en/zh-CN/ru）。 ## 为什么需要 Agent 在把截图保存到磁盘并在消息中引用时，会合理地输出本地图片引用——用户此前看到的却是一个损坏的图片框，而不是可见、可用的路径。把路径变成可读（可选择、可复制）的内容，把死路变成可用的引用；加载错误降级则堵上了其他任何无法加载的 src 的同一漏洞。实际复现在关联 issue 的线程中。 ## 审查者测试计划 ### 如何验证 1. 运行 web-shell 单测：`cd packages/web-shell && npx vitest run client/components/messages/Markdown.test.ts`（jsdom）。预期：`markdown image fallback` 测试全部通过——POSIX 路径 → chip `shot — /Users/foo/shot.png`（无 ``）；Windows 盘符路径 → chip 显示解码后的 `C:\Users\foo\shot.png`；UNC 路径 → chip `unc — \\server\share\shot.png`；无 alt 的本地路径 → 仅显示路径；无法加载的 src 且无 alt → 本地化占位符 `(missing image source)`；`file:` scheme → chip；http 加载失败 → chip；安全 http 图片 → `` 不变；内联 base64 data 图片 → 真实 ``。 2. 在 Web Shell 手动验证：发送包含 `![shot](/Users/<你>/screenshot.png)`（本机存在的路径）的消息。改动前：损坏的图片占位符。改动后：虚线边框 chip，内容为 `shot — /Users/<你>/screenshot.png`，路径为可选择文本。 ### 证据（前后对比） 改动前：#17452 中的复现截图（损坏的 ``，路径显示为 alt）。改动后：chip 的 DOM 由 `Markdown.test.ts` 中的整串断言固定（例如 `shot — /Users/foo/shot.png`、`C:\temp\shot.png`、`(missing image source)`）；未新增截图——chip 是静态 CSS 类（`.imageFallback`：虚线边框、暗色等宽字体），DOM 断言即可观测的契约。 ### 已测试平台 | 系统 | 状态 | | :--------: | :----: | | 🍏 macOS | ✅ | | 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ | | 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ | macOS：Node 22 下的本地 vitest（jsdom）。Windows/Linux：仅 CI——Windows 路径形态（盘符/UNC/百分号编码反斜杠）由基于管线真实编码行为的单测断言覆盖，未做 Windows 真实浏览器验证。 ### 环境 本地：`packages/web-shell` 下 Node 22 的 jsdom vitest；单测无需 dev server。导出路径（文档模式）由 CI 中未改动的 `integration-tests/chat-transcript-document.test.ts` 契约覆盖。 ## 风险与范围 - 主要风险或取舍：本地路径检测是对 `src` 字符串的谓词（盘符、UNC、`~` 及固定的知名 POSIX 根目录集合）；不在该集合内的本地路径（例如 `/data2/shot.png`）仍会先渲染为损坏的 ``，再降级为错误 chip——可接受，因为错误 chip 是通用兜底。 - 未验证 / 超出范围：Windows/Linux 真实浏览器下的渲染验证；脚注预览路径仍使用普通 `markdownUrlTransform`（有意保持不变）；独立导出渲染器的 chip 占位符保持英文（该上下文没有 i18n provider）。 - 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：无。`isLocalFilesystemImageSrc` 仅为单测覆盖而导出；无 API 或协议变更。 ## 关联 issue Fixes #17452

prs.title: fix(cli): give static transcript text an explicit wrap width
prs.body:
## What this PR does

On the static transcript path, a block of text that had no width of its own was measured implicitly by the layout engine, so a line that filled the terminal could run into the reserved right margin and the terminal would then break it hard in the middle of a word. This PR states the width explicitly for the three conversation block types that were affected: ordinary paragraphs, markdown list items, and markdown blockquotes. The width is opt-in per call site, and only the conversational call sites opt in; call sites whose available width already includes their own border and padding are deliberately left alone.

This is a take-over of #15021 by agreement with its author (@PanSHIgg), who asked for the work to move forward here and will close that PR once this one is open. The paragraph half is his change, carried over as-is; the list-item and blockquote halves extend the same mechanism to two call sites that were left as follow-ups in the original PR.

## Why it's needed

The reported symptom is one or two characters landing alone in column zero after a line that reached the right edge, with the following line's indent shifted by a column. It is width-dependent and was reported on Windows at 100 columns. The root cause is that the wrapping text had no declared width, so the layout engine could hand the terminal a line one or a few cells wider than the space actually reserved for it. Giving the block its real width removes that possibility for the three affected block types.

The original PR covered paragraphs only and explicitly deferred list items and the remaining call sites. While verifying the paragraph fix in a real terminal, the same defect was observed on numbered lists and on blockquotes, so all three are fixed here rather than in three separate rounds.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

The regression tests render the real transcript component inside a real static list at a fixed terminal width and assert that no rendered line is wider than the space the transcript reserves (terminal width minus the two-column margins). Each of the three block types has its own test, and each test fails on the build where its own block type is still unfixed:

| build | failing tests |
| --- | --- |
| current `main`, no fixes | paragraphs, flat list, nested list, blockquote — `5 failed` |
| + paragraph fix only | flat list, nested list |
| + list fix only | blockquote |
| + all three | none — `237 passed` across the transcript and markdown suites |

So the three defects are separated by independent signals: fixing one does not hide another. A reviewer can reproduce the first row by reverting the source changes and re-running the transcript test file.

For the live check: run the CLI in a 100-column Windows terminal with the virtualized history disabled, and ask for a long single-paragraph answer, a numbered list of two long items, and a long one-line blockquote. Before the change, words break mid-word at the right edge and the fragment lands in column zero. After the change, wrapping happens at word boundaries and the right margin stays intact.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Both frames below are the same model, the same working directory and a real 100-column Windows ConPTY; only the built bundle differs.

Before — build without the fixes:

![Before: blockquote, paragraph and list all break at the right margin](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Aleks-0/qwen-code/pr-assets-14075/pr-assets/14075-three-base-100col.png)

After — build with the three fixes:

![After: the same three blocks wrap at word boundaries and the right margin is intact](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Aleks-0/qwen-code/pr-assets-14075/pr-assets/14075-three-fixed-100col.png)

The same frames as text, so the break points are greppable. Before — blockquote, paragraph and list all break; worst line is 100 cells against a 98-cell ceiling:

```
  ◆︎  │ История вычислительной техники начинается с механических счётных устройств — абака, счётовой
       доски и арифмометра Лейбница, — продолжается разностной и аналитической машинами Чарлза Бэбби
джа
       с первыми программами Ады Лавлейс, переходит к электромеханическим реле Конрада Цузе и лампов
ым
```

After — same three blocks, no orphan in column zero, worst content line 98:

```
  ◆︎  │ История вычислительной техники начинается с механических счётных устройств — абака, счётовой
       доски и арифмометра Лейбница, — продолжается разностной и аналитической машинами
       Чарлза Бэббиджа с первыми программами Ады Лавлейс, переходит к электромеханическим реле
```

Breaks visible before and gone after: blockquote `Бэбби`/`джа`, `лампов`/`ым`; paragraph `сформулиров`/`ано`, `вме`/`сте`; list `врод`/`е`.

Independent verification of the original paragraph work, carried over from #15021: the paragraph regression test fails on the base commit (`2 failed | 42 passed`) and passes with the fix (`44/44`), and the Windows build, typecheck, lint and bundle are green here. Credit to @holny for the earlier reproduction attempts in the issue thread.

One caveat about the pair above, stated plainly: the "before" frame was captured from the commit this branch was cut from, while the branch itself sits on a later `main` after a merge. The comparison therefore shows the product before and after the three fixes plus unrelated upstream movement. The per-path unit tests, not the screenshots, are what attribute the fix to these changes.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ✅   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### Environment (optional)

Unit tests via the package's own vitest runner. Live frames from a real ConPTY session driven through a pseudo-terminal harness with the terminal buffer captured headlessly; the CLI was built and bundled locally on Windows.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: an explicitly declared width clips instead of overflowing if a call site opts in while passing an available width that already accounts for its own border and padding. That is why the opt-in is per call site and is enabled only on the conversational paths, which pass the width the block may actually use.
- Not validated / out of scope: macOS and Linux. Also not validated: terminals that render ambiguous-width characters as two cells. The fix restores the reserved two-column right margin, which absorbs that drift on lines with no ambiguous glyphs, but a boundary line carrying several of them can still exceed the terminal width by more than the margin; that residual is unchanged by this PR and is tracked in the issue.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. No public options or settings are added or changed.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #14075

Take-over of #15021 by agreement with its author; the paragraph change and the verification above are carried over from it. The remaining caveat noted under Risk & Scope is carried over as well, so the closing keyword reflects the reported symptom being addressed on the reported platform, not a claim that ambiguous-width terminal behaviour was measured.

QwenCode QwenLLM

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

在静态会话（static transcript）渲染路径上，没有自身宽度的文本块会被布局引擎隐式测量，因此占满终端宽度的行可能侵占预留的右边距，随后由终端在单词中间强制断行。本 PR 为受影响的三类会话内容块显式声明宽度：普通段落、markdown 有序/无序列表项，以及 markdown 引用块。该宽度按调用点逐个开启，只在会话类调用点启用；那些可用宽度本身已包含自身边框与内边距的调用点有意保持不动。

这是与 #15021 作者（@PanSHIgg）协商后对该 PR 的接手（take-over）。作者已同意在此推进，并在本 PR 开出后关闭原 PR。段落部分原样沿用其改动；列表项与引用块两部分把同一机制扩展到原 PR 中留作后续项的两个调用点。

## 为什么需要

报告的症状是：某行顶到终端右边缘后，有一两个字符单独落在第 0 列，下一行的缩进也随之错位。该问题与宽度相关，报告环境为 Windows、100 列。根因是换行文本未声明宽度，布局引擎可能交给终端比实际可用空间宽一格或数格的行。为这三类内容块声明真实宽度即可消除该可能。

原 PR 只覆盖段落，并明确把列表项及其余调用点留作后续。在真实终端中验证段落修复时，同样的缺陷在有序列表和引用块上也被观察到，因此三者一并在此修复，而不是分三轮。

## 评审验证方案

### 如何验证

回归测试在固定终端宽度下把真实会话组件渲染进真实的 static 列表，并断言任何渲染行的宽度都不超过会话预留的空间（终端宽度减去两列边距）。三类内容块各有自己的测试，并且每个测试都在“该类型尚未修复”的构建上失败：

| 构建 | 失败的测试 |
| --- | --- |
| 当前 `main`，无任何修复 | 段落、扁平列表、嵌套列表、引用块 — `5 failed` |
| 仅段落修复 | 扁平列表、嵌套列表 |
| 仅列表修复 | 引用块 |
| 三项全部 | 无 — 会话与 markdown 两个测试套件共 `237 passed` |

因此三个缺陷由彼此独立的信号区分：修复其中一个不会掩盖另一个。评审者可以回退源码改动后重跑该测试文件来复现第一行。

实机验证：在 100 列 Windows 终端中关闭虚拟化历史运行 CLI，要求模型给出一个长段落、一个含两条长条目的有序列表和一行长引用。修改前，单词在右边缘被截断，碎片落在第 0 列；修改后按词边界换行，右边距保持完整。

### 前后对比证据

以下两帧来自同一模型、同一工作目录、真实 100 列 Windows ConPTY，唯一差别是构建产物。文件：`14075-three-base-100col.png`、`14075-three-fixed-100col.png`。

修改前 — 引用块、段落、列表均断裂；最宽行 100 格，上限为 98 格（见英文正文代码块）。

修改后 — 同样三块内容，第 0 列无孤立碎片，最宽内容行 98 格。

修改前可见、修改后消失的断裂：引用块 `Бэбби`/`джа`、`лампов`/`ым`；段落 `сформулиров`/`ано`、`вме`/`сте`；列表 `врод`/`е`。

来自 #15021 的独立验证结论一并保留：段落回归测试在基线提交上失败（`2 failed | 42 passed`），加上修复后通过（`44/44`）；本分支在 Windows 上的构建、类型检查、lint 与打包均为绿。感谢 @holny 在 issue 讨论中的早期复现尝试。

关于上述对比的一个坦率说明：“修改前”那一帧取自本分支切出时的提交，而分支本身在合并后已位于更新的 `main`。因此该对比展示的是“三项修复加上无关上游变更”前后的产品状态。真正把修复归因于本次改动的是按路径拆分的单元测试，而不是截图。

### 测试平台

|     系统     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |

### 运行环境（可选）

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或权衡：若某个调用点在可用宽度已包含自身边框与内边距的情况下开启该开关，显式宽度会造成裁切而不是溢出。因此该开关按调用点启用，且只在会话类路径启用，这些路径传入的正是内容块真正可使用的宽度。

prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds `/memory show` to print the combined memory content the session carries, closing the blind spot where a user tuning memory (editing QWEN.md, `/remember`, `/forget`, `/dream`) had no way to verify what the model actually receives without an external-editor roundtrip. The repo was building, testing, lint-allowlisting and bundling ~80 lines of unreachable code in `useShowMemoryCommand.ts`; this PR ports that logic into the command, deletes the dead hook, migrates the tests, and drops both ESLint legacy allowlist entries.

## Why it's needed

Every memory-editing surface has a verification gap: `/memory` opens a dialog of toggles that renders no content; `/context` reports per-file token counts; the search-memory tool is model-facing with a one-line transcript summary; `MemoryManager.getStatus` has no CLI caller. The same three sources the system prompt assembles — hierarchical QWEN.md context files, the auto-memory prompt, and the auto-memory context — are what `/memory show` prints, closing the "is my edit actually loaded?" loop.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Run `/memory show` with memory loaded (edit a QWEN.md first). Confirm the output includes the loaded context-file count and the combined content in a markdown fence, separated by `---`. Run it with no memory loaded — should print the empty state. The subcommand is `packages/cli/src/**` only; no core change.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — CLI output, no UI.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |  N/A   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

macOS: 11 tests in `memoryCommand.test.ts` — all pass, including the combined-content test (three sources joined with `---`), empty state, loaded-but-empty state, missing-config error, and the graceful `getAutoMemoryContext` fallback. ESLint and Prettier clean. Two ESLint legacy allowlist entries dropped.

## Risk & Scope

- 4 files changed: memoryCommand.ts (+54), memoryCommand.test.ts (+85), useShowMemoryCommand.ts (-81 deleted), useShowMemoryCommand.test.ts (-152 deleted), plus 2 ESLint allowlist lines removed.
- CLI-only change (`packages/cli/src/**`); no core code touched.
- The dead-code deletion is the riskiest part — verified by the ESLint allowlist dropping to zero references.

## Linked Issues

Closes #16517.
