prs.title: fix: plugin tools lose native conversation IDs on CLI backends
prs.body:
Closes #200186

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes plugin tools losing the current conversation's native ID when a run uses a CLI backend.

## User Impact

Plugin tools receive the host's raw conversation ID on the CLI loopback path, as they already do on embedded runs. The delivery target remains separate, and an unavailable native ID stays absent.

## Why This Change Was Made

Both CLI grant creation and Gateway tool resolution dropped this existing context field. Forwarding the host-provided `chatId` through those two points restores the documented plugin contract without inferring identity from a delivery target, session key, or client header.

## Evidence

Local focused validation: **112 tests passed across five files**. Core production types, Gateway test types, targeted lint/format, test-line budget (+160/400), and staged diff checks passed. Independent P0-P3 review found no actionable issues in the byte-verified four-file patch and supplied source context.

The broad `check:changed --staged --delegate-compilers` run passed its initial guards but was stopped during whole-repository SQLite analysis when local memory was exhausted. Its remaining lanes are deferred to PR CI; the full command is not claimed as passed.

The regression loads a temporary plugin, creates an admitted CLI grant, authenticates against the real local MCP HTTP server, and invokes the plugin tool. Native ID and delivery target deliberately differ. A second invocation omits the native ID while retaining the same delivery target.

On base `54cb172fb2adf6f77c936c80e3a7ee82cb74e135`, the regression failed at the plugin result:

```text
Expected: {"nativeChannelId":"native-room-123","target":"channel:delivery-456"}
Received: {"nativeChannelId":null,"target":"channel:delivery-456"}
```

No external channel or model credentials were used; this proves the local CLI-grant/MCP/plugin path, not a live Claude or Slack turn. Broad CI remains separate from local focused validation.


With the fix, the real HTTP responses satisfy both cases:

```json
{"nativeChannelId":"native-room-123","target":"channel:delivery-456"}
{"nativeChannelId":null,"target":"channel:delivery-456"}
```

<details>
<summary>Local validation commands and results</summary>

```text
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs run src/agents/cli-runner/mcp-grant-context.test.ts src/gateway/mcp-http.test.ts src/gateway/tool-resolution.test.ts src/agents/openclaw-tools.plugin-context.test.ts src/gateway/mcp-http.plugin-context.test.ts --maxWorkers=1
unit-fast:    1 file,  15 passed
gateway:      3 files, 89 passed
agents-core:  1 file,   8 passed
```

The new integration case took 81.1 seconds on this Windows host, excluding cold worker compilation. An earlier attempt hit the wrapper's 15-minute no-output watchdog during compilation; the successful run used `OPENCLAW_VITEST_NO_OUTPUT_TIMEOUT_MS=3600000`. No test assertions or test timeouts were relaxed.

```text
node scripts/run-tsgo.mjs -p tsconfig.core.json --incremental --tsBuildInfoFile .artifacts/tsgo-cache/core.tsbuildinfo
node scripts/run-tsgo.mjs -p test/tsconfig/tsconfig.core.test.gateway-root.json
node scripts/run-oxlint.mjs --tsconfig config/tsconfig/oxlint.core.json <the four changed files>
node scripts/run-format.mts --check <the four changed files>
node --import ./scripts/tsx.mjs scripts/check-test-lines-ratchet.mts --staged --base HEAD
git diff --cached --check
```

All checks above passed against the patch before commit. The comparison base was `54cb172fb2adf6f77c936c80e3a7ee82cb74e135`.

</details>

prs.title: fix(knowledge): preserve other agents' scribes during setup
prs.body:
Closes #196224

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes: setting up or repairing a Knowledge scribe can remove another agent’s scheduled scribe when the operator can manage both agents.

## User Impact

Each agent can retain its own scheduled scribes when another agent starts or repairs the same scribe. Existing pauses remain preserved during setup; repair still enables its own automation. Previously removed schedules need to be recreated through the normal owner-authorized setup.

## Why This Change Was Made

The generated instructions now explicitly list and create automations for the Runtime agent, inspect recorded `owner.agentId`, and leave other or missing owners untouched. The documentation example uses the same scope. Existing cron authorization and declaration matching are unchanged.

## Evidence

Current-head runtime proof at `c2042d62fb5e55dba9c255731fb950a8b3565024` exercised the unmodified generated setup, setup-repeat, repair and repair-repeat prompts through a running isolated Gateway and production agent tools, using native Codex app-server with the existing ChatGPT subscription (`gpt-6.1-sol`, medium). Independent persisted readbacks show four schedules across three agents: setup preserves the owned pause, repair enables only its own schedule, repeats create no duplicates, and all three foreign records remain entirely unchanged. All four real inference turns reached terminal `ok`. No synthetic inference was used in those measured turns, no production source changed, and no credentials/auth order/model defaults were changed. This is headless Control UI protocol proof, not browser-button interaction or overnight execution; prompt-image delivery below remains open.

- The added setup/repair scope contracts fail on the original generated instructions and pass with this fix; final Knowledge state/view suite: **36 passed**.
- Real Gateway-handler/SQLite ownership suite: **5 passed**, covering three agents with two shared declaration keys, agent-filtered administrator lists, idempotent retries, preserved pauses/foreign definitions, and retained explicit administrator get/update/remove. These protect already-correct backend behavior and are not a reproduction of the prompt defect.
- The primary ownership/validation/Knowledge run passed **192 tests** before final wording/fixture refinements; the affected suites were rerun afterward. Formatting, whitespace and scoped documentation checks passed.
- Earlier installation report (separate from the current-head run above): the browser-source patch was built and adopted through the supported plugin asset/metadata pipeline, followed by native Control UI plugin reload. The report described the corrected setup guard and six schedules across three agents. That earlier report lacks inspectable attached runtime media and is not presented as the new four-schedule proof or as completed proof delivery.

- Focused Knowledge typecheck passed through the native wrapper using the canonical extension-test configuration and ambient declarations. Typed lint passed for the changed Knowledge source/test and Gateway regression (zero warnings/errors). The dependency-ownership refusal was resolved with a task-owned offline frozen install: 1,482 packages reused, zero downloads, no guard bypass. The broader browser package-project declaration failure is retained separately; this is a scoped validation claim.

### Synthetic rendered before / after

The real Knowledge view, dialog and styles were rendered with a synthetic host at base `2e73417ca8a52bfe2e8de64c5263f8b03a4dc6f3` and head `b15b817cbc7b8fb7884b70e7769b216c83b04e2e`. Two original 1440×1000 PNGs were captured and inspected with the expanded Prompt showing the old cleanup instruction and corrected owner-agent filter. Theme dark, locale en-US, time zone UTC; the visible controls were exercised and no fixture write was sent. Unchanged component/style sources were hash-matched. Available Chromium 153 revision 1243 was used; Playwright’s expected revision 1248, the upstream screenshot-frame helper and repeat pixel comparisons were not used. This is synthetic rendering evidence, separate from live schedule readback.

**Draft delivery blocker:** `gh pr edit --attach` refused both inspected PNG attachments because it requires write access to the upstream repository. The required inline-image delivery gate remains incomplete; no generated media was committed and no alternative upload destination was substituted. Private runtime screens are excluded. Source, focused tests, typecheck/lint and live schedule recovery are delivered; this PR is not claimed merge-ready.

prs.title: fix(signal): links with non-English characters are shown twice
prs.body:
Closes #199107

## What Problem This Solves

Signal compares a visible URL label with the parser's percent-encoded destination. A link containing non-ASCII characters or `|` therefore appears twice, with an encoded copy in parentheses.

## User Impact

These links appear once, as written. Differing labels still show their destination. Escaped percent signs stay distinct (`%2541` versus `%41`), and decodes introducing whitespace or controls do not hide the destination. Mailto, plain ASCII, and existing case-sensitive HTTP path/query behavior are unchanged.

## Why This Change Was Made

Reuse Signal's existing normalized-label comparison, also checking the decoded destination. Preserve `%25` before decoding. Short-circuit exact matches and avoid temporary comparison/split arrays.

The original fix and escaped-percent repair by @udsy19 are retained as their original signed-off commits. Existing and added URL assertions are folded into one table, with no cases removed: production net +14 lines, tests net 0.

## Evidence

Verified candidate: `f21586fdea4785e1b11ca136fd6105210501651c`.

[Raw main/candidate JSON-RPC send text and controls](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/199109#issuecomment-6927584154).

- Two recorded signal-cli group envelopes on each side, through isolated built Gateways, the real OpenClaw agent runtime, a deterministic local provider, and the production Signal formatter/native sender.
- Main twice: Unicode and vertical-bar URLs gain an encoded duplicate. Candidate twice: once, as written.
- All four rounds retain differing labels, `%2541`/`%41`, mailto, ASCII, and decoded-space controls.
- Formatter tests: main 3 fail / 17 pass; candidate 20/20 pass. Formatting check passes.
- Full tier: `ocx build --dts` and self-contained packed tarball integrity/import checks pass. Baseline used dist-nodts.
- No dependency, install-script, hook, patch, or package changes. Task-owned HOME/profile/state/workspace and loopback ports; fixture identities only.

## Known Gaps and Merge Danger

The daemon is a loopback signal-cli protocol fixture, not a live Signal account or recipient-device UI. Punycode/IDN hosts are unchanged.

Two-way code change: a revert restores prior Signal text formatting. No configuration, public API, stored-format, or schema changes; already-sent messages are unchanged.

prs.title: fix(auth): main does not build after the identity path lookup moved
prs.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes: `main` has not typechecked or bundled since 9e66164c0ce.

```
src/agents/auth-profiles/oauth-refresh-peers.ts(2,10): error TS2724: '"../../infra/boundary-path.js"' has no exported member named 'resolveIdentityPathViaExistingAncestor'.
```

```
[MISSING_EXPORT] "resolveIdentityPathViaExistingAncestor" is not exported by "src/infra/boundary-path.ts".
   ╭─[ src/agents/auth-profiles/oauth-refresh-peers.ts:2:10 ]
```

## User Impact

User impact: none for released versions. On `main`, the build and any test that needs the compiled bundle fail; this restores them.

## Why This Change Was Made

Two PRs that each passed alone conflict once both are on `main`:

- #200192 (9323fb9d1d2) added an import of `resolveIdentityPathViaExistingAncestor` from `src/infra/boundary-path.js` in `oauth-refresh-peers.ts`.
- #200203 (9e66164c0ce) moved that function to `src/infra/path-existence.ts` and updated the callers that existed on its base.

This change imports it from `path-existence.js`, the same edit #200203 made to the other callers. The function is the same one; behavior is unchanged.

## Evidence

**Red, unmodified main at 4dfa4343011**

- `pnpm tsgo:all`: exit 2, with the single TS2724 error above.
- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs` on a set that needs the compiled subprocess bundle: "Build failed with 1 error", the `MISSING_EXPORT` above. The same failure occurs on 9e66164c0ce.

**Green, this change**

- `pnpm tsgo:all`: no errors.
- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs` on the `src/agents/auth-profiles/oauth*.test.ts` files: 12 files, 165 tests passed.
- The update-service test set that failed to build on main now runs: 24 files, 418 passed, 16 skipped.
- `oxfmt --check` on the file: clean.

**Not run:** the full suite; CI covers it. No test file changed, so none was audited. The autoreview helper cannot run on this machine; the change is one import line.

prs.body:
## Split review hold

**HOLD — open draft; no valid 5–10k deletion replacement survived the named-keeper checks.** Original head: `71f70f9d3016669d37ff3c194b71a13588261d05`; reviewed source base: `b90c5739fa5cbff09f35de8985e1579b4442d5cd`. No deletion from these split proposals landed. Keep this original open for maintainer review; it is not approved to merge.

All four proposed areas retain their candidates: native/provider lifecycle (10 suites), agent execution and delivery (12 suites plus one helper), storage/update/cron (9 suites plus two helpers), and UI/plugin controls (10 suites). Across the 41 suites, the named keepers miss concrete boundaries including native turn settlement, prepared payload custody, physical SQLite admission and rollback, UI focus/lifecycle, and real plugin SDK composition. Dependent helpers remain with their retained consumers.

Preserve the six prior exact-main retentions: `templates-catalog.e2e.test.ts`, `ChatSessionSidebarQueryTests.swift`, `agent-lifecycle-registry.test.ts`, `prepared-model-runtime.catalog-owner.test.ts`, `session-manager-hydration.test.ts`, and `reply-agent-turn-preparation.test.ts`, with their selectors. No source changes or replacement PR are proposed.

This is bounded static source/keeper evidence, not executed runtime proof. The historical WebKit picker failure's cause remains **UNKNOWN**. No exact-main replay or inherited-failure claim is added; the historical zero-finding review does not override the newly identified keeper gaps.

---

## Current validation status

**Skipped from landing; draft, not merged.** Exact head: `71f70f9d3016669d37ff3c194b71a13588261d05`. [Exact-head review](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/198966#issuecomment-6880070552) has zero findings, but CI is not green.

[checks-ui (1/3)](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/43912433970/job/133458927741) failed the WebKit case `ui/src/pages/chat/components/chat-model-picker.browser.test.tsx` / `uses slash to focus open picker search without editing the composer`: expected a non-null element before the slash action. Picker source, direct helpers, setup and lockfile are unchanged. The only changed WebKit selection removes `chat-details.browser.test.ts`; no missing picker initialization was identified. `select-picker.behavior.browser.test.ts` and `modal-dialog.browser.test.ts` remain exact-main bytes, so the earlier order hypothesis does not establish this failure's cause.

Causality is unresolved, not attributed as inherited. No evidence-backed keeper restoration or production change was made. No qualified local or exact-main runtime replay was completed; the campaign's focused Testbox capacity attempt was queued and stopped. Remaining CI and Periphery runs were cancelled to release capacity. Retained for maintainer review with this exact failing test and job link.

## What Problem This Solves

Consolidates redundant test coverage under https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/198737 while preserving named existing coverage and distinct failure detection.

## User Impact

No production behavior changes. This tranche removes **33,431 net lines** (+59/-33,490; 33,549 changed lines) across 59 paths. It removes 41 whole suites and three unused test support modules. No new runtime or support implementation is added.

## Keeper Decisions

The [manifest](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/71f70f9d3016669d37ff3c194b71a13588261d05/test/scripts/coverage-consolidation/recut-198798-198799-d.tsv) names a surviving keeper for every removed file. Decisions use the authorized bounded file-level review; they do not claim exhaustive case-by-case equivalence.

Rebased the final test-only delta onto selected main `b90c5739fa5cbff09f35de8985e1579b4442d5cd`. Six retained candidate suites match it byte-for-byte, including these four restored in this repair:

- `src/agents/prepared-model-runtime.catalog-owner.test.ts`: new replaced-account/native-only publication and provider acquisition ownership assertions.
- `src/agents/sessions/session-manager-hydration.test.ts`: absent-storage transcript-cohort rejection must not consume the callback or create storage.
- `ui/src/pages/agents-home/templates-catalog.e2e.test.ts`: placeholder geometry, audit metadata, Add rollback recovery and no-plan assertions.
- `src/agents/agent-lifecycle-registry.test.ts`: lifecycle binding, committed deletion publication, stale worker reply and recovery-hold coverage is distinct from the database keeper.

Previously retained `src/auto-reply/reply/reply-agent-turn-preparation.test.ts` and `apps/shared/OpenClawKit/Tests/OpenClawKitTests/ChatSessionSidebarQueryTests.swift` also remain exact selected-main keepers.

Removed the orphaned compaction-runtime, SQLite prepared-admission and update-command lease-service support modules. Each retired suite was its helper's only importer; no surviving importer remains. Seven other main-edited deletion candidates contain fixture/wording/timing adjustments or removal of an obsolete case, without new assertions; their manifest keepers remain.

## Validation

Published signed head: `71f70f9d3016669d37ff3c194b71a13588261d05`. **Exact-head CI failed as recorded above; this head is not validated.**

- Normal commit hooks and signature verification passed.
- `git diff --check`, Node syntax checks and targeted oxfmt checks passed.
- All 47 manifest keepers exist. The 44 active deletion rows match the final deleted-file set; executable import, mock and inventory reference checks found no dangling reference.
- Existing dependencies are absent in this PR checkout. Runtime tests and typecheck were not run locally; no install was attempted.

Selected main already contains the stale `src/agents/agent-harness-completion-delivery.test.ts` selector cleanup in the proof inventory, policy watch, database-worker and unit-fast lists; this rebased head preserves that cleanup. Those stale entries caused `test/scripts/ci-node-test-plan.test.ts` / `covers every infra test exactly once across split shards` and `test/vitest-scoped-config.test.ts` / `discovers current and new src/agents watch files once across database owners` on other campaign heads. Those inherited selector corrections remain intact; no assertions or production logic are changed.

The prior head's UI Activity timeout was attributed to an executed main baseline in the earlier PR evidence. That historical attribution is not a passing result for this new head; fresh CI must establish its result.

## Inventory and Baseline Changes

Only this tranche's retired paths are changed in `config/ci-test-timings.json`, `config/test-mock-exports-baseline.txt`, `package.json`, `scripts/lib/ci-policy-test-watch.mts`, `scripts/lib/ci-proof-test-inventory.mts`, `scripts/lib/vitest-build-prerequisites.mts`, `scripts/lib/vitest-runtime-selection.mts`, `scripts/lib/vitest-shard-metadata.mts`, the CLI-process/database-worker/extension-worker inventories and `ui/vitest.config.ts`. The two planner regression fixtures select the retained Telegram polling-session suite with their assertions unchanged.

Related original tranches: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/198798 and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/198799. Published for fresh exact-head CI and review; not merged.

Latest rebase applied cleanly, preserving all main changes and the tranche’s retired test selectors. No deleted test acquired new main coverage between the prior and selected bases.

prs.title: test: consolidate redundant coverage (198798, group C)
prs.body:
## Split review hold

**HOLD — open draft; no valid 5–10k deletion replacement survived the named-keeper checks.** Original head: `b6bad39972b82078f0ec0d779d8929af5d3939f9`; reviewed source base: `b90c5739fa5cbff09f35de8985e1579b4442d5cd`. No deletion from these split proposals landed. Keep this original open for maintainer review; it is not approved to merge.

All 27 candidates retain distinct coverage: eight session/storage/cron suites, eight plugin/configuration suites, and eleven Gateway/UI suites. Examples include physical-store publication failure receipts, real worker actor updates, corrupt plugin rollback refusal, retained Gateway context, and first-message recovery bound to the original physical session. The named keepers do not cover these boundaries.

Preserve all 15 prior retentions and the three remaining reviewed gaps: `src/cron/service.trigger-eval.test.ts`, `src/gateway/model-account-connect.worker.test.ts`, and `src/gateway/server-methods.session-scoped-reads.test.ts`, with their owning selectors. No source changes, new helper pruning, or replacement PR are proposed.

These are bounded static source/keeper findings, not runtime-equivalence proof. The historical CI and review record below remains unresolved; no inherited-failure or current-green claim is added.

---

## Current validation status

**Skipped after the three authorized repair rounds; returned to draft. Not merged.** Exact head: `b6bad39972b82078f0ec0d779d8929af5d3939f9`.

The [final exact-head review](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/198961#issuecomment-6880033002) still identifies three distinct coverage gaps: malformed one-shot trigger recovery, competing personal-account credential writes through the real worker, and file download/preview access for session-read-only callers with draft-grant invalidation. No fourth repair was attempted.

CI is **not green**. [checks-node-changed-2](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/43914146769/job/133464685338) failed `test/scripts/ci-node-test-plan.selection-capacity.test.ts:394`, `shares selected serial setup within the shortest contributing timeout` (expected a shared serial selection). This planner test depends on the complete current file inventory before projecting selected targets; unchanged target files alone do not prove unchanged packing. [checks-ui (2/3)](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/43914146769/job/133464684034) failed `ui/src/pages/chat/components/chat-position-rail.test.tsx`, `keeps the focused run marker through streaming and retargets its persisted answer` (expected false to be true). Neither failure is attributed as inherited. Remaining CI and Darwin runs are confirmed completed with cancelled conclusions. Retained for maintainer review.

## What Problem This Solves

Consolidates redundant test coverage under https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/198737 while retaining distinct failure detection. Re-cuts candidates from https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/198798.

The [file-to-keeper manifest](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/b6bad39972b82078f0ec0d779d8929af5d3939f9/test/scripts/coverage-consolidation/recut-198798-c.tsv) records **45 candidates: 30 deleted and 15 retained**, with **39 existing keeper paths**. This is bounded file-level consolidation, not an exhaustive case-equivalence claim.

## Final Round 3 Keeper Repairs

Retained selected main `b90c5739fa5cbff09f35de8985e1579b4442d5cd` without another rebase. The previous round addressed the three distinct-coverage findings in [the review](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/198961#issuecomment-6880033002). Restored these whole suites exactly from that main and recorded zero-removal self-keepers:

- `ui/src/e2e/chat-stream-runtime-budgets.e2e.test.ts`: real-browser 240-delta coalescing, heap ceilings and idle CPU budgets.
- `src/secrets/egress-proxy/proxy-server.lifecycle.test.ts`: real HTTPS certificate renewal/recovery, trust continuity, connection lifetime and revocation fencing.
- `src/daemon/service-definition-backup.test.ts`: Windows interrupted launcher publication and subprocess crash recovery with runnable launchers and restorable receipts.

Restored the runtime-budget suite's complete owner-watch entry, timing and sequencer hints, serial Vitest configuration, discovery fixtures and documentation references. No assertion was weakened or rewritten. All fifteen retained suites match selected main byte-for-byte.

The final repair restores two more whole suites exactly from selected main and records self-keepers:

- `ui/src/components/sidebar-snapshot.test.ts`: readiness-only settlement schedules persistence after an unsettled capture without requiring another render, including the regression covered by https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/194568.
- `test/scripts/release-publish-parent.test.ts`: accepted numeric child IDs remain recorded before missing browser metadata, SHA verification failure or exhausted propagation reads, including the regression covered by https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/196501.

`test/scripts/ci-ui-e2e-ownership.test-support.ts` is also restored exactly from main. Its explicit `uiE2eRuntimeBudgetTestFile` serial-routing assertion replaces the substituted pasted-text member assertion. The runtime-budget suite and every prior retention remain intact. The release-parent proof-inventory entry and timing row are restored; no production code or new helper is added.

The prior exact-main retentions remain: SQLite cleanup race, cron stream approval, prepared workspace coordinator, workspace sync tunnel, update handoff single-flight, worker preparation, provider-hook provenance, skill selection authority, workspace skill-sync runtime and live session-progress placement. Their required helpers and own inventory entries remain intact.

No deleted test acquired new assertions between the prior and selected main revisions. Other retired paths and their existing named keepers remain as recorded in the manifest. The removed chat-rail sequencer hint stays removed; the restored runtime-budget hint now matches main. The generic isolated WebKit fixture continues to use the existing tooltip suite.

## Size And Scope

Relative to selected main `b90c5739fa5cbff09f35de8985e1579b4442d5cd`:

- **24,819 net lines removed**: +59/-24,878 across 40 paths.
- **24,937 changed lines**, below the 45,000-line cap.
- Production runtime LOC delta: zero. Changes are tests, test metadata, the manifest and existing related documentation references.

Selected main already contains the retired `src/agents/agent-harness-completion-delivery.test.ts` selector cleanup. This rebase preserves it; the previous inventory failure is not reintroduced.

## Local Evidence

- All fifteen retained suites match selected-main blobs; all 39 named keeper paths exist.
- The 30 deleted paths exactly equal the manifest's nonzero removal rows.
- Restored suites' relative imports and the subprocess TypeScript loader resolve. Named helper consumers remain present. The two new suite retentions and serial-routing test-support file match selected-main blobs exactly.
- Deleted-path import, mock and inventory reference checks found no remaining dangling reference outside the manifest.
- Node syntax checks for changed MTS/MJS metadata, JSON parsing, targeted oxfmt, normal signed commit hooks, signature verification and `git diff --check`: passed.
- Existing local dependencies are unqualified. Runtime tests and typecheck were not run; final CI and review status is recorded above.

This final round 3 head is prepared locally and held for publication. Fresh exact-head review and full CI remain pending; no merge submitted.

## Split review hold **HOLD — open draft; no valid 5–10k deletion replacement survived the named-keeper checks.** Original head: `ae4c3a8c563acdf801c39186f73248d3a65e6137`; reviewed source base: `4a0e45492b8987d67d8b56e8d6dcdb3765aa61ed`. No deletion from the split proposals landed. The original remains open for maintainer review, not approved to merge. All three proposed areas retain their suites: process execution/cleanup (23 suites plus its notification helper), authentication/model routing (24 suites), and tool/plugin/session composition (22 suites plus its caller-identity helper). Preserve the existing 20 prior exact-main retentions and the separately identified MCP tool-filter and ToolSearch discovery coverage. Required helpers stay with their retained consumers. The process-cleanup proposal was cancelled without publication after its three returned review passes identified 24 concrete findings covering every deleted suite. Its aggregate was **incomplete (exit 2)**, not a clean review; direct fixture checks confirmed the keeper-boundary gaps. The unpublished managed worktree was removed through native closeout; its source branch/history remain preserved. The other two areas also have no surviving deletion candidate after bounded source/keeper comparison. The historical repair, manifest and CI information below describes the unchanged original head. It does not validate a replacement, establish runtime equivalence, or supersede this HOLD. --- ## Terminal repair disposition **SKIPPED after three repair rounds; returned to draft, not approved to merge.** Head: `ae4c3a8c563acdf801c39186f73248d3a65e6137`. Net deletion remains **22,875 LOC** (+4/-22,879). No fourth repair round or further source changes are planned in this campaign pass. The [final exact-head review](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/198918#issuecomment-6879322158), reviewed at 18:09:59 UTC on November 16, identifies two unresolved distinct-coverage gaps: - `src/agents/agent-bundle-mcp-runtime.tool-filter.test.ts`: the removed real Node-side MCP regression covers `raw_app` visibility, `docs__raw_excluded` filtering and rejection of direct raw tool calls. The Gateway/helper keepers do not cover that Node boundary. - `src/agents/tool-search.discovery.test.ts`: the removed MCP ToolSearch input-signature boundary checks are not replaced by renderer keepers. Coordinator snapshot at **18:14:52 UTC on November 16**: **84 successful, 0 failed, 4 running and 1 queued checks**. CI was incomplete, not green; absence of failures at that snapshot is not validation. The coordinator confirmed that both named runs, Periphery `43923176269` and CI `43923177158`, completed with cancellation on exact head `ae4c3a8c563acdf801c39186f73248d3a65e6137`. No further polling is planned. The earlier Android HTTP 429 infrastructure classification remains below; no Android test failure is claimed. Related: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/198737 ## Change and keeper policy Removes 71 overlapping test suites and two orphaned test-support modules, retaining 20 exact-main suites. All 66 existing keeper paths are verified below. This is the authorized bounded file-level consolidation, not an exhaustive per-case equivalence claim. No production runtime changes or new support modules. **22,875 net lines removed**: +4/-22,879 across 84 files (22,883 changed lines). ## Prior round 2 review repairs Restored whole suites exactly from selected main for the five outstanding distinct-coverage findings: - `src/agents/tools-effective-inventory.cold-provider.test.ts`: cold-provider inventory ownership, resources, cancellation and selected-runtime generations. - `src/agents/agent-bundle-mcp-runtime.agent-bundle.test.ts`: installed bundle discovery and execution through a real stdio tool. - `src/agents/agent-bundle-mcp-runtime.stdio-recovery.test.ts`: reconnect after the real MCP child exits. - `src/agents/runtime-plugins.hooks.integration.test.ts`: standalone prepared-registry hooks, disabled-plugin behavior and retained nested capabilities. - `src/agents/provider-local-service.shutdown.test.ts`: descendant shutdown, replacement leases and recovery after failed process-exit observation. Restored their own protected/runtime inventory, database-worker, storage timing and Windows selector entries. Restored the installed-bundle non-isolated fixture and its original count assertions. Preserved every other main change while resolving the shared package and database-worker inventory conflicts. No deleted suite or retained suite changed between previous selected main `b90c5739fa5cbff09f35de8985e1579b4442d5cd` and current selected main `4a0e45492b8987d67d8b56e8d6dcdb3765aa61ed`. The refresh rebased without conflicts; range-diff confirms the reviewed patch is unchanged. The prior twelve exact-main retentions remain, including real PTY control, protected-mount upgrades, fallback service-tier assembly, asynchronous auth-source ownership, persistence caps, real MCP relay cleanup and delayed cancellation callbacks. Removed `agent-tools.caller-identity.test-support.ts` and `bash-tools.notify-on-exit-ack.test-support.ts` only after confirming their former suites were the sole importers and no surviving import or runtime registration remains. ## Final round 3 restorations The three remaining gaps in [the review](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/198918#issuecomment-6879322158) are restored as whole exact-main suites: - `src/agents/apply-patch.preflight.test.ts`: a later invalid update must fail preflight before an earlier delete changes an important file; also preserves ordered staging and alias checks. - `src/agents/agent-create.retained-schema.test.ts`: real agent creation preserves unavailable recovery-held and retained-deletion stores across schema 41-to-42 handling. - `src/agents/embedded-agent-block-chunker.tables.test.ts`: oversized Markdown-table continuation rendering, CRLF handling, replacement/reconciliation, row conservation and source-byte accounting. All three have no changes between selected main `4a0e45492b8987d67d8b56e8d6dcdb3765aa61ed` and newer main `3c512c5830183db9d4754f3a46a82248351a8138`; no unrelated rebase was performed. Their existing helpers are present and relative imports resolve. The agent-creation database-worker inventory row is restored. No helper implementation or assertion was rewritten. ## Validation - All twenty retained suites match selected main byte-for-byte; all 66 keeper paths exist. These static facts do not resolve the two final review gaps above. - The file-to-keeper manifest below matches all 73 deleted paths. - Restored relative imports resolve; deleted-file import, mock and inventory checks found no dangling references. - JSON, Node syntax, targeted oxfmt, whitespace, normal commit hooks and signature verification passed. - Existing checkout dependencies are unqualified. No local runtime test or typecheck was run. The final-head CI snapshot is incomplete and the two review gaps remain unresolved. - The previous-head [Android job](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/43921221889/job/133489650760) failed before instrumentation tests: Maven Central returned HTTP 429 while resolving the Kotlin Compose Gradle plugin 2.4.21, then the disabled repository could not resolve `junit-platform-engine:1.13.3`. This is a dependency-download infrastructure failure, not a failing Android test; no keeper restoration is warranted for it. This historical infrastructure failure does not validate the final round 3 head. - Earlier head `c59e4f17a757e36c8435434e44243ed2cb7eaee9` failed [UI E2E cached-reader stability](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/43876443448/job/133331498129), `chat-snapshot-text-fidelity.e2e.test.ts:162`. That historical failure remains unclassified and is not counted as passing or inherited. No UI source or tests are changed by this PR. ## Inventory and reference edits Only retired test paths are removed from `config/ci-test-timings.json`, `config/max-lines-baseline.txt`, `config/test-mock-exports-baseline.txt`, `package.json`, `scripts/lib/ci-proof-test-inventory.mts`, `scripts/lib/vitest-build-prerequisites.mts` and the agent/database-worker inventories. The changed-scope and runtime-trial fixtures select surviving suites with their behavioral assertions retained. The restored shutdown suite keeps its timeout-race baseline entry.

No deletion replacement from these packets has landed. The original stays open and in draft; no empty or undersized replacement is being published, and no close or merge is requested.

This is a source-based disposition, not a new runtime or CI run. The exact-head hosted CI result below remains the recorded historical result; green CI does not establish equivalent coverage in the proposed keepers. Earlier preparation and line-count notes remain for provenance and do not override this HOLD.

## Current validation status

**Skipped after three authorized repair rounds; draft, not merged.** Exact head: `3d1cc8962c6b664b55efbb18db3346ef87e05e1b`.

Hosted CI is green: 77 successful checks, zero failed or active checks, and [the aggregate gate succeeded](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/43912093771). Conditional skipped checks are not counted as passing tests. The [final exact-head review](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/198957#issuecomment-6880014537) still identifies four distinct coverage gaps: direct CI failure classification, deterministic explicit provider-profile binding, WebSocket service-tier replay guards, and full long-model identity through Discord Submit. Those findings block landing despite green CI. No fourth repair was attempted; retained for maintainer review.

## What Problem This Solves

Consolidates redundant standalone test coverage under https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/198737 while retaining the reviewed owner-level contracts. Re-cuts part of https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/198797.

Prepared head `3d1cc8962c6b664b55efbb18db3346ef87e05e1b`, rebased onto selected main `ae678bf4c6b808b3ffc69b67e62d3a54c5e0d67f`.

Production source delta is zero. No speculative helper pruning was added.

## Reviewed Retentions

Seven additional suites are retained byte-for-byte from selected main:

- `extensions/memory-wiki/src/cli.test.ts`

The remaining modify/delete conflicts changed fixture synchronization, API setup or removed assertions. Their existing deletion decisions remain; the repair adds no replacement mocks or weaker assertions.

## Evidence

- Normal signed commit hooks passed. Signature verification and `git diff --check` passed.
- All 23 retained candidate files match selected main exactly; every manifest keeper exists.
- The seven restored suites' direct imports resolve, including the loader test's explicitly generated `lazy.mjs` and `label.mjs` fixtures.
- No positive executable or inventory reference to the 26 deleted files was found in the bounded static scan.
- JSON parsing and Node syntax checks passed for the restored selection metadata.
- Existing dependencies are unqualified; no local runtime or typecheck pass is claimed.

The previous head's CI is historical only; the current head's completed CI and remaining review findings are recorded above. No merge has been submitted.

The four proposed split packets failed their named-keeper coverage checks: A (10 suites), B (7), C (8), and D (13). All 38 candidate suites and their required test helpers retain distinct failure detection. Bounded source checks corroborated the reported counterexamples, including account-bound history, queued authority changes, worker cleanup/placement, and authenticated request/publication lifetimes. Keep these suites and helpers; do not treat a nearby keeper as equivalent merely because it covers the same feature. No deletions from these replacement packets have landed. This original stays open and in draft; no empty or undersized replacement is being published. The independent 11-line cleanup of stale references to an already-deleted main test remains a separate inventory repair, not justification for deleting these suites. This is a source-based split disposition, not a new test run or current CI success claim. The preparation, line counts, review and CI notes below are historical records for this unchanged original head; they do not override this HOLD. ## Landing disposition: skipped after three repair rounds Exact reviewed head: `2cb75bf43d9c3818f5cf4cd5878e5d78c092baa6`. The [fresh review](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/198937#issuecomment-6879655057) still identifies distinct coverage gaps for accepted receiver lifetime, visible commentary cursor reset/resume, incompatible concurrent placement requests, and local scanner memo-hit aggregate byte limits. This PR is returned to draft under the maintainer's three-round limit; no fourth repair or merge is requested. Observed CI: 69 successful checks, no test failures, two PostgreSQL jobs still running and aggregate gate pending. Node inventory cases, production/test typechecks and lint passed. Remaining runs are cancelled on returning to draft; cancelled and skipped jobs are not counted as passes. The coverage review blocks landing despite those successful checks. ## Current repair status Repair round 3 is prepared locally against frozen main `4e9812cdef8992e63622e6d621d8e5d36f564539`. The three missing Gateway coverage suites are retained byte-for-byte from that main. Four stale inventory entries for the already-removed harness completion suite are removed. Fresh exact-head CI is pending; no passing runtime proof or landing is claimed. ## What Problem This Solves Consolidates redundant Gateway tests under https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/198737, retaining distinct failure detection and removing orphaned test support. ## User Impact No production behavior change. **29,670 net lines removed** (+11/-29,681); 42 suites and seven orphaned helper modules deleted. Changes stay below 45,000 total lines. ## Why This Change Was Made Rebased onto frozen main `4e9812cdef8992e63622e6d621d8e5d36f564539`. Retained exactly from selected main: - `control-ui-assistant-media-policy.test.ts`: session-bound grants, containment, device revocation and missing-profile refusal. - `worker-environments/provider-retained-lifecycle.test.ts`: retained pause/resume recovery and resource identity. - `cli-session-history.test.ts`: aggregate deduplication, identity and attachment preservation. - `server-close.agent-databases.test.ts`: accepted writes and durable outcomes settle before database retirement. - `github-pr-workspace-refresh.test.ts`: guest writes survive recovery. - `mention-inbox.test.ts`: linked-admin visibility and dismissal isolation. - `server-methods/cron-creator-transports.integration.test.ts`: template creator authority and disabled declarations. - `server.sessions.create.workspace-policy.test.ts`: alias replacement and unchanged session-state checks. The two previously retained suites, `session-restart-resume.test.ts` and `session-sharing-preparation.test.ts`, remain. Seven orphaned helper modules and the unused native-consent registration/fixture were removed after importer checks; the shared request, catalog and context utilities retain live callers. Those four complete entries are removed without changing assertions or production code. ## Evidence Repair head: 2cb75bf43d9c3818f5cf4cd5878e5d78c092baa6. ## Split review hold **HOLD — no viable 5–10k-line replacement survived the keeper checks. This original PR remains open in draft and is not approved to merge.** All four proposed packets failed the named-keeper comparison: A (five native-client suites), B (five PR/release suites), C (five installer/authentication suites and their required helpers), and D (five session/delivery suites and their required helpers). Each contains distinct coverage absent from its named keepers; bounded local source inspection corroborated all 20 reported test locations. No replacement was published and no deletions from these split proposals landed. Retain the candidate suites and required helpers. The existing FaceTime partial mock, typed Codex ordering assertions and Telegram fixture sanitization remain unchanged; this body update makes no source edits. Native Codex executable discovery was personally checked in sibling source at commit `414782450952a196bbb64b1605a458c2531c47b6`, `codex-cli/bin/codex.js:78–104`. The original terminal disposition and historical evidence remain below. They are not current approval or a runtime pass. No merge, replacement-close, new review or CI run is requested. --- ## Terminal disposition: skipped after three rounds **Draft; NOT LANDED; do not merge.** Three review/repair rounds are exhausted. The scoped typed-spy correction is published at `583e593806ed2e2513a1ed78e7cb6182b8146654`; no fourth semantic repair or new review is requested. Base: `ec025eba2df15ab949239fa17dfd99ac4286b50c`. Net remains **24,087 lines removed** (+120/-24,207). The previous head `bf47dea9014c25f990ebe957ce680e03bff7909a` had zero hosted review findings but four failed CI jobs. That review and those checks do not verify this new head: - [check-test-types, job 133525074744](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/43930945565/job/133525074744): two ordering-matcher type errors introduced by the fixture correction. The published fix retains typed local mock references and both ordering assertions. Current-head typecheck and CI remain unverified. - [Browser CLI, job 133524095276](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/43930945565/job/133524095276): the fixture throws a plain `Error`, while the policy expects `ExitError`. The same source mismatch exists in the selected base; no executed-base proof was obtained for this failure. - [UI unit, job 133524089171](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/43930945565/job/133524089171): `updates a mounted inline invocation without rendering the pane or disturbing its composer` found zero tool messages instead of one at line 175, before the toggle. Causality remains unresolved. - [UI E2E, job 133524088645](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/43930945565/job/133524088645): input ACK ownership encountered a detached element at line 77, before the deferred steer receipt; text-fidelity line 162 observed the retained reader anchor move over one pixel across two refreshes. Causality remains unresolved. The relevant UI source/config/helper closures are byte-identical between the selected base and previous head, with no deleted dependency found. That is source evidence only: no matching main execution proves these UI failures inherited, and no specific keeper restoration is justified. No production fix or speculative restoration was made. The new head has **no executed CI or local runtime/typecheck proof**. Local syntax, oxfmt, diff checks, normal hooks and signature verification passed. Both persistence → provider consumption → async delivery assertions remain; the FaceTime mock correction is unchanged. Static checks do not substitute for CI. Cancellation disposition (one bounded confirmation after accepted requests): - [Swift 43930945384](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/43930945384): completed/cancelled, previous head confirmed. - [Darwin 43930945223](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/43930945223): completed/cancelled, previous head confirmed. - [Periphery 43930945266](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/43930945266): completed/cancelled, confirmed by the root for the previous head. - [CI 43930945565](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/43930945565): completed/cancelled, confirmed by the root for the previous head. No dedicated retry, new full CI or new review is requested. Checkout retained for Vincent's review. Earlier preparation details and the deletion manifest follow; they are not a current-head green claim. ## Problem Overlapping test suites inflate repository and CI maintenance. This tranche implements the test-only consolidation authorized in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/198737. ## User impact No production behavior changes. Remove 20 whole test suites and five unused test-support modules while preserving identified owner-boundary coverage. Diff against main `ec025eba2df15ab949239fa17dfd99ac4286b50c`: **24,087 net lines removed (+120/-24,207)**. Production LOC: +0/-0. Shared test helpers and test-only selectors/baselines are also trimmed. ## Why this change Manifest: `test/scripts/coverage-consolidation/recut-198756-a.tsv`. Every deleted file names existing keeper suites. This is deliberate coverage consolidation with file-level evidence, not a claim of identical assertions. Thirteen suites are retained exactly from frozen main; the FaceTime fixture correction is unchanged from the published head; the Codex correction now retains typed spy references. Every orphan support module is mapped to the existing keeper of its former importing suite; orphan removal does not remove any additional invoked tests. Retained suites and reasons: - `extensions/codex/src/app-server/compact.test.ts`: Retain native compaction acknowledgement versus terminal completion, cancellation fencing and binding recovery; run-attempt/shared-client keepers do not cover these distinct paths. - `extensions/signal/src/monitor/event-handler.inbound-context.test.ts`: Main added native quoted-mention visibility and allowlist assertions. - `src/commands/agent-via-gateway.test.ts`: Main added ExpectedCliError classification before local/Gateway dispatch. - `test/scripts/find-reusable-release-validation.test.ts`: Main added independent candidate and qualification SHA admission coverage. - `test/scripts/full-release-artifacts.test.ts`: Main added bounded metadata recovery, immutable identity and authorization failure assertions. - `src/agents/tools/sessions-spawn-tool.test.ts`: Retain the only invocations of completion, input, visible-cleanup and visible-depth test registrars. - `extensions/memory-core/src/memory/index.test.ts`: Retain real forced reindex isolation for unrelated agent database rows; CLI keeper mocks the index owner. - `src/cli/plugins-cli.install.test.ts`: Retain Nix refusal and cancellation before installer or config-persistence effects at the CLI owner. - `src/commands/onboarding-plugin-install.test.ts`: Retain wizard capability consent, cancellation, progress and failure settlement at the onboarding owner. - `extensions/qa-lab/src/codex-native-hook-pressure.e2e.test.ts`: Resolve fixture conflict with current main; do not resurrect retired loop-detection configuration. - `extensions/telegram/src/send.history.test.ts`: Resolve fixture conflict with current main; retain added non-forum reply-chain history coverage. - `apps/android/app/src/test/java/ai/openclaw/app/ui/GatewayConfigResolverTest.kt`: Restore transport-security, URL and setup-code parsing coverage; `GatewayBootstrapAuthTest.kt` never calls the resolver. Its protected-test inventory entry is restored. - `test/scripts/plugin-npm-extended-stable-workflow.test.ts`: exact frozen-main restoration resolves the only modify/delete conflict and retains the new candidate-owned transport admission case. Its complete timing entry is restored and its manifest row is a zero-line self-keeper. prs.title: fix(gateway): close databases of agents removed by config reload without aborting their turns
prs.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes: when a config write removes an agent from `agents.entries`, the hot reload applies the change but never closes that agent's `openclaw-agent.sqlite`, `-wal`, and `-shm`. `agents.delete` then answers `agent "<id>" not found`, so nothing short of a restart releases the agent. If an operator later removes the agent's directory, the Linux WAL sidecar check finds the unlinked `-wal` descriptor on its next periodic tick and SIGKILLs the Gateway, taking every running turn with it.

## User Impact

User impact: removing an agent from config now releases its database on the hot reload. If the agent is idle, the database closes before `config hot reload applied`. If the agent has a turn in flight, that turn is not aborted: it finishes normally, its reply is persisted, and the database closes once the turn settles. The agent's files are kept, and adding the agent back reopens them and continues its history. Agents that stay in the roster are untouched, `agents.delete` keeps its own purge path, and the reload is never held up by the release.

## Why This Change Was Made

After a roster change, `server-reload-hot.ts` only called `reviveAgentDatabasesAfterConfigCommit`, which handles agents that come back after a deletion. Nothing on that path closed an agent that left. Now, after the commit, the reload compares the roster it replaced with the one it published (captured before publish, so a failed publish is not treated as a removal). For each removed agent that still holds a database:

- **Idle:** drain its pending writes, close its session-history worker connections with a real SQLite close (not `worker.terminate()`, which leaves a reader slot behind in `-shm`), checkpoint once with `TRUNCATE`, then close the database through `closeOpenClawAgentDatabaseByPathAsync`, the same path shutdown uses. A fence then refuses a new open of that path until the agent is re-admitted, so a late write cannot recreate the file.
- **Turn in flight:** do not abort it. Release after the turn's own promise settles, using the same close. If the agent is re-added first, the pending release is cancelled.
- **Turn that never returns:** the database stays open, as on `main`; the reload is not blocked.

The history-worker close is bounded by a 1 second budget and waits only on real completion promises (no polling). If a lane cannot be closed in that budget, the reload returns and the database stays open, as on `main`. Two existing gaps made the close give up in a real Gateway and are fixed here: the history pool latches its close permission on its first worker and never refreshes it (`session-transcript-read-pools.ts`), so the release checks the live runtime capability instead, and the trajectory retention sweep retained the history lane with no promise the close could wait on (`trajectory/runtime-retention.ts`). Plain `WorkerTaskPool` lanes are closed through a module-private helper; no exported class gains a method. No SDK, protocol, schema, or config changes.

## Evidence

Live Gateway on an isolated Linux VM, Node 24.22.1, loopback Gateway with a stub model and agents `main` and `worker` (`agents.ownership: "explicit"`). Each scenario removes `agents.entries.worker` from `openclaw.json` and waits for `config hot reload applied`. Descriptors are counted with `lsof` for `worker`'s `.sqlite`, `-wal`, and `-shm`. The branch was tested as a clean merge onto `main` `5e8ed5f5b437` (merge tree `29d4e5705b5c`): `main` once, the merge three times. Latency is `config change detected` to `config hot reload applied`.

| Scenario | `main` | main + this branch (3 runs) |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Idle removal: fds after the strip | 17, stays open | **0 / 0 / 0**, closed before `applied` |
| Idle removal: reload latency | 228 ms | 433 / 230 / 472 ms |
| Idle removal: turn to removed agent, then re-add | refused; re-add works | refused, no DB recreated, no reopened holder; re-add works 3/3 |
| Removal during a held turn: fds mid-hold / after settle | 17 / 18 (stays open) | 19, 17, 19 / **0, 0, 0** |
| Removal during a held turn: turn result | not aborted, reply persisted | not aborted; CLI gets the reply; a fresh connection reads the persisted reply with `stop` 3/3 |
| Turn that never returns | reload not blocked, DB open | reload not blocked, DB open 3/3 |
| Re-add while a release is pending | next turn works | release cancelled, next turn works 3/3 |
| `agents.delete` | 0 fds | 0 fds 3/3 |
| Turns on agents that stay | persisted | persisted 3/3 |

No `terminal session persistence failed` lines in any run. In 2 of 3 merged runs, `-wal`/`-shm` stayed on disk with no process holding them after the close. A clean SIGTERM shutdown on `main` does the same (1 of 3 runs), and a fresh connection replays the WAL and reads the persisted reply, so that is unchanged SQLite behavior, not a held descriptor.

Tests on the merge tree, three times each: `src/gateway/server-reload-departed-agent-databases.test.ts` (12 passed) and `server-reload-agent-databases.test.ts` (2 passed). Trajectory retention (29), writer admission (94), and transcript read pools (22) passed, as did `pnpm tsgo:core`. On the PR head, oxlint and oxfmt are clean on touched files. The new tests drive a real history worker, cover idle close with `-wal`/`-shm` cleanup, a held turn that is not aborted and stays readable from a fresh connection, a never-returning turn, re-add during a pending release, the latched native-lane close, the trajectory retain, a rejected publish, and the reopen fence; they wait on the reload promise rather than a wall clock. Test growth is covered by an allocation under `config/test-lines-allocations/`.

Caveat: I did not wait out the 30-minute WAL maintenance tick for the actual SIGKILL; the fix removes its precondition (open descriptors on a removed agent's files).

Closes #195523

prs.title: fix(cli): nodes push test still expects silent JSON-mode failures
prs.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes: `src/cli/program.nodes-diagnostics-auth.e2e.test.ts` › "rejects environment staging before lookup (JSON: true)" fails on `main` every run since 25c97908924 (#199970). It fails `checks-node-changed` on any PR whose changed lanes select it, for example #200181 (job 133469711316), which does not touch the nodes CLI.

```
AssertionError: expected [Function] to throw error including 'invalid --environment (use sandbox|production)' but got 'exit'
 ❯ src/cli/program.nodes-diagnostics-auth.e2e.test.ts:290:9
```

## User Impact

User impact: none for people running OpenClaw. Contributors stop getting this red check on unrelated PRs. No production file changes.

## Why This Change Was Made

#199970 changed `runCommandWithRuntime` on purpose: in `--json` mode a plain command error now goes through the same diagnostic path as text mode, and the wrapper then throws `ReportedCliCommandError` so the JSON failure owner keeps the original envelope. Its PR text says the nodes subprocess assertions were updated to require the concrete diagnostic. This in-process case was not: it still asserted that JSON mode calls neither `runtime.error` nor `runtime.exit`.

With the new wrapper, the nodes error handler runs in JSON mode, prints `nodes push failed: …` and calls `runtime.exit(1)`. The shared test runtime's `exit` throws a plain `Error("exit")`. The wrapper only converts the `ExitError` the real `defaultRuntime.exit` throws, so the plain error propagated and the case saw `exit` instead of the environment message.

The JSON case now:

- makes the runtime mock throw the real `ExitError` for that one call, as `defaultRuntime.exit` does;
- still requires the rejection to carry `invalid --environment (use sandbox|production)`, which is what the JSON failure owner formats;
- requires the diagnostic exactly once on stderr and exactly one `exit(1)`, in both modes;
- still requires an empty stdout and no Gateway call before lookup.

The text-mode case is unchanged apart from the exit assertion becoming exactly-once.

## Evidence

Head 591cd6209b1 on base 94e34f95696. Command for every run: `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/cli/program.nodes-diagnostics-auth.e2e.test.ts`.

**Red, unmodified main**

| Commit | Result |
| --- | --- |
| 98c732c6113 (parent of #199970) | 18 passed, 2 of 2 runs |
| 25c97908924 (#199970) | 1 failed, 17 passed |
| 6f5d3b399b3 (base of #200181) | 1 failed, 17 passed, 2 of 2 runs |
| 4a74c61ae7c (main when this branch was cut) | 1 failed, 17 passed |

**Green, this change**

- 3 of 3 runs on the first cut, then 1 run after rebasing onto 94e34f95696: 18 passed each. Main moved between the two; the range touches nothing under `src/cli` or `src/runtime.ts`, so I did not repeat the three runs.
- Negative control (temporary edit, reverted): with `runCommandWithRuntime` rethrowing in JSON mode before reporting, as it did before #199970, the JSON case fails on the missing diagnostic.
- `oxfmt --check` on the file and `git diff --check`: clean.
- `OPENCLAW_CHECK_CHANGED_SKIP_DEADCODE=1 node scripts/check-changed.mjs`: exit 0, including the core test typecheck and lint for the changed file. The dead-export scan is skipped because it currently fails on `main` for files this PR does not touch.

**Audit of the touched test file**

- Read all 18 cases, the two describe blocks, helpers, imports and the `process.argv` / `process.exitCode` restore in `afterEach`.
- This is the only case that asserted JSON-mode silence for a plain error. The `nodes status` credentials case that expects no `runtime.error` goes through the expected-error path, which #199970 left unchanged, and still passes.
- `mockImplementationOnce` is consumed by the single `exit` call and `vi.clearAllMocks()` runs in `beforeEach`, so nothing leaks into later cases.
- Nothing was removed or skipped.

**Not run**

- The wider CLI suites; CI covers them.
- The autoreview helper cannot run on this machine. The change is one test case and was read against `src/cli/cli-utils.ts` and `src/runtime.ts` on the head.

prs.body:
## Split review hold

**HOLD — no viable 5–10k-line replacement survived the keeper checks. This original PR remains open in draft and is not approved to merge.**

The proposed A–D replacements were not published. Their named keepers miss distinct worktree, announcement, tool/harness and spawn/delegation coverage. Those tests remain on main; no deletions from these replacement proposals landed.

B's accounting and refresh candidates had no reported finding, but total only 798 raw source lines. They are deferred, not validated or promoted into a smaller replacement. D's review aggregate was incomplete, with 14 concrete suite findings; local checks confirmed those coverage boundaries and the omitted shared fixture. No clean review is claimed.

The original proposal and historical evidence remain below for context, not current approval or validation. No replacement-close, merge, or new CI run is requested.

---

## Final disposition: skipped after three repair rounds

Exact-head [review](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/198917#issuecomment-6879360377) still finds five distinct coverage gaps: released-node/computer v2 requests; persisted subagent registry integration; PDF execution through a real captured catalog; Gateway maintenance tool assembly; and anchored-history budgets/work counts. No fourth repair round or merge is attempted. Latest CI snapshot: 67 successful checks, zero failures, five running; this is not green or completed validation. Returned to draft and remaining CI cancellation confirmed completed. Retained for maintainer review.

## Current validation status

Final repair round 3, prepared head `89e619e6b48b4c4c9c8eb427a9eed86c10114ec6`, selected main `4a0e45492b8987d67d8b56e8d6dcdb3765aa61ed`. Local static verification only; fresh exact-head CI and review are required after publication. Published for fresh exact-head CI and review; merge remains gated.

Related: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/198737

## Change and keeper policy

**27,188 net lines removed** (+20/-27,208 across 83 paths; 27,228 changed lines). Production source delta: zero. Remaining deletions: 65 test suites and two unreferenced test-support modules. The file-to-keeper manifest has 67 rows, each with an existing keeper. Prior distinct-coverage retentions remain exact selected main. All 67 deleted paths have named existing keepers; the final review restorations are listed below.

## Prior round 2 restorations

- `src/agents/tools/image-tool.runtime-abort.test.ts`: Abort signal forwarding; cancellation before execution, during model resolution, and mid-download; requester policy retirement.
- `src/agents/tools/github-publish-tool.handoff.test.ts`: Real yield/cleanup/publication/resume ordering, restored operator authority, failure notices and reset fencing.
- `src/agents/subagents/announce/subagent-announce.requester-settle-dispatch.test.ts`: New bounded saved-state rejection retry assertions, unique run IDs and completion ownership.
- `src/agents/subagents/announce/subagent-announce.requester-settle-pause.test.ts`: Current-main replacement-session pause notice remains owed and is delivered.
- `src/agents/subagents/announce/subagent-announce.requester-settle-routing.test.ts`: Current-main reset/replacement requester scope and authorization assertions.

All five suites match selected main byte-for-byte. The planned round 2 refresh merged cleanly; no deleted path changed between the prior and selected main, so no additional restoration was needed. Restored the complete dispatch proof-inventory entry and the GitHub handoff ownership comment. Main's announce-delivery change only removes one fixture field, so that deletion remains. Rebase inventory conflicts preserve main's unrelated removals and remove only this PR's owned deleted paths.

## Final round 3 restorations

The remaining gaps in [the exact-head review](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/198917#issuecomment-6879360377) are addressed with exact-main whole-suite restorations:

- `src/agents/tools/image-tool.custom-provider-auth.regression.test.ts`: real configured-key authentication and missing-key behavior.
- `src/agents/tools/sessions-tool.batch.test.ts`: 100-target batches, multibyte failure text bounded to 3,840 bytes, and continued sibling processing.
- `src/agents/tools/transcripts-tool.selection.test.ts`: date-shaped raw-ID ambiguity for stop/summarize, including retired captures.
- `src/agents/tools/transcripts-tool.capture-fixture.test-support.ts`: exact-main fixture required by the restored selection suite. Its imported dependency closure is present.

These are self-keepers. Their own mock baseline, proof inventory, duration estimate and database-worker entries are restored; no assertions or production code change. The coordinator-owned `test/scripts/ci-node-test-plan*` files are untouched by this repair.

## Unreferenced support cleanup

- `src/agents/subagents/announce/subagent-announce.test-support.ts`: sole importer was the deleted announce-format suite.
- `src/agents/subagents/spawn/subagent-spawn.in-process-gateway.test-support.ts`: sole importer was the deleted in-process Gateway suite.

Full-path and stem scans found no surviving importer before removal. The remaining two removed modules define fixtures for deleted tests; their deletion removes no additional test cases. The transcript capture fixture is retained for the restored selection suite.

## Split review hold **HOLD — no viable 5–10k-line replacement survived the keeper checks. This original PR remains open in draft and is not approved to merge.** All five proposed pieces were rejected or withdrawn because the retained keepers did not replace distinct coverage. The original tests remain on main; no deletions from these replacement proposals landed. - A and B were omitted; their candidate suites retain distinct coverage. - C was withdrawn after complete review found gaps in all remaining suites: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/200237. - D was omitted after the remaining four suites also showed distinct coverage gaps. - E was withdrawn after 22 concrete suite gaps were corroborated locally. Its review aggregate was incomplete because one helper was missing from the input; that is not a clean review: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/200239. The original proposal and historical evidence remain below for context, not current approval or validation. No replacement-close, merge, or new CI run is requested. --- ## Final disposition: skipped after three repair rounds The [exact-head review](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/198916#issuecomment-6879320517) still identifies three keeper gaps: resized-image retry and database reopen (the pasted-text restoration does not cover this), mutable nested history rewrite detection, and durable fallback notices when the primary never admitted a run. No fourth repair round or merge is attempted. CI is not green: [checks-node-changed-2](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/43919229721/job/133482874570) failed `test/scripts/ci-node-test-plan.selection-capacity.test.ts:394`, `shares selected serial setup within the shortest contributing timeout`. This is the known repository-inventory-sensitive planner fixture; no inherited attribution is claimed. Latest snapshot: 68 successful checks, one failure, two running. Returned to draft; remaining CI cancellation confirmed completed. Retained for maintainer review. ## Current validation status **Final round 3 repair prepared locally; fresh exact-head review and CI pending. Push held; merge remains gated.** Head: `4aef4e18c88852f75b3b750610fa5630c526a25b`. Selected main: `4a0e45492b8987d67d8b56e8d6dcdb3765aa61ed`. Related: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/198737. Replaces part of https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/198897 and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/198904. Part 1/4. ## What Problem This Solves Consolidates overlapping whole-file agent/runtime/model tests while preserving reviewed distinct behavior. The inline manifest maps all 91 remaining deleted suites to 27 surviving keeper suites. No production behavior change. ## Size and selected-main integration - **34,653 net lines removed**: +4/-34,657 across 107 paths; 34,661 changed lines. - Rebased the prepared round-2 delta onto selected main. The final delta contains 91 deleted test suites, four deleted orphan helpers, and 12 test selection/baseline/reference files; no runtime source change. - Ten retained suites match selected main byte-for-byte. The five prior retentions remain: `attempt-prompt-tool-policy.integration.test.ts`, `attempt-session-runtime-prepare.test.ts`, `model-fallback.terminal-boundary.test.ts`, `prepared-model-runtime.sources.test.ts`, and `session-tool-result-guard.transcript-events.test.ts`. ## Final round 3 review resolution The five remaining findings from https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/198916#issuecomment-6879320517 are addressed by restoring whole suites exactly from selected main: - `src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/model.provider-hooks.timeout.test.ts`: rebuilt provider models retain configured request timeouts, explicit hook overrides win, and real HTTP first-event/idle watchdogs use the result. - `src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/run/preemptive-compaction.replay.test.ts`: real Responses admission-to-wire bytes, stateless/text-transform differences, mutable-hook isolation and one-use prepared conversion. - `src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/run/attempt-prompt-submit.pasted-text.test.ts`: pasted attachment content persists through later provider requests and a reopened session, with transcript projection preserved. - `src/agents/prepared-model-runtime.remote-inference.integration.test.ts`: published v3 catalog facts pass through HTTP and SQLite into prepared role selection, inference filtering and pricing. - `src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/run/lane-controller.writer-claim.test.ts`: successful durable writer takeover fences late writes, while a failed replacement preserves the incumbent. All required helpers already survive. Restored three exact database-worker selector entries and the provider-timeout baseline entry; existing embedded-run globs cover the remaining suites. No assertions, timeouts, production code or historical measurements changed. ## Round 2 review resolution `src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/run/attempt-prompt-tool-policy.integration.test.ts` remains its own keeper (130 lines). It uses the real session registry to verify client-shadow denial/no slot, allowed native sibling execution, stable provider prefix, restoration and denial after registry refresh. The unit keeper's mocked lookup is no longer the only coverage. Its canonical embedded-run owner selects it through the existing `run/**/*.test.ts` include; selected main has no separate per-file inventory or mock-baseline entry to restore. The returned-draft refresh additionally retains exact-main `src/agents/session-tool-result-guard.transcript-events.test.ts`: main added committed image-tool-result versus assistant run ownership during callback rebinding. Its proof inventory, database-worker selector, and documentation reference are restored. Removed three stale selectors for the already-deleted `attempt.spawn-workspace.orphan.test.ts`: proof inventory, mapped policy-watch row, and database-worker list. The shared watch object and surviving owners remain intact. Four unreferenced test helpers remain deleted after resolved-import and exact-stem reference checks (313 lines total): - `src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/run/message-tool-terminal.test-support.ts` - `src/agents/model-fallback.run-embedded.attempts.test-support.ts` - `src/agents/test-helpers/catalog-capture-footprint.ts` - `src/agents/test-helpers/prepared-model-catalog-legacy-fixture.ts` Their shared dependencies remain used by surviving tests and were preserved. ## Prior-head UI failure [The previous UI E2E job](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/43917106550/job/133475435648) failed `chat-send-ack-ownership.e2e.test.ts`, `unadopted-c survives a steer ok receipt`, at `scrollIntoViewIfNeeded` because the element detached. This PR changes no UI, Gateway, UI E2E configuration or mock Gateway helper. No specific deleted keeper explains this DOM failure; it remains unclassified, not attributed as inherited. No speculative restore or production change was made. Fresh exact-head CI remains required. ## Validation evidence - Targeted oxfmt 0.74.0, whitespace, six changed-source Node syntax checks, passed. Normal signed commit hooks run on this prepared revision. - All 91 test deletion rows match the final diff; all 27 named deletion keepers exist. Four additional deleted paths are the unused helpers listed above. Ten explicit exact-main self-keepers are listed below. - Exact-main comparison passed for all ten retained suites. No surviving executable relative import/mock of remaining deleted test/helper paths, or exact deleted-path reference in test-selection inventories, was found. - No local Vitest or typecheck: dependency installation is unqualified and none was installed. Historical review/CI results apply to earlier heads; fresh exact-head CI and independent review remain pending.
